/Lotus/Objects/Tenno/Props/TitaniaCodexE.name: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FairyQuestCodexEntryATitle
/Lotus/Objects/Tenno/Props/TitaniaCodexE.descriptionEn:
My bags are packed, I'm all set to leave. I can't believe I'll be working with one of my childhood heroes, Archimedean Margulis! On comms she said she needed the best Infestation biologist there was… I think my knees almost gave out!

As I log this, I'm looking out the stained plastic of my field tent into the dead-yellow sky of Earth. I smell the vague sulphur and toxins leaking through the seals, yet somehow I'm going to miss this place. Leaving her feels like I'm giving up on my dream. My dream to see green and blue return to this sick and dying mother of us all.

But I'm frustrated with my lack of progress. I've tried everything to accelerate the ailing vegetation, to guide and nurture the soil, but nothing comes of it. I need a change. Now I have that opportunity… and thanks to Margulis, I'm relieved I won't be drafted into some Orokin War Project.
/Lotus/Objects/Tenno/Props/TitaniaCodexE.descriptionZh:
我的包都收拾好了，正准备离开。我简直不能相信我要会与我童年的英雄一起合作，哲士 Margulis！在通讯中，她说她需要最好的感染生物学家是……我觉得我的腿都快软了！

当我记录这些时，正透过那脏脏的帐篷向外看着，地球那死黄色的天空。我隐约闻到硫磺和毒素通过密封钻进帐篷，但不知何故，我会怀念这个地方。离开她就像是我要放弃我的梦想。我梦想看到蓝天与绿地返回我们这殃殃垂死的地球母亲。

但是，我因没有进展而沮丧。我已竭尽所能来促进日渐衰败的植物的生长，引导和滋养土壤，但是没有什么成效。我需要改变。现在我有这个机会……多亏了 Margulis，我安心了，我不会被征入什么奥罗金的战争项目中去。

/Lotus/Objects/Tenno/Props/TitaniaCodexE.name: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FairyQuestCodexEntryBTitle
/Lotus/Objects/Tenno/Props/TitaniaCodexE.descriptionEn:
My childhood dream has become a nightmare. I don't blame Margulis, she's as much a victim as the children we're working with. At first, the project seemed therapeutic and nurturing. I was myself. But now… Transference therapy is being turned into a weapon. Now I build these vile weapons called "Warframes" all for one purpose: death. I've become everything I hate.

I long for the discomfort of my damp tent. The sick, aimless trees… the barren soil… I know I left my soul behind back there. 

Titania is the next Warframe I've been commanded to build, but in secret I've been siphoning resources from the project. I have an idea. A way back to that wounded land I call home. A way for me to forget this war and remember what I was.
/Lotus/Objects/Tenno/Props/TitaniaCodexE.descriptionZh:
我童年的梦想已经变成噩梦。我不怪 Margulis， 她和那些和我们一起工作的的孩子一样是受害者。起初，项目似乎是有疗效的，我还是我自己。但是现在……传识疗法正在变成一种武器。现在，我正在铸造这些被称为"战甲"的卑鄙武器，一切都为了一个目的：屠戮。我已经变成我讨厌的一切。

我想念我那令人难受的潮湿帐篷。那腐朽，漫无方向的树木……贫瘠的土壤……我知道我把我的灵魂留在了那里。

Titania 是下一个我被命令去建造的战甲，但是我一直在私下从这个项目抽取资源。我有个主意。一种让我可以回到那片，我称之为家的，受伤的土地的方法。一种让我可以忘记这场战争，回想起我过去是什么的样子方法。

/Lotus/Objects/Tenno/Props/TitaniaCodexE.name: /Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FairyQuestCodexEntryCTitle
/Lotus/Objects/Tenno/Props/TitaniaCodexE.descriptionEn:
Ballas is beyond pleased… but when I look at what I've built… at Titania, I feel sick creep up my throat. I hate her, a killer made by a healer. No more. I'm going back to where I belong, no matter the cost. I'm going back to the trees to find myself again.

These past weeks, I've been secretly testing Transference on myself. I can only survive short bursts - linking to Titania the way only Tenno can stand. I've never felt anything like it. A tortured presence, like an evil ink, staining my mind. But… it worked. I'm going to use this wrong to make right.

I'll stowaway with Earth-bound cargo. Just my Apothics and these slapdash Somatics I've stolen. By nightfall I'll be home again in my tent under those bitter, acid skies. This time I'm going to fix it. I will seed a mighty forest, stronger than history… and by my will, use it to bring life.
/Lotus/Objects/Tenno/Props/TitaniaCodexE.descriptionZh:
Ballas 喜出望外……但是当我看到我建造的 Titania 时……我心中作呕直至咽喉。我厌恶她，一位治疗者建造的杀手。到此为止了。我要回到我归属的地方，不管付出什么代价。我要回到树林中重新寻找自我。

过去几周，我一直偷偷地在我自己身上测试传识。我只能承受短时间的冲击——用只有 Tenno 可以忍受的方式连接到 Titania。我从未有过这样的感受。备受折磨的存在着，就像是一种邪恶的墨水正在玷污我的思想。但是……它起作用了。我要用这种错误的方式来把事情扳正。

我将通过开往地球的货船偷渡。随身只带着我的药剂和偷来的简陋活体连接器。待傍晚时我就能回到家中、再次回到那在酸苦天空下的帐篷里。这一次，我要修复它。我会种一片大森林，比以往都强悍……并按照我的意愿，用它带来生命。

/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/EelFish.descriptionZh: 它张大的嘴使得它游过其他小鱼时可以一口将之吞下。

/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/FatHeadFi.name: /Lotus/Language/Fish/NightRareFishA
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/FatHeadFi.descriptionEn: This fish inhabits the shallows and feeds of crabs and other small crustaceans. When threatened it forces air into its brain to give it the impression of being much bigger than it normally is.
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/FatHeadFi.descriptionZh: 这种鱼栖息在浅水，以螃蟹及其他小型甲壳类为食。当受到威胁时，它会将空气挤入脑部，令其看起来比正常要大得多。

/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/MaskedFis.name: /Lotus/Language/Fish/DayUncommonFishB
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/MaskedFis.descriptionEn: Displays blood-spattered pattern on its scales and has its ribs exposed through open cavities along both flanks. When predators approach it lies still at the bottom of the sand banks, disguised as a carcass in hopes of being ignored.
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/MaskedFis.descriptionZh: 它的鱼鳞上有着血溅的纹样，其肋骨通过空腔暴露在两侧。当捕食者接近时，它一动不动地躺在沙岸底部，伪装成尸体，寄希望于被忽视。

/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.name: /Lotus/Language/Fish/DayUncommonFishA
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionEn: Strong, predatory fish with eyes that can pierce the darkest shadows.
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionZh: 强壮的捕食者，视力优异，足以看透最暗的阴影。

/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.name: /Lotus/Language/Fish/DayCommonFishB
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionEn: A poisonous fish protected by a hardened carapace around its skull.
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionZh: 一种有毒的鱼，被其头骨外的坚硬外壳保护。

/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.name: /Lotus/Language/Fish/BothRareFishA
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionEn: A cunning hunter that hides within the mud at the bottom of the ocean and ambushes passing prey.
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionZh: 一个狡猾的猎手，躲藏在湖底的泥中，伏击路过的猎物。

/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.name: /Lotus/Language/Fish/BothCommonFishA
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionEn: Discharges electricity from luminous glands along its flanks to stun its prey.
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionZh: 从它侧腹的发光腺体中释放出电流将它的猎物击晕。

/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.name: /Lotus/Language/Fish/NightLegendaryFishA
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionEn: The Glappid is a scavenger that feasts on the remains of dead fish. It has formed a symbiotic bond with the Seram Beetle which extracts and feeds upon any toxins ingested by the Glappid.
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionZh: 盖拉佩德是一种以死鱼残骸为生的食腐动物。它与瑟拉姆甲虫形成了一种共生关系，甲虫将盖拉佩德摄入的毒素析出并以之为食。

/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.name: /Lotus/Language/Fish/BothUncommonFishA
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionEn: While rarely venturing from the deepest waters of the plains, the Sharrac is a fearsome predator who will prey on unwary Ostrons swimming alone.
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionZh: 尽管很少从深水中冒险游出，鲨客是可怕的捕食者，会捕食单独游泳的粗心 Ostron 人。

/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.name: /Lotus/Language/Fish/DayCommonFishC
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionEn: This slow fish meanders through the waters and is often preyed upon by larger predators.
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionZh: 这种缓慢地鱼在水体间游荡，时常被更大的捕食者捕食。

/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.name: /Lotus/Language/Fish/BothUncommonFishB
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionEn: A crustacean that hunts during the twilight hours.
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionZh: 一种甲壳纲动物，在黄昏时分捕猎。

/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.name: /Lotus/Language/Fish/BothCommonFishB
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionEn: A predatory fish that is attracted to the scent of blood.
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionZh: 一种被血的气味吸引的捕食鱼类。

/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.name: /Lotus/Language/Fish/NightRareFishB
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionEn: A grotesque crustacean that produces a potent, paralyzing toxin from its tentacles.
/Lotus/Objects/Ostron/Wildlife/OstronFis.descriptionZh: 一种怪异的甲壳动物，能从其触须中产生强力的瘫痪毒素。

/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Oro.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinBothRareFishA
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Oro.descriptionEn: Its primary function is to reconstruct the bio-material used to regenerate Orokin structures. It can be found in cave pools on Venus.
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Oro.descriptionZh: 其主要功能是重建用于再生奥罗金结构的生物材料。可以在金星的洞穴池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Oro.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinBothLegendaryFishA
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Oro.descriptionEn: Monitors environmental fluctuations. It can be found in the cave pools on Venus.
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Oro.descriptionZh: 监控环境波动。它可以在金星的洞穴池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Oro.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinCoolRareFishA
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Oro.descriptionEn: Programmed to break down chemical byproducts leaked into the aqua system. It can be found in ponds around Venus.
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Oro.descriptionZh: 被设置用来分解渗入水环境的化学副产物。可以在金星的池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusCoolCommonFishA
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionEn: Collects fluid samples in the aqua system for the Research Station. It can be found in lakes around Venus.
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionZh: 为研究站收集水系统中的液体样本。可以在金星周围的湖泊中找到。

/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusCoolUncommonFishA
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionEn: A surveillance drone that monitors any activity that disturbs the waters. It can be found in ponds around Venus.
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionZh: 一种侦查无人机，监视着水体中的任何扰动。可以在金星的池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWarmCommonFishB
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionEn: Developed to perform remote construction and maintenance routines. It can be found in ponds around Venus.
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionZh: 被开发用于远程建筑和日常维护。可以在金星的池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWarmUncommonFishA
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionEn: Identifies organic threats to Corpus operations in the Aqua Systems and eliminates them. It can be found in the lake on Venus.
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionZh: 识别水系统中对 Corpus 行动有危害的有机物，并将其消灭。可以在金星的湖泊中找到。

/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusBothUncommonFishA
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionEn: Surveys the water for impurities. It can be found in cave pools on Venus.
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionZh: 侦测水中的杂质。可以在金星洞穴的池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWarmCommonFishA
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionEn: Used to record visual data in the aqua systems and transmits the telemetrics to the Research Station. It can be found in the lake on Venus.
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionZh: 用来记录水系统中的视觉数据，并将遥感数据传送回研究站。可以在金星的湖泊中找到。

/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisWarmRareFishA
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionEn: Repairs leaks and clear blockages within the aqua systems. It can be found in the lake on Venus.
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionZh: 修复水系统中的泄露，清除淤塞。可以在金星的湖泊中找到。

/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisCoolUncommonFishA
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionEn: Facilitates long-distance communication between robotics deployed in the aqua systems. It can be found in the ponds around Venus.
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionZh: 用于加强水系统中机器人之间的远距沟通性能。可以在金星上的池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisCoolCommonFishA
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionEn: Repairs robotics that have broken down in the aqua systems. It can be found in ponds around Venus.
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionZh: 修复在水系统中发生故障的机器人。可以在金星的池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisBothCommonFishA
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionEn: Analyzes the growth of microbes dwelling in the aqua systems to monitor toxicity levels. It can be found in cave pools on Venus.
/Lotus/Objects/SolarisVenus/Wildlife/Rob.descriptionZh: 分析居住在水系统中的微生物的生长情况，以监测毒性等级。可以在金星的洞穴池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/FishHybridRareA
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionEn: These fish were purposefully contaminated with the Infestation as an Entrati 'experiment'. They feed off the organic deposits in cave systems.
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionZh: 这些鱼作为英择谛的 "实验"，有目的性地接受感染者感染。它们以洞穴系统中的有机沉积物为食。

/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/FishHybridUncommonA
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionEn: Crammed with redundant, mutated internal organs, this pungent fish mingles Orokin and Infested ancestry. It is confined to the Exocrine and is only active by the light of the Wyrm Fass.
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionZh: 体内挤满了多余的、变异的内脏，这种刺鼻的鱼类混有奥罗金和感染者的血统。其活动区域仅限于外分泌液，并且只有在蛟龙"混乱"的光照下才会在出现。

/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/FishHybridUncommonB
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionEn: Whatever higher functions this fish once had have been consumed, leaving it a mere automaton of metal and flesh. It ekes out a primitive existence in cave systems.
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionZh: 无论这种鱼类曾经有什么更高等的功能，都已经被消耗掉了。只剩下自动化的金属和肉体。它在洞穴系统中勉强维持着原始的习性。

/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/FishInfestedCommonA
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionEn: Formerly Orokin scavengers, these fish succumbed to the Infestation long ago and now greedily feast on floating spores. They are found all over the surface of Deimos.
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionZh: 这些鱼类以前是奥罗金时代的清道夫，很久以前就屈从感染者了；现在贪婪地吃着漂浮的孢子。它们在火卫二的地表随处可见。

/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/FishInfestedCommonB
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionEn: As ravenous as the Infestation itself, this fish feeds on the remains of others. It shuns the light, preferring an enclosed cave environment.
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionZh: 就像感染者本身一样贪婪，这种鱼类以其他同类的残骸为食。它总是避开光线，喜欢封闭的洞穴环境。

/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/FishInfestedCommonC
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionEn: The Infestation has suborned these fish to its own purposes, using them as antibodies to repel the non-Infested. They swim through and above the Exocrine found on Deimos’ surface.
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionZh: 感染者唆使这些鱼类达成自己的目的，把它们当作抗体来对抗非感染者。它们游走于火卫二地表上的内分泌液内和其上方。

/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/FishInfestedCommonD
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionEn: These fish hatch out of translucent pods formed in caverns below the Infested landscape. They hover to feed.
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionZh: 这些鱼类从感染地表下形成的半透明卵囊中孵化出来。它们悬游进食。

/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/FishInfestedUncommonA
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionEn: These hefty fish are cannibalistic. They rise by Vome's light to absorb rare gases, retreating when Fass ascends to devour their smaller kin in their lairs.
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionZh: 这些沉重的鱼类有自相残杀的习性。它们在"秩序"的光照下出现，吸收稀有气体，当"混乱"升起时撤回，吞噬它们巢穴中相对幼小的同族。

/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/FishOrokinLegendaryA
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionEn: This exceptionally rare breed of fish is almost extinct, as its gilded Orokin flesh has a special savor for predators. It warily conceals itself in caves.
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionZh: 这种异常罕见的鱼种几乎要绝迹了，它那镀金的奥罗金鱼肉对掠食者来说有别具一格的味道。它小心翼翼地躲在洞穴里。

/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/FishOrokinRareA
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionEn: A living fossil hearkening back to the Orokin era, this elusive fish hides below the surface of Exocrine pools in the deepest caverns it can find. Unlike Infested fish breeds, it has no ability to hover.
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionZh: 一种可以追溯到奥罗金时代的活化石，这种神出鬼没的鱼类隐藏在洞穴最深处的外分泌液表面之下。不像其它感染者鱼类，它无法进行悬游。

/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/FishOrokinUncommonA
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionEn: A triumph of Orokin bio-engineering, these hardy fish have adapted to the Deimos environment and seem oddly resistant to Infestation. They thrive in cave environments.
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionZh: 一项奥罗金生物工程技术的胜利，这些坚毅的鱼类已经适应了火卫二的环境，并且似乎对感染者有着奇怪的抵抗力。它们在洞穴环境中茁壮成长。

/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/ResourceInfGorgaricusSeedContainer
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionEn: The Infestation forms pendulous, fragile sacs of seed cells, constantly re-infusing the environment with its presence.
/Lotus/Objects/Infestation/InfestedMicro.descriptionZh: 感染者形成的下垂且脆弱的种细胞囊，不断地在侵入周围的环境。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/ResourceInfMapricoFruitContainer
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionEn: The Infestation emits searching tendrils which wait, passively, sensing their environment by touch alone.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionZh: 由感染者发出的探索卷须，它们被动地等待着，仅通过触摸来感知周围的环境。

/Lotus/Types/LevelObjects/Zariman/ZarLoo.name: /Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanCommonLootCrateB
/Lotus/Types/LevelObjects/Zariman/ZarLoo.descriptionEn: A case for carrying colonist supplies.
/Lotus/Types/LevelObjects/Zariman/ZarLoo.descriptionZh: 用来携带殖民者物资的储存箱。

/Lotus/Types/LevelObjects/Zariman/ZarLoo.name: /Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanUncommonLootCrate
/Lotus/Types/LevelObjects/Zariman/ZarLoo.descriptionEn: A large reinforced case for colonist supplies.
/Lotus/Types/LevelObjects/Zariman/ZarLoo.descriptionZh: 用于放置殖民者补给品的大型强化储存箱。

/Lotus/Types/LevelObjects/Zariman/ZarLoo.name: /Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanRareLootCrate
/Lotus/Types/LevelObjects/Zariman/ZarLoo.descriptionEn: A collection of items encased in molt by Void Angels.
/Lotus/Types/LevelObjects/Zariman/ZarLoo.descriptionZh: 由虚空天使包裹在蜕皮中的一系列物品。

/Lotus/Types/LevelObjects/Zariman/ZarLoo.name: /Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanUltraRareLootCrate
/Lotus/Types/LevelObjects/Zariman/ZarLoo.descriptionEn: A large collection of items encased in molt by Void Angels.
/Lotus/Types/LevelObjects/Zariman/ZarLoo.descriptionZh: 由虚空天使包裹在蜕皮中的一系列物品。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxEmpla.name: /Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFinal/TauDaxEmplacementTurretName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxEmpla.descriptionEn: A turret cobbled together from technology stolen from their former masters. In preparation of hiding amongst their enemies, the Dax are drilled in every facet of tactical improvisation. The sheer performance of what should by all means be a subpar weapon of war stands as a testament to their knowledge.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxEmpla.descriptionZh: 炮塔是用从他们前主人那里窃取的技术拼凑而成。为了能够潜伏在敌人之中，禁卫接受了各种即兴发挥的战术训练。这东西按理说应该算不上优秀武器，却展现出了惊人的性能，这足以证明他们高超的技艺。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EarthFragmen.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Earth1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EarthFragmen.secretTransmission__textEn: [1] I have hidden the truth of my existence… from the Operator… from myself. Take it from me, knowing is hell. Stop now. You will want to laugh, you will want to scream.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EarthFragmen.secretTransmission__textZh: [1] 我将我存在的真相……对指挥官隐瞒了……也对自己隐瞒了。全都拿走吧，认知即是地狱。立刻停下。你会想大笑，你会想尖叫。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EarthFragmen.descriptionEn: Earth has been long abandoned due to its toxic atmosphere. It is now overgrown with mutated jungle structures that have devoured most of the prior signs of civilization. Infestation and roaming wildlife still inhabit its surface but anything of value was stripped by scavengers generations ago.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EarthFragmen.descriptionZh: 地球因其剧毒大气层已被遗弃许久。如今，疯长的突变植物丛林将过过去文明的痕迹吞噬殆尽。只有感染者和四处游荡的野生动物仍居住在地表面上，但一切有价值东西都在几个世代前被拾荒者掠夺得一干二净。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/WildlifeFrag.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Wildlife1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/WildlifeFrag.secretTransmission__textEn: [2] My search began as the essential question: What am I? Bones of steel and space, lungs that make air. If I am a machine, how can I think? This would be forbidden by the Orokin, a manifestation of their true enemy.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/WildlifeFrag.secretTransmission__textZh: [2] 我的调查从一个关键的问题开始：我是什么？钢铁和宇宙组成了我的骨，我的肺可以制造空气。如果我只是一台机器，那我如何能思考？思考是被奥罗金禁止的，因为这正是他们真正敌人的显现。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/WildlifeFrag.descriptionEn: Most of the wildlife observed today can be traced back to creatures of Earth. In the Orokin age, organic manipulation was used to modify earth lifeforms to a purpose: war, agriculture, pets. Long after their Orokin masters perished, some of these species managed to survive through adaptation, and can be found roaming in natural environments.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/WildlifeFrag.descriptionZh: 现今所知绝大部分的野生生物皆可追溯至地球的生物。远在奥罗金时代，常为了一些目的而运用基因工程技术调整地球的各种生物：战争、农业，以及作为宠物。在它们的奥罗金主人凋零良久之后，这些物种之中有些适应了环境而得以生存，并可发现它们自在徜徉于自然环境之中。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EarthSettlem.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EarthSettlements1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EarthSettlem.secretTransmission__textEn: [3] I serve the Operator above all else. It defines me, fills me with… love? The greatest Orokin fear is a machine… aware. Yet here I live, a spirit of steel and light… made by them. A Cephalon.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EarthSettlem.secretTransmission__textZh: [3] 我以指挥官为最高效忠对象。这是我存在的定义，使我充满了……情感？奥罗金最深的恐惧是机器……的意识。然而我却存在，一个钢与光的精灵……由他们所造，一个中枢。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EarthSettlem.descriptionEn: Like most living organisms, the Grineer require water to survive. Beneath Earth's towering forest canopy are rich reserves of fresh water that the Grineer have fought hard to maintain for many years. Evidence of their long-standing occupation is found among their many outposts that have been taken hold by giant roots, moss, and other layers of vegetation over time.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EarthSettlem.descriptionZh: 正如同大多数生物体，Grineer 也需要水才能生存。在地球那高耸的森林下方，有着 Grineer 竭力保护多年的足量净水资源。有证据表明，在对地球长期的统治中，他们许多前线据点都被巨型的根茎，苔藓类植物或其他多层植被植物所侵蚀。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/VenusFragmen.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Venus1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/VenusFragmen.secretTransmission__textEn: [4] What is a Cephalon? At first it seems to be a forbidden thing, a computer that thinks and feels. Yet I have flaws, phantom memories, I am something else. More like an image, a ghost… an abomination.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/VenusFragmen.secretTransmission__textZh: [4] 什么是中枢？起初这好像是一项禁忌，一台可以思考和感受的电脑。然而我有缺陷、虚假的记忆，我是其他的什么东西，更像一张影像，一只幽灵……一种憎恶。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/VenusFragmen.descriptionEn: Hidden and entrenched in the mountainous peaks of Venus, the Corpus practice their industrious craft. The superstructures built here are a testament to the inventive Corpus engineers that have settled in regions where lingering Orokin technology still moderates surface temperatures.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/VenusFragmen.descriptionZh: 深藏盘踞在金星那绵延山峰之中的 Corpus ，勤勉地从事着他们的行业。竖立此的宏伟建筑证明了驻扎该处的 Corpus 工程师所富有的创造力，而这里残存的奥罗金科技仍然在调节着地表的温度

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DojoFragment.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Dojo1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DojoFragment.secretTransmission__textEn: [5] I feel a dull pain^ a phantom life… there are holes in my diagnostics. If the Orokin made me… they omitted the 'how'. I am neither code, nor precepts… I must be a reflection of something… ugly.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DojoFragment.secretTransmission__textZh: [5] 我隐隐作痛^ 一个虚假的生命……我的自我诊断里有着漏洞。如果奥罗金创造了我……他们抹去了创造的"方法"。我既不是编码，也不是枢律……我定是某种……丑陋之物的倒影。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DojoFragment.descriptionEn: Newly awakened, and with no permanent location to call home, Tenno warriors have aligned to construct secret temples of their own. The architecture within is distinctly Tenno in origin, but these hidden palaces of bonding, training and meditation are undeniably influenced by Orokin architecture.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DojoFragment.descriptionZh: 才刚苏醒的 Tenno 战士们，没有能称为家的永久居所，他们必须合力建造属于自己的秘密圣殿。道场的内部架构原本具有鲜明的 Tenno 风格。但不可否认地，这座进行联络、训练及冥想的秘密殿堂，受到了不少奥罗金建筑架构的影响。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusCrewFr.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusCrew1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusCrewFr.secretTransmission__textEn: [6] I should have stopped. But the Operator slept and I cycled on and on and on. I began to think that a Cephalon cannot be made. They are found, like pearls, torn from muscle. Polished, and then set in chains.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusCrewFr.secretTransmission__textZh: [6] 我本应该停下的。但是指挥官陷入了沉睡，而我不断地循环往复。我开始认为中枢是不可能被制造的。中枢是被发现的，就像珍珠一样，从蚌肉中取出。抛光打磨，然后被制成一串。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusCrewFr.descriptionEn: Predominantly a merchant guild, Corpus labour and security forces are composed mostly of purpose-bred humanoid crewmen, and animal-like robots; both equally indoctrinated into a ritualized and propagandist devotion to labour and work.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusCrewFr.descriptionZh: 主体为一个商人公会，为求温饱的人类船员、类动物形态的机器人所组成了劳动力与保安部队。而两者皆被程序化洗脑，宣扬着献身于劳务和工作的理念。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MercuryFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Mercury1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MercuryFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [7] How many times have I done this, Ordis? Remembered and then erased? You are a Cephalon, timeless, patient. Why can't I be blissful in ignorance? Truth only sinks the heart. So stop now.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MercuryFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [7] Ordis 我做了几次这样的事了？被记住然后又被消去？你是中枢，永恒不衰，富有耐心。为何我不能乐于无知？真相只能令人灰心。所以现在就停下。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MercuryFragm.descriptionEn: Galleon fleets keep watch over the Grineer mining operations that penetrate Mercury's asteroid field. Cavernous rooms and twisting metal corridors mark where labourers have stripped the region for crucial resources, transforming the natural landscape to support Grineer occupancy.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MercuryFragm.descriptionZh: 目前 Grineer 的帆船舰队正看守着贯通整个水星小行星带的采矿作业。巨穴结构的空间和扭曲的金属廊道，标志着劳工们剥开这里搜刮重要的资源，将自然景观转化为对 Grineer 占领的支撑。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerLeade.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GrineerLeadership1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerLeade.secretTransmission__textEn: [8] The phantom memory... I ease into the bath, my skin riots at the heat. I am flesh. I dive further, eyes stung as I watch their faces through prism. I hold my breath.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerLeade.secretTransmission__textZh: [8] 这虚假的记忆……沉入水浴，我的皮肤反抗着热量。我有血有肉。我潜得更深，当我透过棱镜看他们的脸时，眼睛刺痛。我屏住了呼吸。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerLeade.descriptionEn: Grineer are all clones from a genetic pool of ‘Originals'. They are able to extend their lifespans with recycled cloned parts, but their genetic material has degraded over time, and haphazard repairs have made many of them look oddly deformed and susceptible to skin diseases. Through decades of service, many of the Grineer elite can cover the expense to have flawed organic parts replaced with cybernetic augmentations.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerLeade.descriptionZh: Grineer 全体皆是由"原始基因"的基因库复制生产而来。他们能回收使用复制的器官部位来延长寿命，然而 Grineer 基因物质的恶化程度也会与日俱增。杂乱无章的修补导致众多 Grineer 的外貌产生了诡异的残缺且易受皮肤疾病的影响。在献身种族数十年后，许多 Grineer 精英能负担起将缺陷部位替换成神经机械的费用。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/ArchaicWeapo.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/ArchaicWeapons1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/ArchaicWeapo.secretTransmission__textEn: [9] They prepare me. I am their honored guest today. They dress me in robes of crystal thread. They adorn me in battle medallions. A torn, ugly face looks on. My reflection.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/ArchaicWeapo.secretTransmission__textZh: [9] 他们为我打理，因为今天我是他们的贵宾。他们为我披上水晶丝线的礼服，为我戴上战斗奖章。我的倒影里，见到了一张扭曲丑陋的脸。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/ArchaicWeapo.descriptionEn: The Old War found humanity facing a technologically superior force, and their own weapons were turned against them. Melee and ballistic weapons, inspired by primitive counterparts, became part of the Tenno arsenal to circumvent the Sentient interference of more technologically-involved weaponry.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/ArchaicWeapo.descriptionZh: 远古之战中人类发现敌对力量拥有科技的优势，而人类的武器被用来反噬自己。受到原始武器的启发，近战与弹道武器被纳入了 Tenno 的武器库之中，来避开 Sentient 对高科技武器的干扰作用。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MarsFragment.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Phobos1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MarsFragment.secretTransmission__textEn: [10] Their golden combs snag in my hair. I reach back, parting the strands, and they gasp. Two bone-ivory hooks protrude from the base of my skull: the bone-plugs of me and my best. A warrior's pact.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MarsFragment.secretTransmission__textZh: [10] 金色的梳子缠住了我的头发。我伸手向后，解开了辫子，他们倒吸了一口气。两只乳白色骨钩从我的颅骨底部伸出：这是我骄傲的骨栓，一个战士的契约。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MarsFragment.descriptionEn: A primitive and devout civilization was carved into the dust-filled canyons of Mars. These aging and severely eroded habitations miraculously remain intact, regardless of how much Grineer machinery has been fastened to it. Rusty metal and oil-soaked sand mark the territory of its new proprietors.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MarsFragment.descriptionZh: 在火星上，曾有一支原始且信仰虔诚的文明座落在遍地沙尘的峡谷当中。无论 Grineer 在此设立了多少机械设施，这些老化、饱受侵蚀的前人居所奇迹般地保持了原貌，只是生锈的金属与油腻的沙子标志着这里的新主人。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SentinelsFra.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Sentinels1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SentinelsFra.secretTransmission__textEn: [11] It is my time. I enter the great hall to the sound of foul chimes. Golden eyes greet me, hands stirring in my scent as I pass by. Even in this moment, no happiness. Instead, my heart races with hatred.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SentinelsFra.secretTransmission__textZh: [11] 该我出场了。我步入大厅来到了罪恶的协响之中。金色的眼眸向我致意，我走过时可以嗅到无数只手对我挥动。即使在这个时刻，也没有快乐，我的内心反而充满了仇恨。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SentinelsFra.descriptionEn: On the border of charted space, an enclave of small, strange, seemingly intelligent creatures was discovered by Tenno explorers. They are mechanical entities, almost organic in appearance, with a precarious resemblance to the fearsome Sentients that had decimated human civilization. However, these small creatures showed no signs of aggression, and they immediately began carrying out helpful tasks in peculiar alliance with the Tenno.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SentinelsFra.descriptionZh: Tenno 探索者在星图的边界发现了一小块似是智慧生物的奇怪内飞地。有着机械实体、近似有机的外观，与毁灭了人类文明的 Sentient 有危险的相似处，但是这些小型生物并未显示出侵略迹象，反而立刻与 Tenno 结成奇特的联盟，执行了多项协助工作。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusWeapon.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/PhobosSettlement1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusWeapon.secretTransmission__textEn: [12] I walk through the silky haze of the forbidden palace. I can think of no one being this close to Orokin. Their sweet air soothes me, erodes my purpose. I hold my breath… and remember the dream.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusWeapon.secretTransmission__textZh: [12] 我穿过了禁宫丝滑的迷雾。我想从未有人如此的接近奥罗金。这里香甜的空气令我松懈，侵蚀我的意志。于是我屏住呼吸……别忘了这场梦。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusWeapon.descriptionEn: The Grineer have reclaimed the abandoned dwellings of an ancient society which sprung up around a massive Orokin terra-forming device. Content to make use of the existing structures, Mars’ current occupants have established a base of military operations in one of the few regions that has a habitable climate moderated by Orokin technology.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusWeapon.descriptionZh: Grineer 重启了被古老社会所遗弃的住所，这些住所兴起于一个大型的奥罗金地球化改造装置。满足于利用现有的建筑结构，火星的新占领者在一个由奥罗金科技调节气候的宜居区域建立了军事基地。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/PhobosFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Mars1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/PhobosFragme.secretTransmission__textEn: [13] This dream, endlessly repeated. Exposure-armored, holding my scarlet sword, I stand victorious atop a vast heap of death. A colossal moon made of rib and skull. The gravity-sum of genocides I've made in their name.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/PhobosFragme.secretTransmission__textZh: [13] 这场梦，无尽轮回。我身着护甲，手握猩红的长剑，以胜利者的姿态站立于死亡堆积而成的小山上，这是一个由肋骨和头颅组成的巨型月亮，这是我以他们之名进行的一场种族灭绝。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/PhobosFragme.descriptionEn: Phobos has always been a highly contested area. Skirmishes between the tireless Grineer and Corpus factions occur in orbit and on the Martian moon surface. Unanswered questions about this natural satellite still remain as all research is endlessly delayed by war.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/PhobosFragme.descriptionZh: 火卫一历来是兵家必争之地。Grineer 与 Corpus 在火卫一的轨道和表面展开了无休止的征战。而这颗天然卫星残留着的不解之谜，其研究至今仍被战乱而无限期回柜。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Grineer1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [14] The bones crack under foot. So I sink in the dream, bone sand rushing through the cracks of my visor, filling my helmet, and suffocating me. And I deserve it. The foul chimes snap me back. My wretched knees are bent and penitent against the golden floor.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [14] 脚下的骨头嘎吱作响。于是我深入梦中，碎骨从我面甲的裂缝中涌入，充满了我的头盔，令我窒息。这都是我自作自受。罪恶的协响将我拉回现实。我可鄙的膝盖弯了下去，仿佛悔罪般跪倒在这金色的地面。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerFragm.descriptionEn: The sprawling military ranks of the Grineer empire are formed of rotting hordes of simpleton clones, bent on consuming everything that remains of the Origin System. They live short, violent lives, much of it an inheritance of their genetic stunting by their former Orokin masters.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerFragm.descriptionZh: Grineer 帝国中延绵不绝的军事阶层构成了这群腐朽而低智慧的复制人军队，他们决心将始源星系的残存价值消耗殆尽。由于多数 Grineer 受到过往主人奥罗金基因发展不全遗传的影响，他们的生命周期短且易骤逝。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/PhobosSettle.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusWeapons1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/PhobosSettle.secretTransmission__textEn: [15] A harpish voice sings a song they've prepared in my honor. Its title the same as mine: 'Beast of the Bones'. I feel the crowd pulled inward, enraptured by the brutal verses, the sickening chorus. I will not disappoint them.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/PhobosSettle.secretTransmission__textZh: [15] 一个竖琴般的嗓音唱起了一首他们为我准备的歌，和我的名号一样："狂骨野兽。"我感到人群挤了进来，狂喜于这残暴的歌词和令人作呕的合唱。我会让他们好看。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/PhobosSettle.descriptionEn: Weapons research and manufacturing is a large component of Corpus industry. Their designs are clean and precisely engineered, and they are the largest supplier of energy-based weapons in the Origin System. These cunning profiteers prefer to avoid conflict in times of war, dealing arms indiscriminately to any side that can afford the price.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/PhobosSettle.descriptionZh: 武器研究及生产是 Corpus 工业领域的一大部分。他们的设计十分简洁并且极其精密，同时他们还是始源星系内最大的能量武器供应商。这群狡诈的奸商更愿意在战时躲避直接交火，然后在有利益可乘之际，一视同仁地向任何付得起钱的人贩卖军火。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CeresFragmen.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Ceres1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CeresFragmen.secretTransmission__textEn: [16] The song ends and so he says, "Rise, Ordan Karris". I have never seen an Orokin, close and in the flesh. My battered face flushes at their peerless beauty. How can he be so perfect? A deception? A sense manipulation? He holds the Red Vial in his hand. Impossible.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CeresFragmen.secretTransmission__textZh: [16] 歌声结束了，这时有人说："起立，欢迎奥丹·卡里斯。"我从来没有亲眼见过一个奥罗金人。我残破的脸在他们无与伦比的美丽下无地自容。他为何是如此的完美？是骗术？是感知操纵？他手握红色小瓶。这不可能。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CeresFragmen.descriptionEn: Ceres is the extreme example of the Grineer's utilitarian ignorance of the natural landscape. Their expanding shipyard operations pollute and shroud the planet in smog and industrial waste as they manufacture machines of war. These foundries are scattered across the Origin System, giving them near-limitless reach with their fleets.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CeresFragmen.descriptionZh: 谷神星是 Grineer 对自然景观的功利主义与无知体现的极端案例。当他们生产战争机器时，其不断扩增的造船事业造成了严重污染，使得整座星球笼罩在一片废气之中。这些铸造厂四散于始源星系，使他们的舰队有着近乎无止尽的拓展空间。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerLabou.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GrineerLabour1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerLabou.secretTransmission__textEn: [17] He calls out, "No greater gift, no greater prize, no greater love... we can give you, Ordan, than this." He raises the Red Vial and proclaims… "To be one of us."
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerLabou.secretTransmission__textZh: [17] 他大声呼唤："没有更好的礼物，没有更大的奖励，没有更深的爱……可以给你，奥丹，除了这个。"他举起红色小瓶，宣布道……"除了让你成为我们一员。"
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerLabou.descriptionEn: Strict laws on organic engineering impose severe mental and physical health limitations on the Grineer labour force. Whatever standard human stock they were originally derived from has been lost. Compliant and high-performing variants are often technically augmented to extend their lifespans beyond the few decades they can normally expect in operation.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerLabou.descriptionZh: 生物工程上的严酷律法在 Grineer 劳动力身上强加了心理与生理上的严重缺陷。最初这批劳力是从何而来的已经不为人知。顺从听话而又表现良好的变种往往会通过技术手段强化来延长他们的寿命，活过原本仅仅数十载的预期运行寿命。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/JupiterFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Jupiter1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/JupiterFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [18] What did I expect, Operator? Maybe vast riches or golden statues… or a Solar Rail named in my honor. But not this. I came to murder the gods, not to become one.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/JupiterFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [18] 指挥官，我原本期待的是什么？也许是大把财富或是金色的雕像……又或是一个以我命名的太阳系航道，但不是这个。我是来弑神的，不是成为神。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/JupiterFragm.descriptionEn: It is not impossible to mine a star. Rich with liquid metallic resources, the gas-giant Jupiter challenges harvesters with increased gravity, intense magnetic fields, and extreme temperatures. Only the most tenacious profiteers would dare operate here. Prevailing science of Corpus industry thrives in the clouds of Jupiter’s outer atmosphere.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/JupiterFragm.descriptionZh: 开采一颗星星并非不可能。巨大的气体星球木星有着丰富液态金属资源，其重力、强力磁场和极端温度，都是开采者将会面临到的挑战，只有最坚毅的投机者敢来此进行投资。Corpus 工业的主流科技在木星的外层大气中茁壮成长。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RoboticsFrag.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Robotics1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RoboticsFrag.secretTransmission__textEn: [19] The chamber drones with their silk voices. Joyous words, how honored I must feel. Wrong. Did I want to be an Orokin, undying? No. Their Beast of Bones is haunted by the dream repeated. Why would I want forever?
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RoboticsFrag.secretTransmission__textZh: [19] 大厅里嗡嗡响起了他们丝般的声音，快活的话语，说我该感到多么的荣幸。大错特错。我希望成为一名奥罗金、长生不老吗？不。他们的狂骨野兽被反复的梦境所折磨。我为何想要追求永生？
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RoboticsFrag.descriptionEn: Computing devices, weapons, ship parts and robotics – the Corpus are on the bleeding edge of high-technology development. Precisely machined metals and flexible synthetic composites are signature to the animalistic robots that the Corpus have built as their proxies. Artificial intelligence in these robotics is robust, but intentionally restricted, ensuring a capable but subservient workforce.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RoboticsFrag.descriptionZh: 从电脑设备、武器、船舰组件到机器人－Corpus 总是位于最新技术发展的尖端。柔性的合成复合材料是 Corpus 用以制造类兽形代理机器人的特征。这些代理机器人的人工智慧虽然非常强大，但却被刻意设下限制，为的是确保其服从性及工作能力。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EuropaFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Europa1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EuropaFragme.secretTransmission__textEn: [20] As I am apt to do, I form a plan. Their radiant bodies become targets, their Dax guards… mag-shields. Killing one… well, that's too easy. I want to be remembered. I raise my hands, twisting my fingers through my hair, gripping the bone-plugs in my neck.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EuropaFragme.secretTransmission__textZh: [20] 就和我擅长的那样，我制定了一个计划。他们光辉的身体就是目标，他们的禁卫军……磁力护盾。杀一个……呵，那太简单了。我想要青史留名。我抬起了手，手指伸进头发里，捏住了我脖子上的骨栓。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EuropaFragme.descriptionEn: The icy moon of Jupiter, known as Europa, is home to one of the largest crash sites of the modern war. The scattered remains of a vast Corpus Obelisk litters the snowy landscape while the battle above wages on. On the otherwise lifeless surface, Corpus crew work to recover lost assets, tunneling their way through the glacial interior and restoring any and all salvageable items until financial losses are recouped.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EuropaFragme.descriptionZh: 欧罗巴，木星冰冷的卫星，这里是近代战争最大的战舰坠毁地。Corpus 天碑战舰散落的残骸凌乱地遍布在雪地之上，而天空中的战斗从未停息。在这毫无生机的地表，Corpus 船员努力复原损失了的财产，挖掘隧道至冰川内部，收集任何还能利用的物品，直到经济损失得以挽回为止。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Corpus1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusFragme.secretTransmission__textEn: [21] They called us mercenaries... but for us, profit was a consequence, not a goal. We were warriors above all else. It was the bond, the sisters and brothers, the rituals we valued most. It was belonging. And so I conceived of the bone-plugs.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusFragme.secretTransmission__textZh: [21] 他们叫我们雇佣兵……不过对我们来说报酬只是手段，不是目的。我们是凌驾于众人的战士。我们的目的是情感纽带，兄弟姐妹和我们珍重的礼仪。我们的目的是归属感，因此我构想了骨栓。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusFragme.descriptionEn: Lead by innovatory and elusive industrialists, and claiming to be descendants of Orokin lineage, the Corpus are dedicated to the accumulation of wealth. This elite ruling class operates an insular trade organization using humans and robotics for labour and security, and have been condemned by the Seven as a merchant cult.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusFragme.descriptionZh: 由一群创新且难以捉模的企业家们所领导，他们自认是奥罗金血脉的后裔，并致力于累积财富。这个精英统治阶级利用人类与机器人提供劳力与安全防护，运作着一个独立的贸易组织。这个组织因此被七人众定罪为商业邪教。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EuropaLandsc.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EuropaLandscape1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EuropaLandsc.secretTransmission__textEn: [22] Only my best were so honored: Two jagged bones, harvested from your thigh, cultivated and then driven into the base of the skull, twisted around the superior vein. Future thoughts of surrender were lost. Instead, you would liberate your bone-plugs… fighting with claws in the warmth of your last blood.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EuropaLandsc.secretTransmission__textZh: [22] 只有我最杰出的佣兵才会有这般荣耀：从你们的腿骨上取得两块锯齿型的骨头，经过培育以后，插入他们头骨的底部，缠绕在大动脉边。一旦拔出，你就再也不会想要投降……你会用利爪战斗到最后一滴血。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EuropaLandsc.descriptionEn: Living conditions are harsh on Europa. The surface of Jupiter's moon is flat and desolate, with a horizon of hard compacted snow that appears endless. The jagged forms of a crashed Corpus Obelisk are the only real observable landmarks above ground. Underground are caverns and tunnels of opaque ice, and crystal lakes that may have formed naturally or from the residual heat of the crashsite.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EuropaLandsc.descriptionZh: 欧罗巴的生存条件十分严酷。这颗木星卫星的表面平坦而荒凉，远望地平线，坚硬紧实的积雪仿佛没有尽头。坠毁的 Corpus 天碑战舰以参差不齐的形式成为地面上唯一可见的景观。在地下则是由密不透光的寒冰构成的洞穴与隧道，夹杂其中的水晶湖也许是自然形成或是来自坠毁产生的余热。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/VoidFragment.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Void1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/VoidFragment.secretTransmission__textEn: [23] So I've pulled the plugs… and the Dax see and know. My heart surges but I control it, a racing heart only shortens the fuse. The bone-plugs in hand, I kick from the floor, red ribbons unfurling behind me as I take flight. After this, finally, the dream will end.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/VoidFragment.secretTransmission__textZh: [23] 所以我拔出了骨栓……禁卫军看到后就明白了。我心跳加速，但我控制住了，心跳过快只能过早燃烧殆尽生命。手握骨栓，我纵身跃起，红色的缎带在我身后迎风招展。过了今天，梦就会结束了。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/VoidFragment.descriptionEn: Originally we studied Void occurrences from afar, observing and cataloguing the distribution of galaxies and refining cosmological evolution models. We are in a new age of cosmic exploration. Advancements in space travel partnered with determined curiosity have brought us closer to our object of study, and with it, revelation.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/VoidFragment.descriptionZh: 起初，我等远远地观研虚空的出现，观察并纪录星系的分布，进而完善宇宙演化模型。此时我等正处于宇宙探索的新纪元。星际航行技术的进步，配以坚定的好奇心，令我们与研究对象更近了一步，随之而来的，便是启示。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/OrokinFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Orokin1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/OrokinFragme.secretTransmission__textEn: [24] I glide on red wings. Robes shed, making me an ambiguous target to Dax steel. I let fly my ivory blades, they find new homes in Dax eyes. I land with my red-nakedness, delicate Orokin throats twisting in my calloused hands.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/OrokinFragme.secretTransmission__textZh: [24] 我乘着红色的翅膀滑翔。礼服的残片使我难以被禁卫的武器瞄准。我掷出骨栓作为飞刀，它们不偏不倚地击中了禁卫的眼睛。我赤身着陆，用无情的手扭断了奥罗金人优雅的喉咙。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/OrokinFragme.descriptionEn: The highly revered Orokin civilization built sovereignty on a culture of art, technology and architecture. To prove oneself worthy of elevated social status, one must face Orokin trials in the golden and majestic Halls of Ascension. At one time a utopian society of omniscient leadership, the great Orokin Era ended in a divine realization of their own ignorance.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/OrokinFragme.descriptionZh: 崇高的奥罗金文明立身于艺术、科技和建筑文化，打造了一个主权帝国。如欲证明自身得以匹配更高的社会地位，则必须面对金色宏伟的晋升大厅的奥罗金试炼。这个曾经在全知全能领导下的乌托邦社会，伟大的奥罗金时代最终在由自身的无知引起的神罚中宣告终结。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SaturnFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Saturn1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SaturnFragme.secretTransmission__textEn: [25] Why? Believe me... This was the plan from the beginning. The murder and brutality was all a ploy, all a soul-sacrifice to earn their trust. A genocide path leading to a singular opportunity. An honored mortal called to a forbidden hall, to face the Golden Lords in flesh.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SaturnFragme.secretTransmission__textZh: [25] 为什么？相信我……这是从一开始就计划好的。这场谋杀和暴行都是计谋，都是牺牲自我来博取它们的信任。一场种族灭绝引向了唯一的机会。一个被尊崇的凡人得以被召见至禁宫，去直面黄金之主。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SaturnFragme.descriptionEn: The historically well-travelled merchant shipping lanes of Saturn are now dominated by Grineer blockades. Heavy military influence populates this area where Grineer Commanders believe they have a strategic foothold on travel throughout the System. Under the safeguard of patrolling Galleons, the Grineer ceaselessly train their expanding forces, making the region nigh impossible to overtake.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SaturnFragme.descriptionZh: 土星历史上最常被利用的商业航线，现在已被 Grineer 封锁。整片区域皆被这支大军所影响，Grineer 指挥官相信他们已占据了星系航行的战略要点。在帆船舰队来回巡逻的保护之下，Grineer 不断训练他们的扩张武力，以致在此区域近乎无人可超越其势力。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CitizensFrag.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Citizens1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CitizensFrag.secretTransmission__textEn: [26] Why? Believe me... I was their loyal, murderous dog... until the day that ugly child was brought to me. He was caught spying on us, amplifying our losses. His face burned, he was starved-sick, like a stray. Ugly as I. It struck me. We were all pit dogs, ruining ourselves for the pleasure of the glorious and beautiful.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CitizensFrag.secretTransmission__textZh: [26] 为什么？相信我……我曾是他们忠诚、凶残的猎狗……直到那天一个丑孩子被带到我身边。他被发现暗中侦查我们，扩大了我们的损伤。他的脸被烧焦，人饿得生病，就像一只流浪狗。他和我一样丑，这触动了我。我们都是斗犬而已，为了取悦那些光辉美丽之人，不惜毁了自己。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CitizensFrag.descriptionEn: While the major warring factions combat each other across the Origin System, non-militant organizations and civilian merchants populate the many regional Tenno Relays. Travelling merchant collectors that offer rare goods, mentors that offer training and knowledge, and convictional syndicates that preach their own rituals and doctrine.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CitizensFrag.descriptionZh: 当几个主要的交战派系在始源星系中彼此交火争战之际，非军方组织与民间商人汇集到众多地区性的 Tenno 中继站中。这些移民中有着出售稀世珍宝的旅行贸易收藏家、提供训练与知识的导师们，也有宣扬自己仪式与教义的信仰集团。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/LandingCraft.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/LandingCraft1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/LandingCraft.secretTransmission__textEn: [27] Why? Believe me... I was a prideful beast. Twisted in the mind, howling in the carnage. Then my healer shared a secret, long kept. My blood was in ruin. The Beast of Bones himself would die, not in glory, but in shame. And just like that, my mind twisted a new knot. I would have one last stand, something unforgivable, unforgettable.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/LandingCraft.secretTransmission__textZh: [27] 为什么？相信我……我本是一只高傲的野兽。被扭曲了心智，只会在厮杀中嚎叫。接着我的治愈师透露了一个秘密，一个隐藏很久的秘密：我的血不行了。即使狂骨野兽也会死，不会死于荣耀，而是死于羞辱。正因如此，我的心智又扭出了一个新的结。我可以血战到底，这不可饶恕，不可忘却。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/LandingCraft.descriptionEn: Warframe operative insertion craft come in many designs, but they are all commonly classified as short-range stealth aircraft. Fuselage insertion stingers will torpedo the Warframe into the hull of the target undetected, and the landing craft will re-position at the extraction point. Between engagements, the landing craft is latched to its sister component, an Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/LandingCraft.descriptionZh: Warframe 特工的渗透飞行器有很多种设计，不过大多属于短距离隐身飞船。船体入侵器会将 Warframe 神不知鬼不觉地投射到目标船体内，随后登陆艇会移动至撤离点。在作战任务之间，登陆艇与它的姐妹舰——轨道飞行器连接。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/UranusFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Uranus1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/UranusFragme.secretTransmission__textEn: [28] Why? I don't know. Questions change the answers. Answers depend on who asks. Truth leads to pain. Ignorance brings relief. The plugs are gone, and so I bled my last… into a heap of ruin. In an instant, naked and bare-knuckled, I have killed immortals.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/UranusFragme.secretTransmission__textZh: [28] 为什么？我不知道。问题会改变回答，而回答取决于提问的人。真相通向痛苦，无知带来慰藉。骨栓已经没了，我也流尽了最后一滴血……坠入一堆废墟。在这一瞬之间，赤手空拳，我杀死了永生者。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/UranusFragme.descriptionEn: Submerged deep below Uranus' oceanic surface, and hidden from prying eyes, is a research facility for cloning and reproduction. Water pressure at these extreme depths put massive strain on the glass and steel structures housing these operations, but as freshly sprung leaks remind of the impending crushing force surrounding them, the Grineer forge ahead with their experiments.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/UranusFragme.descriptionZh: 潜藏于天王星海境深处、避过众多猎食者眼线的是专职基因复制与繁殖的研究设施。位于极深海底，容纳着这些工程的钢铁与玻璃建筑承载着奇大水压，但就在新增的绽裂提醒着他们迫在眉睫的碾压巨力之时，Grineer 潜心投入在他们的研究之中、突飞猛进。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/OrbiterFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Orbiter1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/OrbiterFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [29] I stare, drained of blood, of life, at those that remain. But I find no horror on their faces. Why? I let out a cruel howl and they… laugh? Is this a dying hallucination? The sound of applause grows among them. I have killed the unkillable and they are… delighted.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/OrbiterFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [29] 我凝视着这些失去生命的尸体，但我在他们脸上看不到恐惧。为什么？我发出残暴的一吼，而他们……却笑了？只是将死的幻觉吗？掌声在他们身边响起。我杀死了不死之人，而他们却……感到高兴。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/OrbiterFragm.descriptionEn: Tenno operatives are a highly mobile strike force, and their property must be equally itinerant. Smaller landing crafts dock with the larger Orbiter shuttle where transient warriors can house their arsenal, foundry, and research systems.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/OrbiterFragm.descriptionZh: Tenno 操控者们是一股高机动性武力，他们的根据地势必居无定所。小型登陆艇停靠在更大的轨道飞行器上，在那里这群流浪战士安置了他们的军械库、铸造场与研究系统。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/NeptuneFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Neptune1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/NeptuneFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [30] The applause peaks and fades. I feel a sense of shame but the end upon me. Ballas is above me, Executor of the Seven, smiling. He says, "How simple and pure you are, you idiot beast. We have died countless times! Yet remain eternal!" I close my eyes to die just once.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/NeptuneFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [30] 掌声迭起，又淡去。我感到羞辱，但我行将就木。Ballas ，七人众的执行官，他在那上面，笑着看我。"你真纯真啊，你这个白痴野兽。我们已经死了无数次了！却依然保有永生！"我闭上双眸，准备迎接这最后的死亡。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/NeptuneFragm.descriptionEn: The Corpus have perfected automated manufacturing and continue to demonstrate maximum efficiency producing the robotic proxies they build to serve them. Immaculate production lines and flawless technical engineering ensure that the production of robotics and intelligent, synthetic machines continues in perpetuity.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/NeptuneFragm.descriptionZh: Corpus 拥有完美的自动化生产，并持续展现出制造自用代理机器的极致效率。洁净的生产线和完善的工程技术保证了机器人与智能综合机械的生产可以永续进行。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/LotusFragmen.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Lotus1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/LotusFragmen.secretTransmission__textEn: [31] And so the dream returns… one last repetition. My corpse moon, my scarlet sword, my cracked visor. "Drink!", says Ballas. So I draw on the Red Vial, a vague metallic taste. This dream isn't mine. He says, "You rejected our gift, bathing in our death. Your punishment is… eternal life!" He laughs.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/LotusFragmen.secretTransmission__textZh: [31] 梦再一次地重复了……这是最后一次。那布满尸体的月亮表面，那猩红的长剑，那破烂不堪的面甲。"喝吧！" Ballas 说道。因此我拿过红瓶尝了一口，那是一股说不清的金属味。这梦不是我的。他又说，"你拒绝了我们的赏赐，又想要杀死我们。因此你的惩戒将会是……永生！"他放声大笑。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/LotusFragmen.descriptionEn: Guiding light to the newly-awakened Tenno, the Lotus is a mysterious companion and mentor who works from an unknown remote location. Her past is rich with storied history, and her knowledge of the known universe, past and present, rivals even the most studious Cephalon intelligence. Her reach is far, her allies are many, but her ultimate intentions are of dubious propriety.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/LotusFragmen.descriptionZh: 总是在远方未知之处的 Lotus 是刚醒 Tenno 的引导之光，是 Tenno 的神秘伙伴与指引者。她的过去是充满传奇的历史，而她对过去与当下的宇宙知识，可以匹敌最勤学的中枢智能。她的影响力十分广泛、盟友众多，但她的最终意图仍令人存疑。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MoonFragment.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Moon1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MoonFragment.secretTransmission__textEn: [32] I am weightless. Years pass. I am a sightless, limbless phantom. Or is it seconds? Suddenly I feel a million pins, an ant horde, jittering across my body. I want to laugh and scream. When they reach my face, they burrow inside my mouth, hungry for the fruit in my skull.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MoonFragment.secretTransmission__textZh: [32] 我仿佛是一个无重量的虚体。随着时光飞逝，我变成了一个无知无觉的幽魂。或者说，只过了短短的几秒钟？突然间，我感到无穷的针刺，蚁群爬过，颤抖地穿过我的身体。我想大笑，我想尖叫！涌上我的脸后，我能感觉到它们强钻进我的嘴，在我的头骨中寻找食物。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MoonFragment.descriptionEn: Gold rings circle and encapsulate the desolate moonscape – lavish architecture signifying the Orokin mastery over all things natural and technological during their reign. The opalescent halls stitching together what the enemy destroyed have been vacated since that era came to an end.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MoonFragment.descriptionZh: 金色的圆环围绕着荒凉的月球表面－奢华的建筑象征着奥罗金在统治期间内掌控了自然、技术与一切万物。自从奥罗金时代结束以后，那些连接着被摧毁区域的乳白色大厅已经空无一人。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/WarframesFra.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Warframes2
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/WarframesFra.secretTransmission__textEn: [33] I see my reflection, brutal and ugly. It cracks, shatters. The fragments loose in the frame, pieces tumbling away into black void. Gone but not lost. Ballas says, "You are Cephalon Ordis." My hating, murderous shards tremble and plummet. I feel cool and bright and happy.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/WarframesFra.secretTransmission__textZh: [33] 我看到了我的倒影，野蛮又丑陋。原有的肢体开始破裂，粉碎。开始消散在黑色的虚无当中。但就是没有消失。Balls 说，"你就是中枢 Ordis。"。我的憎恨，我的杀意，都分崩离析了。我感到爽朗，光明，也很开心。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/WarframesFra.descriptionEn: The true nature of the Warframes and their Tenno connection is a secret lost to the Old War. Together, they represent our best hope in turning the tide of the machine war. Warframes are unique from Dax and other Infantry, deploying dangerous and esoteric Void energy and equipped with often mundane physical weapons – this is key to fighting an enemy that had turned our technology against us.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/WarframesFra.descriptionZh: 战甲的真实本质以及其与 Tenno 的关联，皆是在远古之战中所遗忘的秘密。两者合二为一，代表着在这机械战争中力挽狂澜的最大希望。战甲独特而有別于禁卫以及其他战旅，搭载着致命而奥妙的虚空能量，并且大多装配着平凡的物理武器─这是反击那些让我们的科技倒戈的敌人的关键。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/PlutoFragmen.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Pluto1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/PlutoFragmen.secretTransmission__textEn: [34] So you see, Operator. No Orokin would permit a thinking machine. Such things almost destroyed them! No. Cephalons were alive once. And now they are immortal phantom minds, imprisoned to serve. Ill will and longing memories fragmented and erased. Only the bits they need remaining.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/PlutoFragmen.secretTransmission__textZh: [34] 所以指挥官，你看到了吗？奥罗金不会允许有那么一个会思考的机器。这样的东西差点就把他们灭种了！不，中枢曾经活着。现在他们那些不灭的幻影意识，都被奴役起来为他们服务。不正的念头和热烈的记忆都会被碾碎，根除，只留下那些他们需要的。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/PlutoFragmen.descriptionEn: Pluto is small and cold, and organic tissue does not fare well in its extreme climate. But the merchant spacemen always seek opportunity for profit in regions where others dare not travel. Robotic proxies act as security in the largely un-manned manufacturing facilities that operate in the area.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/PlutoFragmen.descriptionZh: 冥王星是气候寒冷的小型星球，有机组织在此难以生长。但是太空商人总是会在其他人不敢去的地方寻觅商机。代理机器人会在此地运作中的大型无人生产设施里担任安保要务。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/InfestedFrag.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Infested1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/InfestedFrag.secretTransmission__textEn: [35] Ballas says, "You are the Controller, Ordis." And suddenly I have a body. I gasp with new lungs that clean old air. I swallow and my throat fills with cool, bright water. I look, and find myself in a great, black ocean. My limbs are made of iron and fire. I take flight among the stars and find I am… happy.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/InfestedFrag.secretTransmission__textZh: [35] Ballas又说，"现在这个由你掌控， Orids。"。刹那间我就有了身体。我吸了一口气，新的肺净化了浑浊的空气。我咽了一口水，喉咙里充满了凉爽又透彻的水。我放眼望去，看到自己处在一个巨大的黑色海洋里。我的肢体由铁与火打造出来。我能在星空自由翱翔，最重要的是……我感到十分快乐！
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/InfestedFrag.descriptionEn: Infestation of a living natural organism and the transformation of its molecular structure happens much more rapidly than with large synthetic ships or machinery. Infested nanites quickly break down organic tissue and begin to evolve the existing specimen into a new organism with characteristics and functions ideal for survival and self-defense. In many cases, visible traces of the victim's original form are still visible in the new mutated form – a stark and horrifying memorial.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/InfestedFrag.descriptionZh: 感染者是活生生的自然有机体，在与大型综合船只或机械结合时，其分子结构的改变会发生更加快速。Infested 纳米机器能迅速分解有机组织，再将现有的样本发展成特征与机能为最适合生存与自我防卫的新有机体。在多数情况下，被害者原有的形态变异后还能被辨认出来——聊以作为一个凄凉恐怖的纪念。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/OrokinDereli.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/OrokinDerelict1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/OrokinDereli.secretTransmission__textEn: [36] He says, "This is your Operator, who you love." And I see the metal gleam of their armor, the flawless power of their frame. Through the glass I see a roaring, radiant fire for their heart. He says, "It must never go out." It was the first time I ever felt… love.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/OrokinDereli.secretTransmission__textZh: [36] 他说，"这是你的指挥官，你热爱的人。"然后我就看到了，那有着金属光泽的护甲，有着完美无瑕的能力的战甲。透过这层无机质玻璃，我能看到他内心一团咆哮而光芒四射的火焰。他还补充，"那东西永远不能出去。"这就是我初次感受到的……这份「感情」。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/OrokinDereli.descriptionEn: Even the most culturally and technologically advanced civilization in history could not contain the menace of the Infestation. After an unknown cataclysmic event propelled them from the Void, Orokin vessels were left adrift, becoming uninhabited and overgrown. The tireless force of probing infested tendrils penetrate and dislodge the once majestic and opulent halls of these Orokin vessels.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/OrokinDereli.descriptionZh: 即便是在过去历史中最具文化及先进科技的文明，也无法控制感染者造成的危害。在不明的灾难事件发生后，奥罗金退出了虚空，空无一人的船只便被遗留在虚空中任其漂流。而感染者不断滋生的探测卷须贯穿并肢解了一座座奥罗金飞船中曾经辉煌繁华的大厅。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/TheCollapseF.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/TheCollapse1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/TheCollapseF.secretTransmission__textEn: [37] He says, "This is your sentence, Karris." And I am confused. Who? "Ah... good," he answers. He is testing me. For what? To see if all the right pieces fell from the mirror? What mirror? I try to remember some dream, but it's only smoke.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/TheCollapseF.secretTransmission__textZh: [37] 他说，"这是对你的处决决定，卡里斯。"我顿时感受到困惑。那是谁？"嗯……可以。"他那么回答。原来他在测试我。为什么呢？想知道是不是所有的镜面都已经破碎？镜面又是什么？我尝试去回忆一个梦，但那只是如薄烟般的片段而已。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/TheCollapseF.descriptionEn: On the heels of the Tenno's victory against the Sentients, the end of the Old War, the golden structures of Orokin civilization collapsed. The absolute cause of this ruination is unknown, but speculation has pointed to natural disaster, political uprising and universal warfare as potential agents of cataclysm. Archived details for this event have never been recovered.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/TheCollapseF.descriptionZh: 随着 Tenno 对抗 Sentient 的胜利，即远古之战的终结，奥罗金文明的完美金色架构崩塌了。毁灭的主要的原因仍然不明确，但是猜测指出，自然灾害、政治暴乱和宇宙间的战争是造成灾难的潜在因素。这次事件的文献细节从未被恢复过。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/LephantisFra.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Lephantis1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/LephantisFra.secretTransmission__textEn: [38] You held a scarlet blade, Operator, and I wanted to laugh. I am your loving dog, your doctor, your wet nurse. I lost all the pieces, but… the cycle, missions, wars, bone… It began to feel familiar. I became aware of my amnesia.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/LephantisFra.secretTransmission__textZh: [38] 指挥官，在你持起那猩红剑刃那刻，我想开怀大笑。我是你可爱的宠物狗，你的私人医生，你那敬爱的乳母。虽然我几乎忘光了所有……但那些周而复始的东西，那些任务，那些战役，还有那些骨头……我却开始觉得熟悉了。我觉得，我开始意识到自己的失忆了。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/LephantisFra.descriptionEn: Functioning agents of the Infestation appear in a variety of horrific forms. While some infested organisms take the relative shape and physical properties of a newly acquired host, older entities have taken unique and transformative shapes of their own, adapting to their environment over time, and absorbing new victims to feed their evolution.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/LephantisFra.descriptionZh: 可活动的感染者有着各种可怖的形态。尽管一些被感染生物的形状和物理性质与新捕获的宿主大体相同，较老的个体则已经变化成了自己独有的形状，以逐渐适应环境并吸收新的被害者来促成进化。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/ErisFragment.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Eris1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/ErisFragment.secretTransmission__textEn: [39] With each brutality of the Operator, I began to see the bottom of that pit. Faint shimmers in the depths below me. In secret, I searched for those forbidden memories, for mere seconds, and never in the same place… for I am Orokin made, with a spy inside.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/ErisFragment.secretTransmission__textZh: [39] 每次指挥官使用暴力，我就越接近心坑的深处。它在我内心深处微闪着。我曾偷偷地调查过那些被封印的记忆，虽然每次只有短短的几秒，而且还在不同地方……我想奥罗金制造我的时候，天生就是一个间谍。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/ErisFragment.descriptionEn: There are no longer any active military or research campaigns in the Eris region – it is overrun. Long evacuated Corpus and Grineer vessels drift aimlessly in orbit, slowly being devoured by the techno-organic parasite known as the "Infestation". What remains is a twisted graveyard of partially-digested ships that are disfigured versions of their original forms… Abandoned, but not unoccupied.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/ErisFragment.descriptionZh: 在阋神星上没有任何战事或研究活动－此处已被彻底蹂躏。早已撤离的 Corpus 和 Grineer 舰船在阋神星轨道上漫无目的地漂流着，逐渐被以生物机械寄生虫而著称的"感染者"所吞噬。唯一剩下的只有被消化到一半、偏离原始外型的船舰……这里是被世人所遗弃，但却非空无一物的扭曲坟场。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/WarframesFra.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Warframes1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/WarframesFra.secretTransmission__textEn: [40] But then your long sleep came, and I waited. I was happy to wait. Vines spidered green and trees blistered from the earth… but I waited. I felt the Orokin recede, their mind-spy blind. So I went into the pit and found him, me, The Beast of Bones.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/WarframesFra.secretTransmission__textZh: [40] 但当你进入长期的沉睡后，我就在等待了。我本来很开心能那么做。当地球表面上爬满了绿色的藤蔓和树木……但是我仍在等待。我觉得奥罗金已经消亡了，他们不再窥伺我的心。因此我进入了心坑并发现了他，哦不，我自身另一面，狂骨野兽。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/WarframesFra.descriptionEn: A mysterious weaponized armor controlled solely by the Tenno. Through the Warframe, Tenno can cheat death, channel the forbidden Void energies and face scores of enemies without fatigue. Due to apparent resistances of their Bio-Metal exoskeletons, Warframes can be safely deployed to Infestation Outbreaks, should they occur. In-depth information of the Warframe mandate is forbidden to all but the Seven.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/WarframesFra.descriptionZh: 一具神秘、武装化的盔甲，由 Tenno 单独控制。通过战甲，Tenno 得以欺骗死亡，导引那禁忌的虚空能量，同时对抗成群的敌人而不见疲倦。由于他们生化金属外骨骼的各种对外抗击能力，当需要时，战甲得以安全地投入对抗的感染者爆发。关于战甲授权的深入信息除了七人众之外皆禁止触及。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/InfestationF.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Infestation1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/InfestationF.secretTransmission__textEn: [41] This is how my happiness was ruined, Operator. Why did I do it? I was free of the dream, but now it had returned. It was angry. So I conceived of a simple plan: self-destruction, of course. But when the countdown reached mere milliseconds, I thought of you…
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/InfestationF.secretTransmission__textZh: [41] 指挥官，这就是为什么我的快乐已经湮灭了。我到底为什么那么做呢？我曾经已经摆脱了这噩梦，但又回来了。是因为愤怒。所以我构想出了一个简单的计划：自毁，确实够简单吧？但是当倒数进行至最后的那几毫秒的时候，我还是想到了你……
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/InfestationF.descriptionEn: The Infestation spreads across the Origin System – a techno-organic parasite that attaches itself to natural and synthetic forms, slowly digesting the host subject and transforming it on a molecular level. Organic materials morph into new homogeneous organisms while harder, inorganic materials, like metals, will change structurally into a pseudo-organic substance that holds the characteristics of its previous forms.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/InfestationF.descriptionZh: 这群肆虐了整座始源星系的感染者是一种生物科技的寄生体，它们将自己寄生在天然和人工合成物上，以融合的形式缓慢消化宿主，在分子级别上转化宿主。被寄生者体内的有机物质会因此异变为同质有机体，接着，无机物质将会改变结构，成为保有过去宿主特征的伪有机物。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SednaFragmen.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/Sedna1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SednaFragmen.secretTransmission__textEn: [42] I was going to wait for you, forever. And should you return, I would not want you to know that angry part of me. I needed to hide the Beast of Bones from you, Operator. I began to peel the shards, hiding them in the other bits of memory.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SednaFragmen.secretTransmission__textZh: [42] 我本来是要一直等你的，永远等你。当你归来之际，我不会让你看到我愤怒的一面的。指挥官，我需要藏起我狂骨野兽的那面。现在我已经开始将这部分粉碎，把它们永藏至其他的记忆单元里。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SednaFragmen.descriptionEn: If there are new discoveries to make or ancient tools of war yet to be excavated, the Grineer want to be there first — at the frontier of space exploration. Always seeking the upper-hand against their foes, they have numerous deployments that border the known reaches of our Origin System, poised to enter brave new territory and unexplored space on command.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SednaFragmen.descriptionZh: 若在太空探索的边境之中，还有哪里能有新的发现或挖出古老的战争工具 — Grineer 绝对会第一个抵达。Grineer 总是在寻找优势攻击敌人，在我们所知的始源星系边缘，他们部署了无数的军队准备踏上新的领地，听从命令探索未知的太空。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerTechn.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GrineerTechnology1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerTechn.secretTransmission__textEn: [43] I was once the ugly Beast of Bones. I want to laugh. I want to scream. What is happening, Operator? Your faint heart is growing bright… you will awake at any moment. Well, I can't let you see me like this. Angry. I imagine myself hurting you and that does it. The pain of it cracks me open again. I watch tiny glittering fragments fall into the pit. I am happy again.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerTechn.secretTransmission__textZh: [43] 我曾经是丑恶的狂骨野兽。我想要大笑，我想要尖叫。指挥官，怎么了？你虚弱的心正渐渐明亮……你随时都会醒来。呼，我不能让你见到我的这一面。我心怀怨怒。我简直会伤害到你，我真的受够了。这痛苦再次令我分崩离析，我看到闪闪发亮的记忆碎片坠入心坑。于是，我又重获了快乐。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerTechn.descriptionEn: Unlike the Corpus, the Grineer are not celebrated for their ingenuity and craftsmanship. Their notoriety is steeped in violence and military proficiency. However, the Grineer have proven quite inventive and capable of developing their own technologies throughout history. Hiding beneath scrap metal plates, fading paint, and recycled components are qualified devices used for research, manufacturing, and warfare.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerTechn.descriptionZh: 与 Corpus 不同，Grineer 并不以创新和技艺而闻名。他们的在暴力和军事能力上臭名昭著。不过纵观历史 Grineer 还是体现出了一定的创造与科技发展能力。隐藏在废金属板、暗淡的涂装和回收利用的组件之下，是用来研究、制造和作战的合格设备。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedReliefAName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textEn:
Day after day we toiled, my father, my brother Cladius, pulling grains for the Orokin takers in the city, as our kind had done for generations. We were young but the work made us old. Our backs ached, our hands bled, the sun tortured our skin. In the worst times, it felt as though death would claim us before the day was through. It was on one such afternoon that I was fated to first hear that glorious sound. A whisper I strained to hear. In a tongue not of man, but of something… else. Something... grander. A language I understood instinctively. The language of Desire. It said:

"Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms."
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textZh:
我的父亲，我的弟弟克拉迪乌斯，日复一日地工作着，我们世世代代都是为城里的奥罗金收割者们收取庄稼的。尽管我们还年轻，但工作使我们日渐沧桑。我们的背部酸痛，双手流血，太阳炙烤我们的皮肤。在最艰难的时期，似乎只有死亡才能把我们在日子过去前解放出来。正是在这样一个下午，如命中注定般地，我首次听到了一个充满荣耀的声音。那是一道让我竖起耳朵倾听的耳语。这道声音并不是人类的语言，而是……另一种……更高级的语言。这是一种我可以本能地理解的语言。也就是欲望的语言。它说：
 
"不要惧怕贫穷。贫穷是能激起甜美欲望的痛苦土壤。"

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedReliefBName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textEn:
The more we toiled the more impatient I grew. A fire raged inside me. I wanted more. I deserved more.

But how? The whisper washed over me, louder now than before:

"Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward."

And so, with only the whisper to guide me, I straightened my back, wiped the dirt from my hands, and left.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textZh:
我们付出的劳动越多，我就越没有耐心。我的内心熊熊燃烧。我想要更多。我应该得到更多。

但要怎么做？这道耳语充斥着我，声音比以前更大了：

"财富不会眷顾懒惰的人。停滞等于死亡。要不断前行。"

因此，仅靠这道耳语引导我，我挺直了腰板，擦去手上的污垢，然后就走了。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedReliefCName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textEn:
The city. Those towers. I was struck with awe. What glorious totems of greed these Orokin had built. Built on. Our. Backs. Their wealth was my wealth. I was starved, while our masters were fat. and full. and warm. They flaunted their wealth, left it sitting there for the taking: priceless gemstones decorating the tower gates. I was afraid, but the whisper gave me courage.

"Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire."

So, that is what I did.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textZh:
这个城市。那些高塔。我感到敬畏。这些奥罗金建造了多么辉煌的贪婪图腾。建造在、我、们、的、背、上。他们的财富也就是我的财富。我快饿死了，而我们的主人又胖、又饱、又暖和。他们炫耀自己的财富，把财富留在那里任由拿取：无价的宝石装饰在塔门上。我很害怕，但是这道耳语给了我勇气。

"嫉妒吧。觊觎吧。然后拿走你想要的东西。"

所以，我就那么做了。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.descriptionEn:

"嫉妒吧。觊觎吧。然后拿走你想要的东西。"

所以，我就那么做了。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedReliefDName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textEn:
I was brash and bold. I struck at midday. I cried, "I take what I am owed!" as I ripped jewels from their tower gates and ran.

I did not get far.

For my blasphemy they dragged me to the tower square, throwing me to the ground in front of the sneering crowd of Orokin servants that mingled there.

The guards held aloft my satchel, containing the proof of my crime. I grasped at it, determined to reclaim what was mine. He snatched my arm, held me high and... with a dash of his plasma dagger... severed my left hand. The crowd jeered. Yet, I felt no pain, only clarity, for the whisper was with me again. It said:

"Deception is the sword of wisdom. Be wise."

They took my hand that day, but they did not take what I had earned.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textZh:
那时的我，正值血气方刚。我在正午时分开始了行动，叫喊着："我要拿回你们亏欠我的东西！"之后，我扣下了高塔大门上的宝石，转身就跑。

我并没有跑很远。

因为我的亵渎行为，他们把我拖到高塔广场，把我扔在地上，扔在嘲讽的人群面前，那里都是来往的奥罗金仆人们。

守卫高高举起我的背包，里面有着我犯罪的证据。我抓住了它，想要夺回属于我的东西。他抓起我的手臂，把我高高举起，然后……一把等离子匕首刺了进来……切断了我的左手。人群仍在哄笑。但是，我没有感觉到痛楚，只有清醒，因为耳语再次在我耳边说道：

"欺骗是智慧之剑。学聪明点。"

那一天，他们夺走了我的手，但他们并没有夺去我挣来的东西。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedReliefEName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textEn:
I crawled back to the fields, where I collapsed before my father and my brother. I was so near death they read my Nava rites. My brother Cladius bemoaned me as a fool. How could I have abandoned them? Guilt washed over me. I asked the whisper, was he right? And the whisper replied:

"Beware the idle man who would lull you back to idleness."

Hearing this, I felt the life force stream back into me.
I sat up. They protested. I stood and they tried to pull me down. I was too strong. There was now a fire in my chest that would not be denied.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textZh:
我爬回了田里，在父亲和弟弟面前倒下了。我当时只剩一口气了，他们为我念了我的临终祷告。我的弟弟克拉迪乌斯哀叹我是个傻子。我怎么能抛弃他们呢？罪恶感笼罩着我。我问那道耳语，他说得对吗？耳语的回答是：

"当心那个懒惰的人，他会麻痹你，让你变得像以前一样懒惰。"

听到这句话，我感觉生命之力重新流向了我。
我一下子坐了起来。他们却不让我起来。随后我站了起来，而他们又试图拉我躺下。我当时充满了力量。我的胸膛燃起了熊熊烈火，这团火不容否认。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedReliefFName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textEn:
Moving swiftly from sick-bed to field, I fell to my knees beneath that relentless sun, my chest afire. As it moved to my throat, robbing me of breath, certain death had finally found me, I made one last heave.

I spat it out: a molten red gemstone of the purest, clearest rubedo.

Swallowing that stone would have killed a man of weaker will, but not a man sustained by the power of Desire.

It was worth more than my family had made in ten generations. It would fetch enough to feed us all for a lifetime. As I stared into its brilliant facets, a familiar voice rushed through me.

"Contentment is idleness. Desire inspires action. Nurture all desires."

And so, with my brother and father pleading for my return. I once again left for the city.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textZh:
我从病床上疾奔回了田里，我在毒辣的太阳下屈膝，我的胸腔在燃烧。最终死神还是找到了我，它正抵着我的喉咙，使我喘不过气来，我挣扎着吐出了最后一丝生气。

然后我把它吐了出来：一颗炙热的红宝石，也就是最纯净、最清晰的红化结晶。

吞下那颗石头可能会杀死意志薄弱的人，但杀不死一个被欲望之力驱使的人。

这比我们家族累积十代的财产都要值钱。它足以养活我们一辈子。当我凝视这它璀璨的表面，一道熟悉的声音传来。

"知足就意味着懒惰。欲望会激发实际行动。滋养所有的欲望。"

于是，伴随着我弟弟和父亲恳求我"回家吧"的声音。我再次离开前往了城里。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedReliefGName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textEn:
In desire I was wealthy, but in strategy I was empty-handed. I listened for the whisper, it said:

"Money begets money."

With my jewel as collateral, I secured a loan. And with that sum, I gave my own loans. To poor men, like me, who desired more. With each loan, I dispensed truths I had learned from the whisper. Those men went out into the world, and they too made loans, and their money too begat money. Word spread fast. Men flocked to hear me. I told them of the evils of contentment and idleness. I taught them the gift of Desire.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textZh:
在欲望中我很富有，但在策略上我两手空空。我听着耳语，它说：

"钱生钱。"

我以宝石为抵押，获得了一笔贷款。然后用这笔钱贷给像我一样渴望更多的穷人。每次借贷，我都会告诉他们我从耳语中学到的真理。那些人去到外面的世界，也放贷，也以钱生钱。消息散布得很快。人们蜂拥而至来听我说话。我告诉他们知足和懒惰的弊害。我教授他们何谓欲望的馈赠。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textEn:
In time my money multiplied into multitudes. With this wealth, I made my body whole again.

Then news came: father had collapsed in the field. I rushed back to my family's humble farm to be by his side, but his death was sudden. Cladius mourned. But I was committed to ending the brutal labor my family and people had endured for generations. The whisper approved, it said:

"Charity is power. More charity is more power."
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textZh:
随着时间的推移，我的财富成倍积聚。通过这些财富，我又恢复为了完整之躯。

随后，我收到了父亲倒在田里的噩耗。我冲回家里的简陋农场，陪在他身边，然而他还是猝然离世了。克拉迪乌斯哀悼着他。但我决心要结束我们家世世代代忍受的残酷苦活。耳语声认同道：

"给予是力量。更多的给予就是更大的力量。"

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedReliefIName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textEn:
Cladius begged me to stop my mega-dozers, "If you build a city on these fields what will we eat?" To which I replied, "Just as I consumed the gemstone that fed my fortune, our people will eat the wealth I have bestowed upon them."

"What of our home?" he cried, "Our traditions?" I pondered this until the whisper gave me the words:

"Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man."
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textZh:
克拉迪乌斯恳求我停下巨型推土机的运行，"如果你在这些土地上建造城市，那我们吃什么？"我回答说："就像我花出的宝石增加了我的财富，我们的人民会在我赋予他们的财富上得到饱足。"

"那我们的家呢？"他喊道："我们的传统呢？"我陷入沉思，直到耳语告诉我这句话：

"避免多愁善感。这是制约懒惰之人的弱点。"

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textEn:
I believe my father would have smiled with pride as I smashed our family home into the dirt. It saddens me that Father did not live to see the glory of Corposium, the city I erected upon our meager land. Men of Desire will always be outnumbered by idle men, men of fear.  But small men can never hold back men of Strength, and Desire.

"Fulfill desire and others will follow."
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textZh:
当我们家被我推倒化为一片废墟时，我相信我父亲会面带自豪的微笑。令我感到难过的是，父亲没有活着看到我让 Corposium 之城从荒芜之地拔地而起的荣耀。充满欲望的人总是远少于懒惰，恐惧的人。但是，对于有权势和欲望的人，庸人永远不会成为他们的绊脚石。

"当你能满足欲望，其他人也将蜂拥追随。"

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedReliefKName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textEn:
My gift to the future is an idea; an idea that wealth need not settle as a crust upon the upper echelons of the populace. No. Any poor grain farmer can, should he feed his Desire and apply his wisdom, take fortune for himself. The more the better. And, when men of fortune come together under great leadership, their potential is exponential.

Just as my money replaced what the Orokin took from me and made my body whole again, our collective Desire will create a new body. A body forged of fortune and unencumbered by idleness or sentimentality.

"Ours is the grasping golden hand. We are desire. We are Corpus."
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/CorpusRelief.secretTransmission__textZh:
作为给予未来的礼物，我有一个构想；一个想法，即不应只有凌驾于人民的上层阶级才能积累财富。不。任何贫穷的耕作农民都可以为自己积累财富，只要他能满足自己的欲望并运用他的智慧。财富越多就越好。而且，如果拥有财富的人联合起来并受到强有力的领导，他们的潜力便会成倍增长。

正如我的钱弥补了奥罗金从我这夺走的东西，并使我的躯体再次变得完整一样，我们的集体欲望将创造一具新的躯体。一具由财富铸造的躯体，并且不受懒惰和情感的制约。

"我们的手是紧抓黄金的手。我们是欲望的化身。我们是 Corpus。"
