/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: Things have never been this bad. The currents are strengthening in that rank cesspool of a Board. Nef Anyo has consolidated his power on Venus, winning Frohd Bek's favor. All eyes are turning toward their new darling. And the currents… the currents would drag me down. I am underestimated. I am unseen. I must turn that to my advantage.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 情况从未如此严峻过。董事会那个污水坑让暗流变得更加汹涌了。奈富·安尤已经巩固了他在金星上的力量，赢得了 Frohd Bek 的青睐。所有人都把目光转向他们的新欢。而那些暗流……会让我万劫不复。我被低估了，被忽视了。我必须利用这一点。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GasCityFragmentB
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: I seek advantage and advantage appears! I'd long thought that old fool Regus dead, but here is - rich and gullible as ever! With an offer of shared wealth. Says he has tech like I've never seen! Old War tech. And he wants an investor. Oh, I'll invest all right…
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 我寻求机遇，机遇就送上门来了！我一直以为那个老傻瓜 Regus 已经死了，可瞧瞧现在——他跟以前一样有钱又容易上当受骗！他提供了一个能一起牟利的途径。他说他有我从未见过的技术！远古之战的技术，而且他想要一个投资人。哦，我会投资的……

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GasCityFragmentC
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: This is about more than investment. Regus surprises me. How a man of his limited intellect came by such wonders is…. But… forget that. What he has is… exceptionally viable. Where did he find this technology? It stinks of Tau, but the advantages to be had in the exploitation of it… the things I could create… the profits I could accrue… the Board will never dare underestimate me again!
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 这不仅仅是投资的问题。Regus 让我感到震惊。一个像他这样脑子不灵光的人是如何取得这样的奇迹的……但是……算了。他现在所拥有的技术……尽管诡异，但却可行。他是在哪里找到了这项技术？它散发着来自 Tau 星系的恶臭，但只要合理利用，它就能让我取得优势……想想那些我能借此创造出来的东西……我能获得的利润……董事会再也不敢低估我了！

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GasCityFragmentD
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: Regus' price was high, but I dangled the Board's most enticing intellectual property, SysComm, to seal the deal.  Then I placed a contract, loaded with escape clauses and loopholes, in that slack, idiot's fingers… And he signed! The fool signed without even reading it! Any partner that thick is a liability. A liability soon to be nullified.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: Regus 的要价很高，但是我拿出了董事会最诱人的知识产权，SysComm，作为交易筹码。随后，我起草了一份合同，里面附加了各种免责条款和漏洞，并把它交到了那个懒散的白痴手里……然后他签了名！这个笨蛋连看都没有看就签了名！任何一个迟钝的合作伙伴都是一种负担。一种很快就会被废弃的负担。

Any partner that thick is a liability. A liability soon to be nullified.

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GasCityFragmentE
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: Regus has changed. Or, perhaps, he is not such a fool... and today I saw beneath the mask. He is no longer so agreeable. Rather he came to our meeting with a raft of his own, radical, proposals. An entire shift in direction. And then, as I made to leave, he smiled. He smiled and, for just a second, I don't think his face was human at all. This is all wrong. I'm tearing up the contract. I have a terrible feeling that if do not escape this partnership immediately, I never will.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: Regus 变了。或者，也许，他根本就不傻……今天我看到他面具下的真面目了。他不再那么讨人喜欢了。相反地，他来参加我们的会议时，提出了大量他自己的激进建议。整个战略方向的转变。然后，当我准备离开时，他冲我笑了。他笑了，但就在那一瞬间，我觉得他的脸根本就不像人类。这一切都是错误。我要撕毁这份合同。有一种可怕的感觉萦绕在我的心头，如果再不立即摆脱这种合伙关系，我会永远无法脱身。

This is all wrong. I'm tearing up the contract. I have a terrible feeling that if do not escape this partnership immediately, I never will.

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GasCityFragmentF
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: That was not Regus. It was never Regus. It revealed its true face to me and… by the Void. I've entered into a partnership… with Sentients. The world-builders, the world-killers. Our enemy under all. This contract is worthless. Instead, they demand submission. CT! Assemble the disciples. Arm the Condors. Those oversized crustaceans have no idea who they're dealing with.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 那不是 Regus，它从来就不是 Regus。它通过虚空……给我展示了它的真面目。原来……我和 Sentient 结成了合伙关系。那些世界的改造者，世界的毁灭者。我们所有人的劲敌。这份合同毫无价值。相反，它们要求我的服从。终端机！召集信徒们，武装好秃鹫空投艇。让那些巨大的甲壳生物明白自己到底在跟谁打交道。

终端机！召集信徒们，武装好秃鹫空投艇。让那些巨大的甲壳生物明白自己到底在跟谁打交道。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GasCityFragmentG
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: That did not go as planned. Thousands against one. That massive grotesque tore through my forces like a shark through a shoal. We never inflicted so much as a scratch. Now it perches outside my home. The message is clear. I am to make Amalgams, and if I cross them, the Ropalolyst makes an ash cloud of this city. If my rivals find out I'll be executed for treason. What choice do I have but to comply?
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 事情没能按计划进行。千军万马对付一只怪物。那个大家伙像鲨鱼穿过浅滩一样撕裂着我的部队。而我们却无法伤到它分毫。现在，它就栖息在我的家门外。这一切所要传达的信息已经很明显了。我得开始制造并合体了，如果我反抗它们的话，蝠力使就会把这座城市变为废墟。如果我的竞争对手们发现了我的背叛行为，那我肯定会遭到处决。可现在，我除了服从，还有什么选择呢？
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.descriptionEn:
That did not go as planned. Thousands against one. That massive grotesque tore through my forces like a shark through a shoal. We never inflicted so much as a scratch.

Now it perches outside my home. The message is clear. I am to make Amalgams, and if I cross them, the Ropalolyst makes an ash cloud of this city.

If my rivals find out, I'll be executed for treason. What choice do I have but to comply?

事情没能按计划进行。千军万马对付一只怪物。那个大家伙像鲨鱼穿过浅滩一样撕裂着我的部队。而我们却无法伤到它分毫。

现在，它就栖息在我的家门外。这一切所要传达的信息已经很明显了。我得开始制造并合体了，如果我反抗它们的话，蝠力使就会把这座城市变为废墟。

如果我的竞争对手们发现了我的背叛行为，那我肯定会遭到处决。可现在，我除了服从，还有什么选择呢？

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GasCityFragmentH
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: Disciples! Good news! The Amalgam program has entered into a fruitful partnership. Pursuant to our agreement, their identities will be kept confidential, and a strict no-fly zone shall be instated around their craft. In time the nature of our project will be made known. Until then know that we work for a brighter Corpus future! Life is Profit.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 信徒们！好消息！并合计划缔结了一段富有成效的合伙关系。根据我们的协议，他们的身份会得到保密，而他们的飞船周围也会设立严格的禁飞区。假以时日，我们的计划终会被世人所知。在那一刻来临之前，请所有人谨记，我们是在为 Corpus 光明未来而奋战！生命，就是为了盈利！
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.descriptionEn:

In time the nature of our project will be made known. Until then know that we work for a brighter Corpus future! Life is Profit.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GasCityFragm.descriptionZh: 信徒们！好消息！并合计划缔结了一段富有成效的合伙关系。根据我们的协议，他们的身份会得到保密，而他们的飞船周围也会设立严格的禁飞区。 假以时日，我们的计划终会被世人所知。在那一刻来临之前，请所有人谨记，我们是在为 Corpus 光明未来而奋战！生命，就是为了盈利！

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/TheBusinessLoreFragmentA
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [1] In this life a person has to find that which is more important than themselves. The Orb Vallis died a long time ago. It should not exist. But here it is. It has a second chance. If that's not hope, then what is? I respect anything... that fights its way back from death.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [1] 人这一生，总得找到某种比自己更重要的东西。奥布山谷早已死过一次。照理说，它就不该存在。可它如今就在这里，重获新生。倘若这都不算希望，那什么才算？任何能从死亡手里挣脱的生命……都值得我尊重。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn: In this life a person has to find that which is more important than themselves. The Orb Vallis died a long time ago. It should not exist. But here it is. It has a second chance. If that's not hope, then what is? I respect anything... that fights its way back from death.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh: 人在一生中需要找到比他们自己还重要的东西。奥布山谷在很久以前就已经死去。它本不应该存在。但是现在它就在这里。它有了第二次机会。若那不是希望，那什么是？我尊重任何……与死亡抗争后存活下来的东西。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/TheBusinessLoreFragmentB
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [2] A sculptor sees the shape within the rock. Their skill lies in removing anything that is not that shape, delivering something beautiful and lasting into the world.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [2] 雕刻家能看到藏在岩石里的轮廓。他们的本事，在于凿去一切不成形的部分，把美丽而长久的作品带到世上。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn: A sculptor sees the shape within the rock. Their skill lies in removing anything that is not that shape, delivering something beautiful and lasting into the world.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh: 雕刻师在创作前就已经能看到作品在原石内的形状。他们的技巧在于移除不属于那个形状的部分，并将某些美好与永恒的东西带到这个世界。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/TheBusinessLoreFragmentC
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [3] I was a sculptor, of sorts. Modest. My task was the considered removal of those who obscured the shape of what we wanted to be. With their deletion a just society came into clearer focus.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [3] 我从前姑且也算是个雕刻家。我的任务就是经过思考，剔除阻碍我们雕刻出理想社会形态的杂质。随着他们被逐一抹除，一个公正社会的轮廓便越发清晰。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn: I was a sculptor, of sorts. Modest. My task was the considered removal of those who obscured the shape of what we wanted to be. With their deletion a just society came into clearer focus.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh: 在某种意义上说，我也曾是一名雕刻师，一名谦卑的雕刻师。我的任务是谨慎移除那些阻碍我们展现自我形态的人。当这些人消失后，社会就能显得更加公正。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/TheBusinessLoreFragmentD
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [4] Small actions lead to powerful outcomes. One example: a young man is repoed, and Eudico resurrects the resistance. Wise conservation is all about understanding patterns. Cause and effect. When orchestrating change in an ecosystem, ask: how will the system reconfigure in response to this new species. New forests? Redirected rivers? Diverse and beneficial new breeds? It is all connected.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [4] 蝴蝶轻轻拍动翅膀，可能就会掀起一场飓风。比如，一个年轻人惨遭回收，而最终尤迪科却借此振兴了抵抗势力。明智的生态保护，核心在于掌握规律——也就是因果关系。想改变生态系统，得先问问：新物种加入后，整个系统将如何重塑？会长出新的森林？河流会改道？会不会诞生更多样、更有益的新种群？这一切都紧密相连。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
Small actions lead to powerful outcomes. One example: a young man is repoed, and Eudico resurrects the resistance.

Wise conservation is all about understanding… patterns. Cause and effect. When orchestrating change in an ecosystem, ask: how will the system reconfigure in response to this new species. New forests? Redirected rivers? Diverse and beneficial new breeds? It is all connected.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
微小的举动可以引发重大的结果。举个例子：一名年轻人被执行索回，却导致 Eudico 恢复了反抗之声。

明智的动物保育活动，必须基于对事物运行规律的理解之上。因与果。当你对生态系统进行调整时，试着问自己这样的问题：系统将会以什么样的方式​来应对这个全新的物种。新的森林？河流改道？多样且有益的新品种？一切都是相互关联的。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/TheBusinessLoreFragmentE
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [5] It was Legs' punishment that inspired Eudico to resurrect Solaris United. Lean and wise, it's time for that hungry, furious wolf to enter the woods. For the Corpus to receive a selective and beneficial extinction. A small price to pay. A young man's body. An old man's soul.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [5] 正是腿哥遭受的惩罚，点燃了尤迪科要振兴索拉里斯联盟的决心。这头饥饿而愤怒的狼，如今已变得精悍而狡黠——是时候让它重返森林了。也该让科普斯迎接一场有选择性的良性灭绝了。代价并不高，就是一具年轻人的身体，还有一位长者的灵魂。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
It was Legs' punishment that inspired Eudico to resurrect Solaris United. Lean and wise, it is time for that hungry, furious wolf to enter the woods. For the Corpus to receive a selective and beneficial extinction.

A small price to pay. A young man's body. An old man's soul.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
腿哥所受的惩罚激发了 Eudico 重建索拉里斯联盟的决心。事态的发展就是如此巧妙，是时候让那头饥饿且狂怒的狼进入树林了。Corpus 将会迎来有选择性且对整个系统有益的灭绝。

为此付出的，只是一个小小的代价。一位年轻人的身体。和一位老者的灵魂。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EudicoLoreFragmentA
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [1] I founded Solaris United the day an old woman had her pet taken from her. The day my best friend watched her arms be given to someone else. The day my mother lost her head. I founded Solaris United the day I sold my heart. To buy a gun.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [1] 我创立索拉里斯联盟，是在一位老妇人的宠物被夺走的那天。是在我最好的朋友眼睁睁看着自己的双臂被装到别人身上的那天。是在我母亲失去头颅的那天。也是在我卖掉自己的心，换来一把枪的那天。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
I founded Solaris United the day an old woman had her pet taken from her. The day my best friend watched her arms be given to someone else. The day my mother lost her head. 

I founded Solaris United the day I sold my heart. 

To buy a gun.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
我创立索拉里斯联盟的日子：是一位老妇的宠物被夺走的日子；是我最好的朋友看着自己的手臂被交给了另外一个人的日子；也是我母亲失去头颅的日子。

在我创立索拉里斯联盟的那一天，我卖掉了我的心。

买来了一把枪。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EudicoLoreFragmentB
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [2] Biz just appeared one day, taught us how to fight economically, intelligently. Oh… Sparky, you should have seen us. Fireballing refineries by night, dutiful clean-up crew during the day. My job was to get people believing in us. Believing we could change things. That got more people killed than anything Zuud and her sisters could have hoped to make.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 比兹有一天突然出现了，教会我们如何精打细算、动脑子作战。噢……小火花，你真该瞧瞧我们那时候的样子。夜里把精炼厂炸成火球，白天却扮成尽职尽责的清理工。我的工作，是让大家相信我们，相信……我们能够改变一切。而这份信念……它害死的人，比祖德和她的姐妹们造出的任何武器都要多。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
Biz just appeared one day, taught us how to fight economically, intelligently. Oh… Sparky, you should have seen us. Fireballing refineries by night, dutiful clean-up crew during the day. My job was to get people believing in us. Believing we could change things.

That got more people killed than anything Zuud and her sisters could have hoped to make.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
盘总在某天突然出现，并教会了我们如何以经济且高明的方式来战斗。噢……小火花，你真应该来看看我们那时的样子。晚上精炼炉火力全开，白天清扫人员认真工作。我的职责是让人们相信我们，相信我们能够改变现状。

但这场变革带来的伤亡，已经超越了祖德和她的姐妹们所能造出的最强武器。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EudicoLoreFragmentC
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [3] It... it was a small operation, one we... one we almost didn't run. That's what keeps me up at night. Deck 12.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 那……那只是一次……很小的行动，小到我们差点就作罢了。可偏偏就是这件事，让我每天夜不能寐。12 号甲板的行动。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
It was a small operation, one we almost didn't run. That's what keeps me up at night. 

Deck 12.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
那……那是一次小行动，一次差点让我们没能逃出来的行动，同时也是一段让我时常无法入睡的记忆。

12号甲板。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EudicoLoreFragmentD
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [4] Everyone I knew, everyone who believed in us, everyone I CONVINCED to sign on… died. Parents, lovers… whole families. Zuud's sisters. Legs' folks. All gone. Except us, and a few others. Me, Biz, Zuud, Little Duck. I washed my hands of it. They were bloody enough.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 所有我认识的人，所有信任我的人，所有被我说服加入的人……全都死了。父母、爱人……一个个完整的家庭。祖德的姐妹、腿哥的双亲，所有人都不在了。如今活着的，只剩我们寥寥几个，我、比兹、祖德、小鸭子。我也金盆洗手了，因为手上沾的血，已经够多了。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
Everyone I knew, everyone who believed in us, everyone I convinced to sign on… died. Parents, lovers… families.  Zuud's sisters.  Leg's folks.  All gone.

Except us, and a few others. Me, Biz, Zuud, Little Duck. I washed my hands of it. They were bloody enough.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
所有我认识的人，所有相信我们的人，所有我招募来的人……都死了。双亲、恋人……整个家庭。祖德的姐妹。腿哥的亲人。全都逝世了。

除了我们，还有其他一些人。我、盘总、祖德、小鸭子。自那之后，我就洗手不干了。因为我的双手上沾染了太多的鲜血。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EudicoLoreFragmentE
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [5] Then, years later, Biz showed up again. And then you. And then, somehow, here we are. This isn't the first Solaris United. It's the second. And, one way or another, the last.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 几年过去后，比兹又现身了。接着是你。再然后，不知怎么的，我们就走到了这一步。索拉里斯联盟不是第一次建立了，这是第二次。而且，无论结果如何，这也将是最后一次。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
Then, years later, Biz showed up again. And then you. And then, somehow, here we are.

This isn't the first Solaris United. It's the second. And, one way or another, the last.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
几年之后，盘总又一次回到了这里。而后，你就来了。再之后，发生了一些事，我们就变成了现在这个样子。

这不是第一个索拉里斯联盟。这是第二个。而且，无论结果如何，这都会是最后一个。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/LegsLoreFragmentA
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [1] So I ain't got no fam - biological or logical. Mumsie and Dadsie got burned up workin' for Solaris United the first time. Figured I'd be a Ventkid, but then the Temple came lookin' to collect on what I took from 'em, an' left me barely a head. So, really things could only get better from there.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 是啊，我没有家人——血缘上没有，逻辑上也没有。第一次索联起义时，我老爸老妈就为这事没了。我本来想去投奔通风小子，结果润盈殿那帮人找上门来收我账，最后把我拆得只剩个脑袋了。哎，都已经到这份上，以后的日子总不能更糟了吧。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn: So I ain't got no fam - biological or logical. Mumsie and Dadsie got burned up workin' for Solaris United the first time. Figured I'd be a ventkid, but then the Temple came lookin' to collect on what I took from ‘em, an' left me barely a head. So, really things could only get better from there.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh: 我没有家人（无论是生理还是义理上）。老爸老妈在第一次为索拉里斯联盟工作时就被烧死了。后来我打算加入通风小子，可没想到润盈殿那边居然派人来索回我从他们那里偷走的东西，然后我就差不多只剩下一个头了。所以说，从今往后，我的生活只会变得更好。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/LegsLoreFragmentB
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [2] Can't be a Ventkid all MOA'd up. Don't fit, can't crawl, can't board. So I make my logical fam right here in me shop. Y'can see the resemblance. Runs in the family. Woulda been a Ventkid, though. For sure.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 浑身挂着恐鸟零件，可当不了通风小子。身体塞不进管道，也爬不上去，悬浮板也踩不了。我就在自己的小店里，亲手造出我的机械家人。瞧，我们长得多像，家族遗传嘛。不过我本来肯定能成为通风小子。绝对能。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
Can't be a ventkid all MOA'd up. Don't fit, can't crawl, can't board. So I make my logical fam right here in me shop. Y'can see the resemblance. Runs in the family. 

Woulda been a ventkid, though. For sure.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
我全身都被换成了恐鸟部件，也就无法加入通风小子。因为这副身体实在是不合适，无法爬行，更无法使用悬浮板。所以我就在自己的店里制作我的义亲。你能从它们身上看到家人的影子。

当然，如果可能的话，我还是想成为通风小子。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/LegsLoreFragmentC
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [3] Mister The Business has been really good to me since… since my accident. Always comin' over with somethin'. I tell him he doesn't have to, but he says to me: "In revolution, it is the weakest who sacrifice the most. You've done your part, that I might do mine." And then he hands me a nutrient canister or a part I can use. It's nice and all, but why's he looks so sad about it?
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 自从……自从我出事以后，「操盘手」先生就一直很关照我。他时不时会带点东西来看我。我跟他说过不用这样，可他对我说：「在革命中，往往是弱者做出了最大的牺牲。你已经尽了你的那份力，也让我尽尽我的那份吧。」然后他就递给我一罐营养液，或者一个我能用上的零件。是挺好的，可他为什么看起来那么难过呢？
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn: Mister The Business has been really good to me since… since my accident. Always comin' over with somethin'. I tell him he doesn't have to, but he says to me "In revolution, it is the weakest who sacrifice the most. You've done your part, that I might do mine." And then he hands me a nutrient canister or a part I can use. It's nice and all, but why's he looks so sad about it?
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh: 在我出事后……盘总先生对我非常好。总会给我带些东西过来。我跟他说过不必这样，但他对我说："在行动中，弱者牺牲得最多。你尽了你的本分，我也该尽尽我的。" 说完他就递给我一个营养罐头或者一个我能使用的部件。虽然现在一切都已经很好了，但他为什么看起来这么伤心呢？

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/LegsLoreFragmentD
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [4] Mister The Business got me thinkin': me and my MOAs, we're tight. I need it, they do it. If Nef does try musclin' the Solaris out with his MOAs again… I might just replace his with some of my own. Get inside his head, chek? I mean, I'd rather be gettin' my music to the people, but who says I can't also be a beautiful spider at the center of a big ol' web of subterfuge and intrigue?
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 「操盘手」先生的话让我开始琢磨：我和我的恐鸟，都是铁哥们。我一句话，他们就去办。要是奈富再敢用他的恐鸟来镇压索拉里斯人……说不定我能拿我的恐鸟，把他的全换掉。从内部瓦解他，懂吗？我是说，我当然更想把音乐带给大家，但谁规定我就不能同时做一只漂亮的蜘蛛，坐在一张由渗透与暗线织成的大网中央出谋划策呢？
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn: Mister The Business got me thinkin': me and my MOAs, we're tight. I need it, they do it. If Nef does try musclin' the Solaris out with his MOAs again… I might just replace his with some of my own. Get inside his head, chek? I mean, I'd rather be gettin' my music to the people, but who says I can't also be a beautiful spider at the center of a big ol' web of subterfuge and intrigue?
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh: 可以说是盘总先生让我真正开始思考：我和我的恐鸟宠物，关系紧密。我需要帮助，它们就给我帮助。如果奈富再用他的恐鸟宠物打击索拉里斯…我也许会用我自己的恐鸟宠物来替换他的。想敲开他的脑袋看看？我是说，我很愿意跟大家分享我的音乐，但谁说我不能同时成为活在巨型诡计阴谋之网中心的美丽的蜘蛛呢？

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/LegsLoreFragmentE
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [5] I was hangin' in my rack the other cycle, 'bout to power down, an' I hear Boon and Roky and the venters bangin' skeg on the pipes and ducts. They had a good bounce goin' so's I start singin', as I do. Got a little loud, and the skeg stops. I get all quiet like. Really stepped in it, thinks me. Then the grill pops and Boon's got his head in my hab sayin' "Hey, keep it goin'!" Didn't sleep much that night. Neighbors neither. Ventkid. That's me.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 上个周期，我正挂在床架上准备睡觉，忽然听到阿布、小洛和通风小子们在管道和风道上敲打奏乐。他们敲的节拍很带劲，于是我也就照老样子跟着唱。唱着唱着声音有点大，然后乐声突然停了。我吓得赶紧闭嘴。心想，完了，踩雷了。紧接着通风口格栅「砰」地一声弹开，阿布把脑袋探进我的舱室说：「喂，接着唱啊！」那一晚我没怎么睡，邻居们也被我吵得够呛。那天晚上我终于当上了通风小子。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn: I was hangin' in my rack the other cycle, ‘bout to power down, an' I hear Boon and Roky and the venters bangin' skeg on the pipes and ducts. They had a good bounce goin' so's I start singin', as I do. Got a little loud, and the skeg stops. I get all quiet like. Really stepped in it, thinks me. Then the grill pops and Boon's got his head in my hab sayin' "Keep it goin'!" Didn't sleep much that night. Neighbors neither.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh: 有一天，我挂在自己的床架上，正准备关机休息，然后我就听到阿布和小洛以及其他的通风小子在管道上敲奏管道乐。他们奏得起劲，所以我开始唱起来了。我唱得有点大声，结果管道乐就突然停止了。我以为自己刚才的举动冒犯到他们了，所以吓得不敢发声。随后，铁栅格突然打开了，阿布把头探进我的房间，说道："嘿，继续呀！"结果那一晚我都没怎么睡。邻居们也没睡。通风小子。那就是我。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/LittleDuckLoreFragmentA
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [1] Quills wanted me sellin' arms to the Tenno. Back in Fortuna. Not bloody likely. Quills. Shady, side-mouthed, double-talking ambidexter-feeling muckers. Never trust anyone who don't speak plain. Told 'em thanks but hop it. I'd a previous commitment: a contract to extract a Corpus defector name of Jubb Lott. Quill smiled that smile. The smile I hate the most. The smile of a body who thinks he's two steps ahead. The more I think about it, the more I know he was. Pratoo. That was his name. Quill Pratoo Secondary Sahd.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [1] 夜羽想让我回福尔图娜，给 Tenno 卖武器。想得美。夜羽那帮混蛋，个个都是阴阳怪气、满嘴瞎话、两面三刀的无赖。千万别信那种说话遮遮掩掩的家伙。我跟他们说「谢了，一边玩去吧」。我先前还有个活没交差——是一份合同，要把一个叫朱布·洛特的科普斯叛逃者捞出来。那个夜羽冲我笑了笑。我最痛恨的那种笑，那种自以为比你多算计了两步的轻笑。越琢磨那个笑，就越发现他确实算计了我。普拉图，他就叫这个名字。二级三席夜羽普拉图。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
Quills wanted me sellin' arms to the Tenno. Back in Fortuna. Not bloody likely. Quills. Shady, side-mouthed, doubletalking ambidexter-feeling muckers. Never trust anyone who don't speak plain. Told ‘em thanks but hop it. 

I'd a previous commitment: a contract to extract a Corpus defector name of Jubb Lott. 

Quill smiled that smile. The smile I hate the most. The smile of a body who thinks ‘e's two steps ahead.

The more I think about it, the more I know he was.

Pratoo. That was his name. Quill Pratoo Secondary sahd.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
夜羽希望我向 Tenno 出售武器。回到福尔图娜。应该没有血腥。夜羽。阴沉，装腔作势，心怀不轨的伙计。永远不要相信任何不说话的人。告诉他们谢谢，叫他们离开吧。

我之前的承诺是：从一个 Corpus 叛逃者名字 Jubb Lott 那里得到情报的合同。

夜羽笑了笑。一个我最讨厌的笑容。他总是可以巧妙地预测别人会做什么或想什么。

我想的越多，我就越了解他。

普拉图。那是他的名字。夜羽 普拉图 Secondary sahd。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/LittleDuckLoreFragmentB
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [2]Today?! I didn't know you were coming today!
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 今天？我怎么不知道你今天要来！
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
JUBB LOTT: Today?! I didn't know you were coming today! 
LITTLE DUCK: That's how hostile extractions typically work, Jubb! (blam) Unless! (blam) you'd like! (blam) to pencil me in! (blam) for a two-thirty next week! (blam) Maybe copy in your supervisor and half the security team?
JUBB LOTT: AAGH! 
LITTLE DUCK: What is their problem?!
JUBB LOTT: I MEAN ALL MY FILES ARE STILL IN MY OFFICE! YOU KNOW: THE WHOLE REASON YOU'RE DOING THIS?
LITTLE DUCK: What files? I wasn't told about any files! 
JUBB LOTT: That's because I didn't tell them!
LITTLE DUCK: Tell who? Tell who, Jubb!
JUBB LOTT: The Quills, alright? The Quills!

And that's when it all made a cruddy kind of mucking sense. I'd been set up.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
JUBB LOTT：今天？！我不知道你今天要来！
小鸭子：这就是敌方撤离点典型的工作，Jubb！（责备）除非！（责备）你想要的！（责备）安排我去！（责备）下周两点半！（责备）也许伪装成你的主管和一半是安全团队？
JUBB LOTT：啊！
小鸭子：他们到底有什么问题？ ！
JUBB LOTT：我的所有文件都在我的办公室里！你知道吗：你做这件事的原因是什么？
小鸭子：什么文件？我没有被告知什么文件！
JUBB LOTT：那是因为我没告诉他们！
小鸭子：告诉谁？到底是告诉谁，Jubb！
JUBB LOTT：夜羽，了解了吗？就是夜羽！

从那时候开始，这一切都成了一种肮脏污秽的感觉。我被陷害了。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/LittleDuckLoreFragmentC
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [3] It was hairy but I managed to get us behind a sealed bulkhead, and into Lott's office.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 过程虽然惊险，不过我还是想办法带大家从密封仓后头穿过去，溜进了洛特的办公室。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
It was hairy but I managed to get us behind a sealed bulkhead, and into Lott's office. 

LITTLE DUCK: They don't fight like this for mid-level pencilnecks! Who are you?
JUBB LOTT: Jubb. Lott. Secondary Sub-Architect of Nef Anyo's Venusian Restoration. I… have information.

And then he said it.

JUBB LOTT: For Solaris United.

And then he got killed.

JUBB LOTT: Unf!
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
状况不明，但我设法把我们带到一个密封的舱壁后面，然后进入 Lott 的办公室。

小鸭子：他们不会这么弱地作战！你是谁？
JUBB LOTT：Jubb。Lott。奈富·安尤的金星修复站的副建筑师。我……有情报。

然后他说了。

JUBB LOTT：关于索拉里斯联盟。

然后他就被杀了。

JUBB LOTT：呃！

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/LittleDuckLoreFragmentD
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [4] So. Solaris United was on its feet again. I've got friends in Fortuna. The first time SU tried to knock the crown off Nef's head it almost got every last one of them killed. Some of them, it did. Biz once told me how he survives atrocity. 'If there's a fire on Deck 12, you seal off Deck 12. You don't go in. That's how you burn up. You wait 'til the fire's starved of oxygen. That's when you go in, assess the damage and clean up.' I can't seal off Deck 12. Deck 12 is where I live.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 所以说，索拉里斯联盟又站起来了。我在福尔图娜还有朋友。上次索联试图颠覆奈富的统治，结果差点全军覆没。有些人，确实没能活下来。比兹曾告诉我，他是如何在那场灾难中苟活下来的。他说：「如果12号甲板着火了，就封死它。但千万不能进去，进去就是送死。等火焰把氧气耗光，再进去评估损失和清理现场。」我实在没办法封死12号甲板，因为那儿就是我的家。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
So. Solaris United was on its feet again. I've got friends in Fortuna.  The first time SU tried to knock the crown off Nef's head it almost got every last one of them killed. Some of them, it did. Biz once told me how he survives atrocity. ‘If there's a fire on Deck 12, you seal off Deck 12. You don't go in. That's how you burn up. You wait ‘til the fire's starved of oxygen. That's when you go in, assess the damage and clean up. 'I can't seal off Deck 12. Deck 12 is where I live.

LITTLE DUCK: What information? Tell me! Now!
JUBB LOTT: Nef. Vallis. Orb Mothers…  It's been developed…
LITTLE DUCK: What? What's been developed?!
JUBB LOTT: Shielding... Satellites... The Orb Mothers… cannot be…
LITTLE DUCK: Jubb? What? The Orb Mothers cannot be what? Jubb!
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
所以。索拉里斯联盟重新站起来了。我有些朋友在福尔图娜。当索联第一次尝试颠覆奈富的统治时，他们几乎全军覆没。而且，对某些幸存者来说，索联已经死了。盘总曾跟我讲述他是如何在那场灾难中活下来的："如果12号甲板着火了，你就得封锁12号甲板。你不能进去，因为进去就会被烧死。你只能等火焰把氧气耗尽，才能进去。而接下来要做的，就是评估损伤和清理现场。"封锁12号甲板这种事，我实在是做不到。12号甲板是我生活的地方。

小鸭子：什么情报？告诉我！立刻！
JUBB LOTT：奈富。山谷。圆蛛母亲……已被开发出来了……
小鸭子：什么？什么被开发了？！
JUBB LOTT：护盾……卫星……圆蛛母亲……不能……
小鸭子：Jubb？什么？那些圆蛛母亲不能什么？Jubb！

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/LittleDuckLoreFragmentE
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [5] Biz saved me from a life of swabbing latrines on Phobos. He made me what I am. But only because I left before I became what he was.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 是比兹把我从火卫一刷马桶的日子里捞了出来。是他成就了今天的我，但这正是因为我及时抽身，才没有变成曾经冷酷无情的他。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
Biz saved me from a life of swabbing latrines on Phobos. He made me what I am. But only because I left before I became what he was. 

Now… now I had to go back. Everything Jubb knew… Biz had to know. Yoodi had to know. They, and everyone in Fortuna, could be proper beached if I didn't. Pencilnecks like Jubb don't risk their hide unless they mean it. Whatever Nef was doin' with those Orb Mothers would be a hammer on the head of SU. Had to go back. If I didn't, if somethin' happened to Fortuna, I'd never sleep proper again.

So. No more treasure hunting for LD. No more rescues. Back to where it all happened, and the hope that this time it wasn't burning, and me along with it.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
盘总拯救了我，免了我在火卫一洗擦厕所的人生。他成就了我。但纯粹是因为我在变成他之前就离开了。

现在…现在我要回去了。任何 Jubb 知道的事…盘总都必须要知道。Eudi 也需知道。他们，和每一个在福尔图娜的人，要是我不回去就会被搁浅了。弱鸡如 Jubb 不会拿他们的隐身一事来冒险，除非他们真想这样做。无论那时奈富通过圆蛛母做什么，对索联来说都是一记当头棒喝。要是我不回去，若然福尔图娜出了什么事，我也永远无法安睡了。

所以，LD 不需再寻宝。不再有更多的救援。就回到这一切发生的原点，还有那份这次它不会毁于一旦的希冀，包括我在内。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/SmokefingerLoreFragmentA
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [1] I… have no truck with the Corpus. The greatest damage done by avarice for the sake of avarice is precisely that it, without remorse or relent, demonstrates the easy sale of men and women who lend their bodies, their intellects, their voice... to ends in which they themselves do not believe. The Temple of Profit is an ideology that teaches one thing only: that all creations of the mind^ words, images and ideas, are meaningless.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 我……和科普斯没什么好说的。贪婪之所以为害至深，恰恰在于它冰冷赤裸地证明了：人们能多么轻易地出卖自己的身体、才智和声音……去替连他们自己都不相信的目标效力。润盈殿的信条只教人一件事——一切思想的造物、言辞、图像和观念，皆为虚妄。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn: I… have no truck with the Corpus. The greatest damage done by avarice for the sake of avarice is precisely that it, without remorse or relent, demonstrates the easy sale of men and women who lend their bodies, their intellects, their voice... to ends in which they themselves do not believe. The Temple of Profit is an ideology that teaches one thing only: that all creations of the mind; words, images and ideas, are meaningless.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh: 我……与 Corpus 之间没有任何恩怨。为了贪婪而贪婪，这种行为所造成的最恶劣的后果，就是它以毫无悔恨和怜悯的方式展现出了一个事实：人们可以轻而易举地借出他们的身体、他们的智慧、他们的声音……为的是连他们自己都不相信的最终目的。润盈殿是一种思想，它只教导一件事：那就是所有头脑的创作；言词，影像，和构想，都是毫无意义的。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/SmokefingerLoreFragmentB
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [2] And that is how you keep people beaten. By starving them not only of models of something better, but draining them of wholesome inspiration, denying them examples of a higher way of being and sapping them of any belief that they can achieve it. To be blunt: to Hell with the Corpus. Although… although there was one Corpus, a singular man, for whom I make a singular exception. His name was Sigor Savah.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 这就是你让他们一败涂地的方式。夺走他们对美好的向往，榨干他们所有积极的灵感，否定任何更高尚的生存方式存在，再瓦解他们实现这一切的最后一丝信念。说白了，让科普斯见鬼去吧。只不过……只有一个人例外，一个……一个非凡的人，我愿意为他破一次例。他叫西格·萨瓦。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
And that is how you keep people beaten. By starving them not only of models of something better, but draining them of wholesome inspiration, denying them examples of a higher way of being and sapping them of any belief that they can achieve it.

To be blunt: to Hell with the Corpus. 

Although… although there was one Corpus, a singular man, for whom I make a singular exception. His name was Sigor Savah.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
而那正是让人们一蹶不振的方法。让他们没有更好的目标可以去追求，消耗他们心中所有的动力，杜绝能让他们接触到高质量生活的机会，同时削弱任何他们认为能达成它的信念。

直言不讳地来说：Corpus 都见鬼去吧。

不过……还是有一位特别的 Corpus，一个独一无二​​的男人，在我眼中只有他是个例外。他的名字叫西格·萨瓦。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/SmokefingerLoreFragmentC
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [3] I was a younger man then, an assistant to the efforts of Morphology Specialist Sigor Savah, though I don't think he ever knew my name. Morphology Specialist Savah's job was to catalog and assess whatever lifeforms - dead or alive - were uncovered as Venus sprang back to life. That man sacrificed everything - career, future, perhaps even his life - to save a kavat, if you can believe that. I know, because I helped him. Though he never knew that, either.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 那会儿我还年轻，给赫赫有名的形态学专家西格·萨瓦当助手，哦不过他估计连我的名字都没记住。萨瓦专家负责记录和评估金星复苏过程中发现的一切生命，无论死活。你信吗？为了救一只库娃，那个男人舍弃了一切——事业、前途、甚至他的生命。我知道，因为是我暗中帮了他。而这件事，他同样被蒙在鼓里。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn: I was a younger man then, an assistant to the efforts of Morphology Specialist Sigor Savah, though I don't think he ever knew my name. Morphology Specialist Savah's job was to catalog and assess whatever lifeforms - dead or alive - were uncovered as Venus sprang back to life. That man sacrificed everything - career, future, perhaps even his life - to save a kavat, if you can believe that. I know, because I helped him. Though he never knew that, either.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh: 在我年轻的时候，曾经当过形态学专家西格·萨瓦的助手，虽然我不认为他知道我叫什么名字。形态学专家西格·萨瓦的工作是记载和评估金星复苏后被发现的任何生物（无论生死）。你可能不敢相信，那个男人为了拯救一只库娃而牺牲了一切（事业、未来、或许连同他自己的生命）。我知道这件事，因为我曾帮助过他。虽然他也从来没有意识到这一点。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/SmokefingerLoreFragmentD
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [4] The kavat, Specimen VK-7, had been tracked to her lair and was to be destroyed. Sigor prevented that at the cost of his liberty, and was soon to lose his life. Coward that I was I told myself there was nothing I could do. Then she was there. VK-7. In front of my hab, waiting, looking at me with more intelligence than any kavat should have. And she dropped keys at my feet. The keys to the security center. It was I who opened the door to Sigor's cell. Who watched as VK-7 dispatched Sigor's would-be executioner, a Corpus I had often worked with in Reclamation 3. It was I who ensured one cargo pod in particular was replotted, to intercept an outbound Solaris rail tractor. It was I who sealed multiple bulkheads, to stem the flow of troopers meaning to end them both.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 那只库娃的样本编号是 VK-7，她的巢穴已被锁定，等待她的只有毁灭。西格以葬送自由为代价阻止了他们，而很快，他连命也得搭进去。像我这样的懦夫，只能一遍遍告诉自己：我也无能为力。然后，她出现了。VK-7，她就蹲在我的住处外，等待着我。她的眼神中带有一种库娃不该有的智慧，定定地注视着我。她把钥匙丢在了我脚边，那是安全中心的钥匙。是我打开了西格的牢门，眼睁睁地看着 VK-7 解决掉前来处决他的刽子手——我在3号开垦区还和他共事过。是我暗中操作，让某个特定的货舱偏离航线，去拦截一艘出航的索拉里斯航道牵引机。也是我，封死了一道道舱壁，把那些要置他们于死地的士兵，牢牢截在身后。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
The kavat, Specimen VK-7, had been tracked to her lair and was to be destroyed. Sigor prevented that at the cost of his liberty, and was soon to lose his life. Coward that I was I told myself there was nothing I could do.

Then she was there. VK-7. In front of my hab, waiting, looking at me with more intelligence than any kavat should have. And she dropped keys at my feet. The keys to the security center.

It was I who opened the door to Sigor's cell. Who watched as VK-7 dispatched Sigor's would-be executioner, a Corpus I had often worked with in Reclamation 3. It was I who ensured one cargo pod in particular was replotted, to intercept an outbound Solaris rail tractor. It was I who sealed multiple bulkheads, to stem the flow of troopers meaning to end them both.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
库娃，样本 VK-7，已被追踪至她的巢穴中，并且即将遭到消灭。西格以他的自由为代价防止了这件事，并且也即将因此失去生命。那时的我，就像一个胆小鬼，只会用"我什么都做不了"的借口来安慰自己。

然后她就出现在了那里。VK-7。就在我的住处前。她看着我，眼中透露出了比任何库娃都要高级的智慧。随后，她就在我的脚前面放了一把钥匙。那是通往安全中心的钥匙。

打开西格牢房门的是我。我看着 VK-7 解决了那个即将对西格行刑的人（一个经常和我一起在3号回收单位工作的 Corpus）。是我给一架特定的货舱重新规划了航线，使其阻截了一架离港的索拉里斯航道牵引机。是我封锁了数个舱壁来防止前来拿下他们的士兵们的涌入。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/SmokefingerLoreFragmentE
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [5] Why did I do it? Hmm.. I remember Sigor best this way: he puts down an instrument, respects me enough to look me in the eye, and he tells me: "Every living thing longs to be whole. Every living thing yearns to defy death. If from death you returned, yet the part you loved best did not… what then?" That was the last thing he ever said to me. That is why I helped him. In saving that animal Sigor Savah had saved himself. How many of us can say that? I was not about to stand by and let the Corpus steal from him the one thing that was truly his. To a flaming Hell with the bloody Corpus. Cetus, is where Sigor went. The Plains. His story is out there, if you want to hear it. To this day I hope he is, too.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 我为什么这么做？嗯……我记忆里的西格，印象最深的画面是：他放下手中的仪器，郑重地抬眼望着我，对我说：「每一个生命都渴望完整。每一个生命都奋力向死亡抗争。如果从死亡的深渊中归来，而你最深爱的那部分却没能回来……那又该怎么办？」那是他对我说的最后一句话。这就是我帮他的原因。在拯救那只动物的过程中，西格·萨瓦也救赎了自己。我们之中有多少人能拍着胸脯说出这句话？我绝不能袖手旁观，任由科普斯夺走唯一真正属于他的东西。让这帮该死的科普斯统统滚进烈焰地狱。西格去了希图斯，去了夜灵平野。他的故事就发生在那里。你想听的话就去那找吧。直到今天，我仍然希望他还在那里。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
Why did I do it? Hmm.

I remember Sigor best this way: he puts down an instrument, respects me enough to look me in the eye, and he tells me: "Every living thing longs to be whole. Every living thing yearns to defy death. If from death you returned, yet the part you loved best did not… what then?" That was the last thing he ever said to me.

That is why I helped him. In saving that animal Sigor Savah had saved himself. How many of us can say that? I was not about to stand by and let the Corpus steal from him the one thing that was truly his. 

To a flaming Hell with the bloody Corpus.

Cetus, is where Sigor went. The Plains. His story is out there, if you want to hear it. To this day I hope he is, too.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
我为什么会那么做呢？嗯……

关于西格，我记得最清楚的是这样一件事：他放下一件乐器，以尊重的目光看着我，然后说道："每个生物都渴望变得完整。每个生物都向往违抗死亡。若你从死里回生，然而你最喜爱的部份没有……那么接下来怎么办呢？"那是他对我说过的最后一番话。

也正是因为这几句话，我才会去帮助他。在挽救了那只动物的同时，西格·萨瓦 也挽救了自己。这种事能有几个人做到？我不会眼睁睁地看着 Corpus 从他那里偷走真正属于他的东西。

下地狱去吧，这些该死的 Corpus。

西格去了希图斯。如果你有兴趣的话，就到夜灵平野上去寻觅他的故事吧。我衷心希望他本人也在那里。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/TickerLoreFragmentA
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [1] Used to be every time an old love ended and a new one began, friends would say "You seem so much happier now." And I'd smile and I'd agree and then I'd go back to my hab... and say your name. Just to feel it on my lips again. Like summoning a ghost.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [1] 过去，每当一段旧情落幕，又有一段新欢开始，朋友们总会说：「你现在看起来开心多了。」我会一笑而过，点头赞同，然后回到我的住处……默默念叨你的名字。只为了能再次感受它在我唇间滑过的触感。仿佛在召唤幽灵。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn: Used to be every time an old love ended and a new one began, friends would say "You seem so much happier now." And I'd smile and I'd agree and then I'd go back to my hab... and say your name. Just to feel it on my lips again. Like summoning a ghost.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh: 按照以往的规律，每当一场旧爱结束时，新的爱情就会开始，朋友们都会说"你现在看起来更快乐了"。我会表示赞同并还以微笑，然后在回到我的住处之后……说出你的名字。这只是为了能让我的双唇再次感受它。就像召唤幽灵一样。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/TickerLoreFragmentB
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [2] We met in unspoken agreement. You called me by the name of the one who had hurt you. My name for you was the name of the one who had wounded me. We played the part for each other. When I spoke, I spoke for them. Through you I told the one who had wounded me all the little things I never had a chance to. Cooked them all the meals I never got to share. Made all the jokes. Laughed all the laughs. With them, through you. And you, with yours, through me. Then, one day, you called me by my own name and we never looked back.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh:
[2] 我们心照不宣地走到了一起。你用伤害你的那个人的名字称呼我。而我也用刺伤过我的名字称呼你。我们为彼此扮演着那些角色。每当我开口，便是替他们说话。透过你，我向那个曾伤害我的人倾诉了未曾出口的点点滴滴。

我为他们烹制了所有我不曾分享过的饭菜，开了所有来不及说的玩笑，也笑完那些本该一同笑出的笑声。透过你，我与他们重逢。你也透过我，和伤害你的那个人相遇。直到有一天，你喊出了我真正的名字。那一刻之后，我们便再也没有回头。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
We met in unspoken agreement. You called me by the name of the one who had hurt you. My name for you was the name of the one who had wounded me. We played  the part for each other. When I spoke, I spoke for them. Through you I told the one who had wounded me all the little things I never had the chance to. Cooked them all the meals I never got to share. Made all the jokes. Laughed all the laughs. With them, through you. And you, with yours, through me.

Then, one day, you called me by my own name and we never looked back.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
我们的会面带着一种默契。你用那位伤害你的人的名字称呼我。而我则给你冠上了那个伤害了我的人的名字。我们相互为对方扮演对方所需要的角色。我所说的话，都是在为那些角色而说。通过你，我把那些一直以来都没有机会说出的小事情全都告诉那个伤害了我的人。所有那些为他们烹调而我却无法享用的菜肴，所有那些玩笑，所有那些欢声笑语。我通过我的那些角色来面对你，而你，则用你的那些角色来面对我。

然后，有一天，你用了我自己的名字叫我，我们从此不再回首。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/TickerLoreFragmentC
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [3] There's a dream I have every now and then. You are you, in your own first body. And I am there in mine. I stand on the shore. You stand in the sea. I watch as the waves roll in, but never break against your back. They whisper right through you, and you fade away from me. Again. I still have your glove. Just the one. The only thing I have left of you. In quiet moments I lay it on my lap, lace my fingers through yours, and make promises. I promised that what happened to you would never happen to another. Promises. I couldn't keep.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh:
[3] 我时常会做这样一个梦。梦里你还是最初的你，灵魂还住在原先的身体里。我的灵魂也在我自己的身体里。我站在岸边，你站在海里。
我看着浪潮滚滚而来，却从未在你背上溅开。浪花低声呢喃着，直直地穿过你的身体，然后你在我眼前渐渐消散。一如以往。我还留着你的手套，不过只剩一只了。这是我唯一留下的、属于你的东西。在安静的时刻，我把它放在膝上，把手指一根根套进去，与你十指相扣，然后许下诺言。
我向你保证，发生在你身上的悲剧，绝不会在别人身上重演。而我……没能守住这个诺言。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
There's a dream I have every now and then. You are you, in your own first body. And I am there in mine. I stand on the shore. You stand in the sea. I watch as the waves roll in, but never break against your back. They whisper right through you, and you fade away from me. Again.

I still have your glove. Just the one. The only thing I have left of you. In quiet moments I lay it on my lap, lace my fingers through yours, and make promises.

I promised that what happened to you would never happen to another.

Promises. I couldn't keep.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
我不时会做一场梦。你是你，在你的第一个身躯里。且我在我的身躯里。我站在海岸上。你站在海里。我看着海浪滚进来，可是它们不会打到你的背。它们从背后低调穿过你，并且你从我前面消失。再一次。

我仍有你的手套。只有这个。这是我唯一留下关于你的东西。在安静的时候我会把它放在我的大腿上，然后假装与你十指相扣，并许下诺言。

我承诺，在你身上发生的事再也不会发生在另外一个人的身上。

而这，是我过去没能遵守的诺言。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/TickerLoreFragmentD
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [4] I sold my arms to buy you an arm. I sold my legs to buy you a leg. I sold my lungs, my bones, my heart... to buy a safe place to cradle your beautiful head. I bought you back from them. I brought you back to me. You in the body I had bought for you, me in the body I had earned to replace the one I sold. But you weren't you. Not anymore.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [4] 我卖掉自己的双臂，给你换来一条胳膊。我卖掉了双腿，给你换来一条腿。我卖掉了肺、骨头、心脏……只为买下一处安全的地方，好安放你那美丽的头颅。我把你从他们手里赎了回来，把你带回了我身边。你住进我为你买来的新身体，而我被困在靠出卖原本躯体换来的义体中。可你已不再是你，一切都回不去了。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
I sold my arms to buy you an arm. I sold my legs to buy you a leg. I sold my lungs, my bones, my heart... to buy a safe place to cradle your beautiful head. I bought you back from them. I brought you back to me. You in the body I had bought for you, me in the body I had earned to replace the one I sold. 

But you weren't you. Not anymore.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
我卖掉了我的手臂来为你买一只手臂。我卖掉了我的脚来为你买一只脚。我卖掉了我的肺、我的骨头、我的心……来买下一个安放你美丽头部的安全摇蓝。我从他们那里把你买回来了。我把你带回来我身边。你在一副我买给你的身躯内，我在一个我用自己的身体换来的身躯内。

但你已不再是你。再也不是了。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/TickerLoreFragmentE
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [5] Sat so long on the Taxman's shelf, you barely knew who you were. And you certainly didn't know me. The goodbyes I said decades earlier… they stuck. These days you work the canal with few memories of who you were. And I'm in the business of keeping promises.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [5] 你在税务官的货架上放了太久，久到连你自己都快忘了自己是谁。而你，自然也不可能认得我。几十年前我跟你说过的那些告别……终究是成真了。如今你在运河区工作，只剩下以前零零散散的记忆。而我干起了另一门营生——履行之前的诺言。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
Sat so long on the Taxman's shelf, you barely knew who you were. And you certainly didn't know me. 

The goodbyes I said decades earlier… they stuck. 

These days you work the canal with few memories of who you were. And I'm in the business of keeping promises.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
搁置在税务官的架上，你几乎不认得你自己了。而且你当然也不认得我了。

几十年前说过的再见……仍会共鸣。

这些天你在运河里工作，仅存几个关于自己是谁的记忆。然后我还蛮擅长守住承诺的。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/RudeZuudLoreFragmentA
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [1] Chatter wakes me, tells me a woman is at my lock, asking for water. Her carapace is scorched. Her raiments, burnt. I fetch water. When I return there are five more women. All singed. They say they are from... Deck 12.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [1] 杂音叫醒了我，说有个女人站在我门口，想讨口水喝。她的外表被烧焦了，衣服也被烧烂了。然后我就去给她拿水。等我回来时，门外又多五个女人。她们全被烧焦了，还说她们来自……12号甲板。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.nameZh: 粗鲁的祖德的记忆碎片1/5
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn: Chatter wakes me, tells me a woman is at my lock, asking for water. Her carapace is scorched. Her raiments, burnt. I fetch water. When I return there are five more women. All singed. They say they are from... Deck 12.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh: 杂音叫醒了我，告诉我有一位女士在我的门口讨水喝。她的外壳被烧焦了。她的外衣也被烧坏了。我转身去取水，当我回来后，门口又多了五位女士。每个都被烧焦了。她们都说她们来自……12号甲板。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/RudeZuudLoreFragmentB
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [2] There is no Deck 12. I am certain I have seen those faces before. I fetch more water. I return, they are gone. I return to my rack, feeling… I return to my rack angry at the inconvenience is what I do!
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [2] 压根就没有什么12号甲板。我敢肯定，我之前见过那些面孔。我又去拿了些水。等我回来，她们全都不见了。等我回到床架边，感觉……不，我是憋了一肚子火，带着这一通烦心事，就这么一头栽倒在床上！
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.nameZh: 粗鲁的祖德的记忆碎片2/5
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn: There is no Deck 12. I am certain I have seen those faces before. I fetch more water. I return, they are gone. I return to my rack, feeling… I return to my rack angry at the inconvenience is what I do!
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh: 没有12号甲板这个地方。我确定我以前见过这些面孔。我转身去取更多的水。等我回来后，她们就不见了。我回到我的床架上，感觉……我回到我的床架上，为这一通烦心事而气愤不已！

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/RudeZuudLoreFragmentC
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [3] The gentleman Business visited with me. Inconvenient. Why? Why so much talk when there is so much to do? The gentleman Business communicated the belief that… such nonsense… that I must 'make peace with what happened on Deck 12.'
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [3] 那位体面的「操盘手」先生来找我聊过。真是添麻烦。为什么？明明我还有那么多活要做，为什么偏要说那么多弯弯绕绕的废话？「操盘手」先生向我表达了一个看法……简直胡说八道……他说我必须「与12号甲板上发生的事和解」。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.nameZh: 粗鲁的祖德的记忆碎片3/5
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn: The gentleman Business visited with me. Inconvenient. Why? Why so much talk when there is so much to do? The gentleman Business communicated the belief that… such nonsense… that I must ‘make peace with what happened on Deck 12.'
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh: 操盘手绅士拜访过我。真麻烦。谈话有什么意思？明明有这么多活要干，哪有功夫说话？操盘手绅士给我传达了一种信念那就是……一堆废话……说什么我需要"放下12号甲板上发生的事"。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/RudeZuudLoreFragmentD
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [4] Deck 12. Deck 12. What is this Deck 12. Chatter had stopped speaking entirely, then. "It's all right that you weren't there, Zuud. That's what your visitors wanted you to know. That fire was not for y…" Ach! Enough! Nonsense and stupidity and a waste of my time!
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [4] 12号甲板，12号甲板，12号甲板到底是什么？然后，杂音就没再念叨了。「还好你没在那儿，祖德。来找你的人就是想让你知道这一点——那场大火不是冲着你……」啊！够了！胡说八道，一帮蠢货，纯粹浪费我的时间！
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.nameZh: 粗鲁的祖德的记忆碎片4/5
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn: Deck 12.  Deck 12. What is this Deck 12. Chatter had stopped speaking entirely, then. "It's all right that you weren't there, Zuud. That's what your visitors wanted you to know. That fire was not for y…" Ach! Enough! Nonsense and stupidity and a waste of my time!
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh: 12号甲板。12号甲板。什么是这个12号甲板。杂音之后就完全没再说话了。"你不在那里并不是你的错，祖德。那些来看望你的人就是想让你明白这一点。那场火不是因为你……"啊！够了！无聊！愚蠢！真是浪费我的时间！

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/RudeZuudLoreFragmentE
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: [5] So many visitors, every one of them hoping to take something away. Dealing with them is like an uncomfortable dream, while speaking with Chatter is like being shaken awake. Are they real? How real are you, when you're sleeping? How real are you, floating, dreaming you are somewhere else? That's what Chatter wants to know. How did the women at my lock know my name?
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: [5] 来找我的人太多了，每个人都指望着能带走点东西。和她们打交道就像做了场烦人的梦，而和杂音说话就像猛地被摇醒。她们是真实存在的吗？当你入睡时，你能感受到几分真实？当你飘飘然梦到自己在别处，你能有多少真实可言？这就是杂音想要知道的事。那些守在我门外的女人，是怎么知道我名字的？
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.nameZh: 粗鲁的祖德的记忆碎片5/5
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionEn:
So many visitors, every one of them hoping to take something away. Dealing with them is like an  uncomfortable dream, while speaking with Chatter is like being shaken awake. Are they real? How real are you, when you're sleeping? How real are you, floating, dreaming you are somewhere else? That's what Chatter wants to know.

How did the women at my lock know my name?
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/SolarisFragm.descriptionZh:
这么多访客，每个都想带走点什么。和他们交涉就像一场令人不适的梦，然而和杂音对话就像被摇醒一样。他们是真实的吗？当你在睡觉的时候，你又有多真实？当你在梦中漂浮着、想象着自己在别的地方的时候，你又有多真实？那些就是杂音想要知道的。

那些在门外的女士们是怎么知道我的名字的？

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GlassFragmentA
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.secretTransmission__textEn: In the dying days of the Orokin, with forums and promenades still blood-wet from Tenno betrayal, a colossal Sentient descended upon Ancient Er, falling from distant stars to deliver upon Orokin a terrible and final ruin. Tower upon Tower fell to its weapons, but one withstood. The Tower of the Unum. The Tenno scattered, but one remained. Gara. She and the Unum - inseparable. The Unum: lodestone of our people, and subject of a hundred stories herself. The Sentient was a deformed creature, twisted and massive, sent from some dark fold of distant space^ a warped thing wounded by daylight. By night it was a terror, felling Tower after Tower, Citadel after Citadel. By day it hid, blinded and pained. It was during the day that Gara roamed, yearning to strike it from Creation while it cowered, weakened and blind, to safeguard her beloved Unum. But never could Gara find it.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.secretTransmission__textZh: 在奥罗金覆灭的末期，议事广场与回廊之上，Tenno 背叛所遗的血迹尚未干涸。就在此时，一只庞然的 Sentient 自远星陨落，降临于古老的埃尔，为奥罗金带来一场恐怖而终末的毁灭。它的炮火摧毁了一座又一座高塔，却唯有一座屹立不倒，那便是乌努母神之塔。Tenno 四散，唯有一人留下，她就是 Gara。她与乌努母神形影不离。乌努母神是我族的精神指引，她自身亦是无数传说的源头。那只 Sentient 是一头扭曲而庞大的畸形怪物，来自遥远深空的暗处。它生来残缺，畏惧日光的灼烧。夜幕降临，它便是恐怖的化身，接连摧毁一座又一座高塔与堡垒。白昼到来，它则蛰伏潜藏，强光令它目盲，痛苦不堪。于是 Gara 在白昼游猎，渴望趁这怪物蜷缩、虚弱、失明之时，将它从这造化天地间彻底抹去，以此守护她挚爱的乌努母神。然而 Gara 始终未能寻得它的踪迹。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.descriptionEn:
The children of Cetus can often be found chasing one another through streets and around landing bays, when not helping their families with chores or the running of businesses. Traditional games are popular, such as ‘Shunta' or ‘Kubrow and Vobi'. They can be found playing riding sticks, or floating boats made from stale, hollowed-out loaves of bread. 

Since the arrival of the Tenno a new form of play has emerged, in which children act out the tales they have heard of the Tenno.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.descriptionZh:
当不需要帮家里干杂活或者照看生意的时候，希图斯的孩童们经常在街道和着陆湾中嬉戏追逐。传统的游戏非常流行，比如"Shunta"或者"库狛与沃比"。有时会看到他们骑在树枝上玩耍，或者用不新鲜的中空面包当做小船漂在水中。

自从 Tenno 到来之后，一种新的游戏出现了，孩童们表演着听来的 Tenno 传说。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GlassFragmentB
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.secretTransmission__textEn: By night the Sentient was abroad, its titanic mass casting a terrible shadow across the land, the mass of it railing against the walls of the Tower, yet kept at bay by the exertion of the Unum's collossal will and the sacrifice of her faithful. But such exertions could not be maintained forever. Gara yearned to strike out, to lash and tear at the monstrosity that threatened her love, but the Unum forbade it. At night the Sentient was at the height of its power, and Gara's light would make her the most tempting of targets to a creature of such profound darkness. Gara's death would be certain. No. A different strategy was required.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.secretTransmission__textZh: 夜幕降临，Sentient 便四处肆虐。它那庞然的身躯在大地上投下恐怖阴影，狂怒地冲撞着高塔的墙垣。尽管乌努母神以无上的意志，加上忠诚信徒们的牺牲，将这怪物死死阻挡在外，但这样的苦撑终究无法长久。Gara 渴望主动出击，想将那头威胁她挚爱的怪物撕成碎片，但乌努母神阻止了她。每至夜晚，Sentient 的力量便攀至顶峰，而在那深暗至极的怪物眼中，Gara 耀眼的光芒，只会让她沦为最诱人的猎物。贸然出击，Gara 必死无疑。此路不通，必须另寻对策。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.descriptionEn:
The word ‘cetus', in the Ostron tongue, means ‘landless, cladeless; a body turned to dust turned to motes on a careless wind.' History says the town was founded as a home for anyone, regardless of clade, trade or origin. Friendships last a lifetime here. It is easy to imagine how, in the earliest days of Cetus - with the Eidolons roaming the Plains, the walls laid low and Grineer war parties pressing in - mutual support and protection would have been essential. 

As times have improved this trait has become a key part of Ostron culture.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.descriptionZh:
在 Ostron 人的语言中，"希图斯"意味着"没有土地，没有家族，随时可能在风中飘散成灰的人"。据历史所述，这座村庄建立时接纳了所有人，不论家族、职业和血统。在这里友谊长存。不难想象，在希图斯建立的早期——平野上有夜灵游荡，高墙倒伏，而 Grineer 战斗部队大军压境——因此互助协防一直都是至关重要的。

随着时代的进步，这种特质已经成为了 Ostron 文化的关键。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GlassFragmentC
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.secretTransmission__textEn: The Sentient prowled and pressed and failed, never risking too much - for the Sentient could not reproduce. What it lost it lost forever. It had killed many cities before, felled many Towers, but this little one prevailed. Why, it pondered in many voices, was that? The Unum knew she could not defend forever, nor could her faithful throw their bodies against the Sentient in perpetuity. So she gave her followers some of her blood - her refined Temple kuva - and they in turn gave it to the animals of the land, and the animals became an extension of her and she became an extension of them. And the animals roamed, and searched. And they found where the Sentient chose to hide itself.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.secretTransmission__textZh: 那只 Sentient 潜伏游走，步步紧逼，却屡屡受挫。它从不轻易涉险，因为 Sentient 无法繁衍。任何折损，皆无可挽回。它曾屠戮无数城池，倾覆无数高塔，唯独眼前这座孤塔始终屹立不倒。为什么？千万个声音在它体内低声盘问，究竟是为什么？乌努母神深知，死守终有尽头。她也不能让忠诚的信徒永远以血肉之躯去抵挡 Sentient。于是她向信徒赐下了自己的鲜血，那正是经过提纯的神殿赤毒。信徒们转而将鲜血喂给这片大地上的生灵。从此，生灵化作了她意志的延伸，而她也借由生灵感知四方。于是，生灵们四处游走，循迹追踪。最终，它们探明了那只 Sentient 的隐匿之所。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.descriptionEn:
What is known of the ancient warrior known as Gara comes to us from folklore and oral tradition. It is said she was the Unum's closest companion, and that when the Lotus instructed her children to flee Gara remained, refusing to leave the side of the one she loved best. 

When the Sentient was done razing a great many other Towers, when it turned its myriad eyes and receptors toward the Unum, it was Gara who gave herself to protect her friend - shattering the Sentient. The mindless monstrosities that now stride the Plains - the Teralysts - are all that remain of it.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.descriptionZh:
被称作 Gara 的古代战士因民间故事与口耳相传的传说而广为人知。据说她是乌努母神最亲密的伴侣，当 Lotus 命令她的孩子们逃离时，Gara 留了下来，拒绝离开她挚爱的身边。

当那 Sentient 夷平了许多其他高塔时，当它将无数的眼睛和感知器探向乌努母神时，是 Gara 献出生命保护了她——破碎了那只 Sentient。兆力使——这些无意识的怪物如今在平野上横行，则是它的的残余。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GlassFragmentD
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.secretTransmission__textEn: The Sentient sensed this subterfuge, and capturing one of the Unum's animals opened it up for examination. And what little of the Unum that was present there... lit the Sentient's mind like the dark star from which it had fallen. The Sentient, you see, could not procreate. But in the Temple kuva it tasted healing. Completeness. A future. It devoured each and every last Unum-animal, but it was not enough. The Sentient turned its hundreds of eyes toward the Tower with new understanding: it would not destroy the Tower. It would become the Tower. It would kill the Unum, take her place and, one with that healing palace, give birth to a race of itself. Gara and Unum knew where the Sentient was. The Sentient knew the Tower was the future of its race. The Sentient threw itself at the Tower, no longer cautious, taking great losses and knowing the prize was worthy of it. Should it succeed all losses would be replaced a thousand-fold. This is when, across the Plains, the great pylons ignited for the first time. Sheets of energy sprung up between them, powered by the will of the Unum at their epicenter, trapping the monstrosity within. Loyal Gara, unwilling to heed inaction any longer, broke from the side of the Unum and flew out at night, her eyes on the Sentient Mind.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.secretTransmission__textZh: Sentient 察觉了这场暗计。它捕获了一只被赐血的生灵，将其剖开查验。那生灵的体内，仅仅残存着一丝乌努母神的气息。可这微弱的痕迹，却犹如它坠落而来的那颗暗星，瞬间照亮了 Sentient 的心智。要知道，Sentient 无法繁衍。可在神殿赤毒中，它尝到了治愈的滋味。那是久违的完整，更是族群的未来。将所有承载神血的生灵吞食殆尽后，它仍觉远远不够。Sentient 将成百上千只眼睛转向高塔，终于有了新的明悟。它不再企图摧毁高塔，而是要成为这座高塔。抹杀乌努母神，取而代之。与那处治愈的殿堂融为一体，进而孕育出属于自己的种族。Gara 和乌努母神已然洞悉了 Sentient。而 Sentient 也同样清楚，这座高塔便是全族存续的希望。于是，它抛却一切谨慎，疯狂地扑向高塔。哪怕承受再惨烈的折损，眼前的渴求也值得付出任何代价。只要得偿所愿，失去的一切，都将以千百倍补偿回来。就在这一刻，平原之上，巨型塔柱首次爆发出光芒。能量光壁在塔柱之间拔地而起，由身处中心的乌努母神以无上意志驱动，将怪物死死困锁阵中。忠诚的 Gara 再也不愿坐视无为。她离开乌努母神身侧，毅然冲入黑夜，目光死死锁定 Sentient 的心智中枢。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.descriptionEn: The distant, mournful howls of the Eidolon - yearning for the terror it once was - drift through the alleys and byways, across rooftops, to the ears of sleeping families.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.descriptionZh: 夜灵遥远悲凄的哀嚎——渴求着昔日的恐怖——流转过小巷和旁路，穿过屋顶，进入熟睡的家庭耳中。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GlassFragmentE
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.secretTransmission__textEn: The Sentient, torn between its most coveted prize and a mortal threat, broke from the Tower and turned back on itself to defend itself from noble Gara. But Gara's eyes were not for the Sentient - but for the glittering, man-sized device resting just beyond the gates. It had not been there before, but it was there now. It swatted Gara from the sky, drew it to herself, meaning to end her life there and then. The battle was terrible. Gara sustained injuries she would not survive. But! In her final moments brave Gara seized upon the device her beloved Unum had crafted, seized it to her breast, and allowed the Sentient to draw her in one final time. Toward its body. Toward its core. Toward the seat of its intelligence. From within the Sentient unfurled myriad feelers, probes, tendrils - viciously-toothed and made for killing. They swept toward Gara, violently, and the Glass Warrior made no defense. Her defense was her final attack. The device detonated, and the Unum cried out as night lit as day. The battle - the terror - was ended. The Tower walls shook. The Sentient's body shuddered^ wracked by a cacophonous energy. Forests fell as piece after piece, giant body after giant body crashed to the Plains and marshes and flatlands. Animals fled in spreading waves from pounding sky-high walls of dust, angered and whipped to fury by the death of a god. The last of Gara's energy arced from body-to-body, machine-to-machine, piece-to-piece, a horizon-wide applause of light beautiful and terrible. And then… silence. All was still. The Unum's adherents wandered through the haze, calling for one another, lost in a miasma. Husbands seizing onto wives, children onto parents. It was over. Gara was never seen again. The Sentients, then, became as they are now: senseless, wandering, yearning for a unity they sense more than remember. And the Unum. The Unum survived, alone, for centuries. Until today. When you stand here, reading this. This is Onkko, Cetus Archivist, with my translation of the Gara legend.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.secretTransmission__textZh: Sentient 陷入两难，一边是它垂涎已久的至宝，一边是足以致命的威胁。它从高塔前抽身，回首迎战高贵的 Gara。可 Gara 的目光并未落在 Sentient 身上，而是落在大门之外那件闪耀的装置上。那装置约有一人大小，先前并不在那里，此刻却赫然伫立。Sentient 将 Gara 从空中击落，又将她拖向自己，妄图当场了结她的性命。那一战惨烈无比。Gara 身负致命重创，已无生还之机。然而，在生命最后的时刻，勇敢的 Gara 紧紧抓住了乌努母神为她铸造的装置，将它牢牢抱入怀中，任凭 Sentient 最后一次将她拽近，深入那庞然的躯体，没入那深邃的核心，抵达那心智的中枢。Sentient 体内骤然探出无数触手、刺针与绞须，根根生满倒刺，专为杀戮而生。它们狂暴地席卷向 Gara，而这位玻璃战士未作任何防御。她的防御，便是她最后的进攻。装置轰然引爆，黑夜瞬间亮如白昼，乌努母神发出阵阵悲鸣。这一战就此终结，那弥漫的恐惧也随之消散。高塔的墙垣震颤不止，Sentient 身躯剧烈抽搐，被一阵喧嚣的能量肆意撕扯。一块又一块残躯，一具又一具庞然巨体，接连坠向平原、沼泽与旷地，成片的森林为之轰然倒下。冲天尘墙轰然推进、狂暴翻涌，仿佛因神明陨落而震怒不已，走兽则如浪潮般四散奔逃。Gara 最后的能量在一具具躯体之间、一台台机器之间、一片片残骸之间跃迁闪烁，化作横贯天际的一场光之礼赞，既绚烂又骇人。而后，万物归于寂静。乌努母神的信徒在浊雾中徘徊，彼此呼唤，迷失其间。丈夫紧紧抓住妻子，孩子紧紧抱住父母。一切都结束了，Gara 从此再未现身。自此，Sentient 一族便成了今日这副模样，神智涣散，四处游荡，比起记忆，它们更多是凭借本能在渴望着曾经的完整。至于乌努母神，她活了下来，孤身守望了数个世纪。直到今日，当你立于此处，读到这些文字的此刻。我是希图斯典籍官昂克，以上便是我译述的 Gara 传说。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.descriptionEn:
Chimurr: Fill the gourd with bomba leaves, then add steaming water and imbibe through a burnished juta reed. A very old Ostron tradition. To serve it to guests signifies union and friendship. 

Harpu: fresh-brewed chimurr with melted vobi butter creates a filling, tasty beverage. It is often bulked out with salt and balb flour. Always served hot. 

Daku liquor: highly sought after. The Suma Doni (a lowlands marsupial) eats the peca nut, then excretes a fine paste. It is from this paste that Ostrons make daku liquor. 

Golden caviar: harvested from abyssal depths such as the Geonate Shelf. 

Kubuchi: fermented sorghum. Cheap liquor. No Ostron would be caught drinking it in public. Any offworlder who does is immediately seen as a greenhorn and an easy mark. 

Wine: some merchants claim to be able to imbue a bottle with the ‘etheric signature' of a person one wishes to be rid of. Drink them in the evening, expel them by morning. 

Ito-da (termite droppings): Mineral-dense. Will keep a traveler going long after hunger should have dropped them.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GlassFragmen.descriptionZh:
赤穆茶：将葫芦装满 bomba 叶，再加入开水，用一根铮亮的朱塔芦苇吸着喝。这是一种非常古老的 Ostron 传统，用来招待客人以彰显团结和友谊。

Harpu：刚酿好的赤穆茶和沃比黄油一起融化，创造出一道能填饱肚子的美味饮品。常常用盐和巴柏面粉使之膨胀。永远热腾腾地上桌。

Daku 酒：非常热门。Suma Doni（一种低地有袋类）吃下芘卡胡桃，排出精细的糊。从这种糊中 Ostron 人制作出 daku 酒。

黄金鱼子酱：收获自深海的深渊，比如 Geonate 大陆架。

库布奇酒：发酵的高粱。一种廉价的酒。Ostron 人绝对不会在公开场合喝它。任何公开喝这种酒的异世者立刻会被看做是好骗的愣头青。

葡萄酒：有些商人号称可以在瓶中注入你想要摆脱之人的"醚特征签名"。晚上灌醉那人，白天就能赶走了。

Ito-da（白蚁粪便）：富含矿物质。可以在饥饿击倒旅行者之前，让他们支撑很久。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GhoulFragmentA
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textEn: Every living thing longs to be whole. Every living thing yearns to defy death. If from death you returned, yet the part you loved best did not… what then?
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textZh: 一切生命都渴望完整，也都渴望挣脱死亡。如果你死而复生，你的挚爱却没能和你一起回来……那该如何是好？
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionEn:
"It came through the wall. All I remember is the roar, the open maw… the rank foulness of its breath. The lolling tongue. And… the way two of my friends were crushed between it and our grain silo. The way it seemed to fall in love with tearing them apart, over and over and over…"
Interviews in the Field, Eidolon Plains, conducted by Sigor Savah.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionZh:
"它破墙而至。我只记得那吼声，那张开的巨颚……那带有强烈腐臭味的吐息，垂下的舌头，还有……它将我的两个朋友连同我们的粮仓一起咬碎。它一遍又一遍地撕咬，似乎非常享受将猎物撕碎的快感……"
采访地点：夜灵平野的野外。采访者：西格·萨瓦。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GhoulFragmentB
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textEn: My name is Sigor Savah, morphology specialist with Nef Anyo's Venusian terraforming expedition. I was tasked with decoding the Orokin gene record of what had once been a preserve, and reviving select specimens for study. This is an account of my encounter with lifeform VK-7, a larger-than-average kavat specimen possessed of… atypical behavioural characteristics. Specimen VK-7, unlike the others, did not come from a gene record. She was found, frozen, in a sealed closet close to the environmental control station. Her unassuming tomb for millennia.Here, then, was an intact example of Orokin-era fauna. I was Corpus: a scientist second and a businessman first. VK-7 - an Orokin-strain kavat of unusual size and patterning… well… I could think of several members of the nobility who would pay a fortune for such a thing. Enough to buy a handsome slice of any planetoid of my choosing.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textZh: 我叫西格·萨瓦，是奈富·安尤的金星环境改造远征队的形态学专家。 我的任务，是解码这片昔日保护区留存的奥罗金基因档案，并复活选定个体以供研究。这份记录描述的，是我与 VK-7 生命体的相遇。她是一只体型远超平均水平的库娃，并表现出……非典型的行为特征。与其他个体不同，VK-7 并非源自基因档案。我们发现她时，她正被冰封在环境控制站附近的一个密封柜中。数千年来，那里就是她不起眼的坟墓。而摆在我面前的，是一只完整保存至今的奥罗金时代动物。我是地道的科普斯——逐利第一，科学第二。VK-7，一只奥罗金原生品种的库娃，有着极为罕见的体型和斑纹……呵……不少贵族估计都愿意斥巨资买下她。那笔钱足够让我在看中的小行星上，买下一大片地皮。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionEn:
"Its arms shot forward, the drills ratcheting outward… passing in and out of Horvath's body like it was nothing. I can still hear the screech of the drills. The maddening chatter of its teeth. Horvath's screams."
Interviews in the Field, Eidolon Plains, conducted by Sigor Savah.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionZh:
"它的双臂向前弹射出去，那钻头旋转着飞出……Horvath 的身体如同薄纸一般，瞬间就被刺破。即便是现在，我依然能听到那钻头发出的啸叫声，那牙齿所发出的狂乱之语，还有 Horvath 的哀嚎。"
采访地点：夜灵平野的野外。采访者：西格·萨瓦。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GhoulFragmentC
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textEn: I had the corpse lain on a dissection rack, ready for a full surgical examination. Then, like any animal dreaming, the paw… ...twitched. I glanced at the vitals scanner, expecting to see some anomalous electrical reaction taking place, contracting ancient muscles... but no. What I saw, there, was a beating heart. I did not revive Specimen VK-7. Before my eyes she willed herself back to life. It was… the most… beautiful… thing I had ever seen. Some speak of feeling a connection to something greater than themselves, to which I laughed, as any right-thinking Corpus would. Life is profit, profit is life. But, in that moment… watching that animal claw her way out of death's dark pit… though I did not admit it to myself… something in me was forever changed.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textZh: 我将样本的尸体放在解剖台上，准备进行全面的外科检查。就在那时，她如同正在做梦的动物一般，爪子突然动了一下。我瞥了一眼生命体征监测器，以为只是某种异常电流刺激了沉寂已久的肌肉……但不是。我看到的，是一颗正在跳动的心脏。我还什么都没有做，她凭借自己的意志复活了。那是……我这辈子见过的……最美的景象。有的人说能感受到与某些比自身更伟大的存在之间的联系，对此我向来嗤之以鼻，任何头脑正常的科普斯都会如此。生命就是利润，利润就是生命。可就在那一刻……看着她在我眼前挣脱了死亡的束缚……尽管当时的我不愿承认……可我心中的某些东西，就此永远改变了。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionEn:
"It came at me, wailing, like a lost thing screaming for help. Then it wrapped its clay-cold arms about me… and here I am. Barely anything left of me now, lying in this bed, except a few stories… and the memory of its face. Like a newborn child."
Interviews in the Field, Eidolon Plains, conducted by Sigor Savah.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionZh:
"它朝我过来，哀号着，如同一只正在求救的生物。随后，它用如同陶土般冰冷的手臂将我缠住……把我变成了现在这副样子。我拖着一副所剩无几的身体，躺在床上，如同一个新生儿。现在我所剩下的，只有一些故事……和关于它样貌的记忆。"
采访地点：夜灵平野的野外。采访者：西格·萨瓦。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GhoulFragmentD
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textEn: I found her sharp gaze unsettling. The way she would watch my every move from her cage unnerved me. When a visitor came I would watch VK-7 studying their habits. In time she came to anticipate regular arrivals, having memorized their schedules. On the morning of my fourth shift I entered my laboratory to find her cage door open, and VK-7 gone. One consequence of breathing life back into a world is unintentionally resurrecting lifeforms and viruses one finds less desirable. The Infestation is both of those things. Reports returned of some hive sites found destroyed… and then of a large beast found at others. An animal intelligent enough to learn and react to Corpus behaviors and patterns. Some claimed it had learned to measure ammunition expenditure to better attack when a target was most vulnerable. Needless to say almost none who attacked the beast survived. This had to be Specimen VK-7.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textZh: 她锐利的目光让我深感不安。待在笼中时，她会盯着我的每一个动作，让人脊背发凉。每当有访客到来，我会观察 VK-7 是如何学习访客的习惯。不假多时，她就记住了所有人的日程，甚至能预料他们造访的时间。在我第四次轮班的早晨，我照常踏入实验室，却发现关她的笼门大开，而 VK-7 不知所踪。让某些生命复活的代价，就是可能会无意中唤醒那些你不希望看到的生命体和病毒。而感染者兼具了这两者。随后陆续传回的报告称，一些巢囊被彻底摧毁……另一些巢囊附近则发现了一头巨兽。一头聪明到能观察、学习并针对科普斯行为模式作出应对的动物。有人声称，她甚至学会了估测敌人的弹药消耗，专挑对方最脆弱的时机发动袭击。不用说，遭遇这头野兽的人几乎无一生还。那一定就是样本 VK-7。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionEn:
"Konzu gave us standing orders. Shoot the sawmen first. We'd seen what they had done to our brothers and sisters. That was not going to happen to us."
Interviews in the Field, Eidolon Plains, conducted by Sigor Savah.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionZh:
"孔尊给我们下达了作战命令。先朝那些电锯兵射击。我们已经见识过他们对我们的兄弟姊妹所做的事。我们绝不能让那些悲剧在我们身上重演。"
采访地点：夜灵平野的野外。采访者：西格·萨瓦。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GhoulFragmentE
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textEn: I left to join with a flamer team already deployed to a nearby hive. Both team and hive were dead when I arrived: killed by tooth and claw. Fearing for my life I made to leave, and was apprehended by the site of a low figure blocking my egress: Specimen VK-7. She prowled forward from the shadow of a shattered, snow-blown hive, her pawprints red with blood. I made to open a comm channel, to request assistance. VK-7 growled, low, and… I swear this to be true… slowly shook her head. I did not make that call. She padded closer, and I saw the wound on her side. She turned that side toward me: an act of trust… and a request for aid. I unpacked my field kit and, carefully, went to work.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textZh: 我动身前去与一支部署在附近巢囊的喷火兵小队会合。等我抵达时，小队和巢囊都已无生机。他们尽数被尖牙和利爪撕碎。我担心自己性命不保，正打算离开，却被堵在出口处的一道低矮身影摄住了心神——是样本 VK-7。她从覆着雪的破碎巢囊阴影中缓缓踱出，每个爪印都被鲜血染红。我伸手准备接通通信频道呼叫支援。VK-7 发出一声低吼，然后……我发誓这是真的……她缓缓摇了摇头。最终我没有发出呼叫。她轻轻走近，我这才看到她侧腹的伤口。她将受伤的一侧朝向了我——那是对我的信任……也是在向我求助。我打开野外急救包，小心翼翼地开始为她处理伤口。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionEn:
I came to the Eidolon Plains not to explore horror, but to lay to rest an ancient mystery. It would seem, horror had something to say, regardless.

The Ghouls. Grown in darkness, beneath the feet of the enemy. Born to fight.. To kill… and to die.

Truly, of all the places horror may call home, it is most comfortable within the imaginings of men.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionZh:
我来到夜灵平野并不是为了探寻恐怖之物，而是为了解开一个上古谜团。不过，这趟旅途似乎终究无法摆脱恐怖的萦绕。

尸鬼。成长于敌人脚下的黑暗之中。生来就是为了战斗……杀戳……和死亡。

实话说，尽管恐怖之物可以出现在很多地方，但它们最喜欢的地方，还是人们的脑海。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GhoulFragmentF
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textEn: I did not report my experience with Specimen VK-7. I could not admit why, then, but now I can tell you. I felt it would have violated a trust. There I was: a morphology specialist, sworn to the Corpus Empire, and yet... for reasons entirely illogical... I placed loyalty to a wild animal above my life oath... and every doctrine that values self-interest above ... 'charity.' But keep that confidence I did. I think that is why VK-7 brought me the hand.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textZh: 我没有上报我与样本 VK-7 相遇的经过。当时我也不清楚个中缘由，但现在我可以告诉你。我觉得那么做，会辜负她对我的信任。当时的我是一名形态学专家，宣誓效忠科普斯帝国。可我却……出于某种完全不合逻辑的理由……把对一只野生动物的忠诚，置于我的毕生誓言之上……也置于那些崇尚私利、鄙视「慈善」的教条之上。但我确实替她保守了秘密。我想，正因如此，VK-7 才会把那只断手给我。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionEn:
The Ghouls are designed to a simple philosophy: victory assured, through overwhelming numbers and the element of surprise.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionZh:
尸鬼被设计为一种头脑简单的生物：他们只会通过人海和突袭战术来取得胜利。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GhoulFragmentG
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textEn: Somehow she had managed to infiltrate the facility, bypass two different security gates, and had gained entry to my laboratory without raising an alarm… or my awareness. She held in her jaws a severed hand. Blackened. Fossilised. Gently, she laid it before me and, with a meaningful glance, turned, padded away into the shadows, and was gone. I analyzed the hand. What I learned that night, alone, in my laboratory, would become an obsession to focus the remainder of my life.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textZh: 不知用了什么办法，她居然潜入了设施，绕过两道不同的安保闸门，悄无声息地进入我的实验室。没有触发警报……甚至连我都没有察觉。她的嘴里叼着一只断手。那只手焦黑，已经石化了。她将断手轻轻放在我面前，意味深长地看了我一眼，随后转身悄然隐入阴影之中，消失不见。之后我分析了那只手。那一夜，我独自在实验室中发现的真相，成为了我余生唯一追逐的执念。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.nameEn: A Tide of Claws and Flesh
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionEn:
Sudden terror… the element of surprise… and cheaply bought. Ghouls are shock troops, fast-grown in diapause bags, cultured from repurposed Grineer gene slurry. The key to victory is quantity over quality. A tide of claws and flesh to crush any enemy foolish enough to stand before it.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionZh:
突现的恐怖……偷袭战术……且成本低廉。尸鬼是突击部队，他们能在休眠袋中以惊人的速度成长，通过改造过的 Grineer 基因浆培育。用数量代替质量是他们的制胜理念。任何胆敢阻挡他们的对手，都会被潮水一般的利爪和血肉所粉碎。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GhoulFragmentH
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textEn: The hand was of Orokin construction. Emphasis on that last word. Whoever the original possessor had been, they were born of no mother. In the past I had been privileged to read some of Alad V's treatises on Warframes, and there could be no mistake: what I held was the hand of one of those very… creatures… and one Anyo Corp had no record of. Therefore my first task was to extract a working blueprint - or as near as possible - from the sample's cellular makeup. One word recurred again and again, the word that had once been her name: Khora. Khora.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textZh: 那只手是奥罗金制造的。重点在于「制造」二字。无论它原本属于谁，都绝非肉体凡胎所生。过去，我有幸拜读过阿拉德 V 几篇关于战甲的论文，因此绝不会认错——我手中握着的，正是那种……造物……的手。而安尤企业的档案中，根本没记录过这种型号。于是，我的首要任务，就是从样本的细胞构成中提取一份可用的蓝图——或者说尽可能还原它。在破译过程中，一个词反反复复出现，那是她曾经的名字：Khora。Khora。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionEn:
While not of Vor's design, the General uses the ghouls to good effect.

Credit for the development of these horrors goes to none other than Doctor Tengus: father of the infamously unstable Grustrag 3. Developed in his laboratories, against the wishes of Vor himself, and with the funding of a certain ill-fated Counsellor… the Ghouls are Tengus' crowning achievement.
