They have secured the Doctor's place in the good graces of the Grineer Queens.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionZh:
尽管尸鬼并非出自沃尔之手，但这位将军很好地运用了尸鬼的能力。

在这恐怖之物的研发过程中起到关键作用的人，自然要算 Tengus 博士——他是臭名昭彰的 Grustrag 三霸之父。尽管沃尔反对这项研究计划，但某位命运多舛的议员却为之提供了资金支持，并最终让尸鬼的研究获得成功……尸鬼是 Tengus 所取得的最高成就。

博士也因此获得了 Grineer 女皇们的嘉奖。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GhoulFragmentI
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textEn: I was convinced: Specimen VK-7 wanted Khora resurrected. Why else bring the hand to me? Why trust me with this sole remaining piece of a lost Orokin warrior? The evidence of such rich, nuanced cognition on the part of an animal… that was the real treasure here - the value of which, I knew, would be lost on my superiors. VK-7 would be hunted down and, at best, captured for testing. At worst… well. Therefore I told them none of this. To no avail.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textZh: 我无比确信，样本 VK-7 想让我复活 Khora。不然为何要将这只手带给我？为何要将这位失落奥罗金战士仅存的残肢托付给我？一只动物，竟拥有如此丰富而细腻的认知……这才是真正的无价之宝——可我清楚，我的上级根本不关心这种价值。他们会追捕 VK-7，最好的结果是被抓去做实验。最坏的话……就不必说了。因此，我向他们隐瞒了这一切。可惜，终究还是徒劳。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionEn:
Ghouls are far from the finest of Grineer troops, but what they lack in martial skill they make up for in sheer horrifying volume.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionZh:
尸鬼远远不是 Grineer 最优秀的士兵，但他们军事技能上的缺陷由绝对的恐怖数量所弥补。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GhoulFragmentJ
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textEn: Specimen VK-7 was tracked to a box canyon 4.3 klicks south-southwest of the atmosphere processing station. The Horror of the Hives, as she had come to be known, had been deemed unworthy of study - and was to be destroyed in her lair. I positioned myself at the entrance to her cave-home and waited... to doom myself in the name of some imagined ideal. My own voice screamed in my head "What are you doing? What are you *doing?*" Once, not so long before, I was a man who would have sold this animal for profit. Now I stood in the freezing cold, surrendering all I had for… some would say nothing. I would say... heh. Something greater than myself. They came, picking their way through the snow, heads bowed, pushing against a numbing, slashing wind that froze skin and... carried my voice to them. I begged them to stop, pleading VK-7s case... with a bomb in my hand. It went about as well as you'd expect. They did not listen. Numsol is employed, traditionally, as an animal tranquilizer... but converts to an aerosol easily enough. The canister rolled from my fingers, into the canyon, puffed through four inches of frost, and erupted in a geyser of brown-green gas - thrown toward the hunters by that roaring wind. Bathing them. I am a better scientist than saboteur. Their respirators dealt with the numsol as handily as every other contaminant, and I was promptly arrested. But VK-7 did escape. I achieved that much.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textZh: 我们在大气处理站西南偏南 4.3 公里外的一座箱型峡谷中，发现了 VK-7 的踪迹。那时她有了一个称号——「巢囊梦魇」。上面认定她已不具备研究价值，决定将她连同她的巢穴一并摧毁。我守在她洞穴的入口等待着……准备为某种或许只存在于想象中的信念，迎接自己的毁灭。脑海中的声音不断冲我尖叫：「你在干什么？你到底在干什么？」就在不久之前，我还是个只会把她卖掉换取利润的小人。如今，我却站在刺骨的寒风中，甘愿放弃自己拥有的一切，只为了有些人眼中的微不足道。而我会说……呵呵。为了某些比我更伟大的存在。他们来了，低着头在雪地中艰难跋涉，顶着冻僵皮肤、如刀割般刺骨的狂风……风把我的话带给了他们。我哀求他们停手，为 VK-7 辩护……手中还握着一枚炸弹。结果如你所料，他们根本不听。镇定凝胶通常被用作动物镇定剂……不过把它制成气溶胶也不难。炸药罐从我指间滚落，棕绿色的气体如喷泉般涌出，被咆哮的狂风吹向刺杀小队，将他们完全笼罩。只可惜，我作为科学家还行，当个搅局的实在业余。他们的呼吸器就像过滤其他污染物一样，轻易过滤了凝胶气体。我也随即遭到逮捕。不过 VK-7 成功逃脱。我能做的也仅此而已。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionEn:
Ghouls are deployed in advance of regular Grineer troops. Before then, those troops must keep the ghouls sated… lest they turn upon those who failed to feed them.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionZh:
尸鬼会被部署在常规 Grineer 部队之前。直到部署前，必须先满足尸鬼的口腹……以免他们倒戈攻击喂不饱他们的部队。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GhoulFragmentK
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textEn: The atmosphere processor wasn't made for imprisonment, or interrogations, but the lack of facilities did not prevent them performing both. Bound and beaten in maintenance closet A-5, I told them everything. It doomed me. Zyl, the oxygen tech from Reclamation 3, had a previous career in psychological operations for some branch of the military. Therefore he had been selected to administer to me, to interview me and, ultimately, to execute me. Barrel pressed to my forehead Zyl said he would prefer it if I did not look at him. Obliging as ever, I closed my eyes. There was a sharp crack, then nothing more. I opened my eyes. Zyl lay dead at my feet, limp, throat clasped in VK-7's jaws. I was Corpus no longer. Remaining on Venus would be death for both of us. We had to escape.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textZh: 大气处理站原本并不是监狱，也不是审讯室。不过，设施不全也没妨碍他们进行监禁和审讯。我被绑在维修储藏室 A-5 里，挨了一顿毒打，最后交代了一切。我注定难逃一死。齐尔是来自三号回收区的氧气技术员，早年曾在军方某个部门从事心理战工作。因此他被指派来处置我、审问我，并最终将我处决。枪口顶着我的脑门时，齐尔说，希望我不要看着他。我一如既往地顺从，闭上了眼。接着我听到了一声脆响，之后再无动静。我睁开眼睛，发现齐尔瘫倒在我脚边，已经没气了，喉咙被 VK-7 紧紧咬住。我不再是科普斯的一员。继续留在金星，对我们俩来说都是死路一条。我们必须逃走。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionEn:
Especially degenerate Ghoul specimens are employed as suicide troops
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionZh:
尤其是那些退化了的尸鬼样本，被用作自杀部队。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GhoulFragmentL
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textEn: Together we made for an automated cargo relay - one that would ferry us anonymously to the hold of a Solaris rail tractor in geosynchronous orbit, and away from Venus. How well she guided me, circumnavigating patrols and security cameras. But, inevitably, my former comrades calculated our likely destination and closed in, rapidly. Plasma blasts lanced the air from both sides of the hangar. I bundled myself into the nearest open conveyor, bound for orbit - a waste of time, I knew. We had reached our means of escape, but had no hope of achieving it. Troopers and Moas closed in, in a classic pincer movement. Sparks and near-misses flashed hot against my face. In moments our conveyance would be destroyed, and us along with it - and my only thought was heartbreak for how badly I had failed her. In that final moment VK-7 did something that will stay with me for the rest of my days. With one of her meaningful glances - the last we would ever share - she reared up and activated the conveyor. My pod's door slammed shut and, outside my viewport, she leapt toward the enemy. Before I could slap the release and free myself the magrails activated and I was hauled out of the complex, skyward, and into orbit. Saved. Leaving her behind.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textZh: 我们一起逃往一座自动化货运站。从这里可以神不知鬼不觉地把我们运到同步轨道上的索拉里斯航道牵引机的货舱里，从而带我们离开金星。她一路引领着我，巧妙绕过巡逻队和监控探头。可不出所料，我的前同事很快推算出了我们的目的地，迅速包围了过来。等离子光束撕裂了机库两侧。我钻进最近的运输舱，准备前往轨道——我知道这不过是苟延残喘。逃生的跳板就在眼前，但我们没机会向前了。士兵和恐鸟用经典的两翼包抄阵型向我们逼近。火花和近在咫尺的流弹擦过我的脸颊，炽热无比。再过片刻，我们的运输舱将被摧毁，我们也会葬身于此。可我脑中唯一的念头，竟然是因为自己辜负了她而感到无比心碎。就在最后一刻，VK-7 做出了让我余生都无法忘怀的事。她意味深长地看了我一眼——那是我们最后一次对视——她直立起身，启动了运载装置。舱门在我面前砰地关上。透过观察窗，我看到她纵身扑向敌人。还没等我按下释放按钮解开自己，磁力轨道便已启动，我被强制弹出设施，冲向天空，进入了轨道。我得救了，但她永远留在了那里。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionEn:
They are incapable of fear. Relentless.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionZh:
他们无法感到恐惧、残酷无情。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/GhoulFragmentM
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textEn: That was… well, many years ago, now. I have spent my life attempting to locate Khora's remains. Contacts inform me she was found, fused but intact, within the Orokin terraforming complex itself and shipped offworld via a notorious Solaris rail agent - who subsequently vanished. I now believe, firmly, that her remains are to be found on the Eidolon Plains. I go there now, entrusting these encrypted logs to my old friend, Konzu, for safekeeping. There I shall put a lifetime of searching to rest. I have never doubted that VK-7 survived Venus. And to this day I still believe that, before I leave this life forever, I shall one day look up from my writings to find a familiar figure standing in my doorway… alongside her kavat. I am Sigor Savah. A better man, as it turns out, than a scientist.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.secretTransmission__textZh: 那是……呃，很多年前的事了。此后，我倾尽余生寻找 Khora 的遗骸。线人告诉我，有人在奥罗金环境改造设施内部找到了她。虽然尸身被熔封，但整体保存完好。随后，一个臭名昭著的索拉里斯航道特工把她运出了金星——而特工也从此销声匿迹。如今我坚信，她的遗骸就在夜灵平野。我即刻就要动身前往那里，将这些加密日志托付给我的老朋友孔尊代为保管。在那里，我会让毕生的搜寻有个了结。我始终坚信 VK-7 活着逃离了金星。时至今日，我依然相信，在我离世前，终有一天我在案前抬起头的时候，会看到一个熟悉的身影伫立在我的门口……身旁还跟着她的库娃。我是西格·萨瓦。事实证明，比起当个科学家，我更适合当个好人。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionEn:
Massive casualties may be inflicted upon massed ranks of ghouls without slowing their advance.

This is a new phase in the Grineer campaign for dominance in the Origin System.

One that has increased the stakes for every sentient being who calls it home.

Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/GrineerGhoul.descriptionZh:
大规模的尸鬼部队可以造成巨量的杀伤，并且他们的行进速度完全不会受到影响。

这是 Grineer 统治始源星系战役的全新阶段。

在这个阶段里，对于以此为家的众生而言，是更加危险了。

西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentA
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: In the age after the fall of the Orokin the grand clade-families of the Ostrons were cast wide across the solar system, roaming and homeless in their great floating markets.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 奥罗金陨落后的岁月里，奥斯特朗人的庞大枝族散落于太阳系各处，栖身于巨大的移动集市，四处游荡，无家可归。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn: The site of the final battle between the Unum's champion, Gara, and the colossal Sentient that wished to claim the Tower's regenerative qualities for itself. Today the remains of the Sentient, diminished and confused, wander the Plains - seeking a cohesion the Ostrons hope it shall never find.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh: 这里是乌努母神的战士，Gara，与妄图夺取高塔治愈能力的巨大 Sentient 决战的场所。如今这些 Sentient 的残骸已经变得衰退而混乱，在平野上徘徊——寻求再次的凝聚，而 Ostron 但愿这永远不会成真。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentB
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: In this time two young people were in love: the woman Er-Phryah and the man Mer-Sah. Er-Phryah was from the yingbindunyai clade (meaning "great bond"): a very old and wealthy compact of bonded families.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 在这样的年代里，有两个年轻人相爱了：女的名叫埃尔-芙丽雅，男的名叫弥尔-撒。埃尔-芙丽雅来自英宾杜奈枝族（意为「伟大的羁绊」），那是一个由许多结盟家族缔结而成的联盟，古老而富有。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn:
Many questions remain: what is the true history of Cetus? Who is the Unum and for how long has she been one with the living Tower? What is her relationship to the Quills and what hidden purpose do they serve? The Archivist, Onkko, preserved much of the old folklore but how much of that is true?

If there is any kind of scheme to the unfolding of things, some end-point in sight, then one thing is certain: the arrival of the Tenno in Cetus is no accident.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh:
许多问题仍然存疑：希图斯真正的历史是如何的？谁又是乌努母神，她又与那座活着的塔共存了多久？她和夜羽的关系是如何的，而夜羽们又是为了什么样隐藏的目的而工作？档案保管人，昂克，保存了大量民俗知识，但其中又有多少是真实的？

假如说，事物的演变蕴含着阴谋，视野有着终点，那么有一件事是确定的：Tenno 来到希图斯绝不是偶然。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentC
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: Mer-Sah, however, had no clade: his family having been shattered by the Grineer many years before. He was cetus, meaning 'landless, cladeless^ a body turned to dust turned to motes on a careless wind.' Er-Phryah belonged to families within families. Mer-Sah was alone.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 然而，弥尔-撒却没有枝族，他的家族多年前便被克隆尼摧毁了。他是一个「希图斯」，意思是「没有土地，没有枝族；躯体化为尘土，又化作微尘，散入无情的风中」。埃尔-芙丽雅身处层层相属的家族之中，而弥尔-撒却孤身一人。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn:
"Khanung! Khanung! Clear Ingress Four-Two-Seven-Five! Shock charges have been affixed! Evacuate five hundred meters boomward! Prepare to make fire! Prepare to make fire!"

The Unum specifies which part of her Temple-body may be harvested, and when. In this manner her body eternally replenishes, providing her people with flesh to sell, Temple-kuva to refine and oils with which to make remarkable unguents. On occasion, nestled within the substrata of her being, a rare discovery awaits: forgotten technology. Proto-essence. Things which lure travelers from across the system, and so are a bounty for her people.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh:
"当心！当心！清空入口4-2-7-5！冲击载荷已经附着！疏散爆破方向五百米内！准备好点火！准备好点火！"

乌努母神详细列举了她哪部分的神殿身躯可以被收割，以及何时收割。以这种方式，她的身躯可以永续地再度补充，使得她的子民有肉可以贩卖，有神殿赤毒可以精炼，有油脂可以制作非凡的药膏。偶尔，在她的基质下裹挟着稀有的发现：失落的科技。原初精华。这些东西诱惑着全星系的旅行者们，也因此成为了她的子民的宝物。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentD
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: But, to Er-Phryah, Mer-Sah was a poet who had eyes to see the beauty of things and ears to hear the softly whispered language of the universe. 'I know a place,' he said. 'Where I may be homeless no more. I have heard a voice, and it leads me there. Come with me.'
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 不过，在埃尔-芙丽雅眼里，弥尔-撒是一位诗人，他的双眼能看见万物之美，他的双耳能听见宇宙那轻柔的低语。「我知道一个地方，」他说，「在那里，我将不再无家可归。我听见了一个声音，它指引我前往那里。随我来吧。」
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn:
Swazdo-lah - a common greeting
Sho-lah - 'farewell'
Surah - 'friend'
Dah-dap - 'thank-you'
Ai yo - a common exclamation. Could be thought of as 'oh my'
Lok heb - 'hail'
Chut! - 'silence!' (request for)
Kruna metta - an imploration. 'please'.
Khanung! - a warning
Utz - a universal emphatic, appended to the end of a descriptor ("I am happy utz.") 'Very'
Doh-ga - Urgency. 'hurry'
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh:
Swazdo-lah - 常用问候语
Sho-lah - "再见"
Surah - "朋友"
Dah-dap - "谢谢你"
Ai yo - 常用惊叹词。可以被理解为"（哎呦，）我的天呐"
Lok heb - "打招呼"
Chut！- "安静！"（征求语气）
Kruna metta - 表示恳求。"请"。
Khanung！- 表示警告。
Utz - 表示通用的语气加强，置于形容词之后。（"我高兴 utz"。）"非常"
Doh-ga - 表示紧急。"赶快"

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentE
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: But Er-Phryah's father was a man made foolish by his wealth, and vociferously disapproved of their love. Mer-Sah was cast adrift from the floating market that was home to his one true love.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 可是，埃尔-芙丽雅的父亲却是个被财富冲昏头脑的人，他声色俱厉地反对这对年轻人相爱。弥尔-撒因此被逐出移动集市，被迫离开了他此生唯一的挚爱。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn:
The Unum gives of herself, decreeing what parts of her Temple-body may be harvested for the good of Cetus. Drillers, climbing great scaffolds, punch cavities into the Temple wall which are then packed with mighty shock charges. The call ‘prepare to make fire!' echoes across the rooftops, and all know to clear the streets and alleys boomward of the harvest. The detonations rupture the sacred flesh, freeing great blanketpieces which are, in turn, pulled free and rolled down via the use of long billhooks. It is then the duty of agile balloon drop-drivers to deliver this bounty to the butchers below.

Flensers: those who carve up the Temple's flesh.

Eruptors: those who lay shock charges along chosen lines, and ‘make fire', loosening the carved flesh for removal by balloon.

Retrievers: those who wring all oil from scrubs at the end of a shift.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh:
乌努母神献出了自己，决定了她哪部分的神殿身躯是可以为了希图斯而收割的。钻工们爬上巨大的脚手架，把神殿的墙壁凿除孔洞，然后在其中填满强力的冲击载荷。"准备好点火！"的呼号响彻屋顶，所有人都知道要撤出爆破方向的街道和小巷。爆炸物割开了神圣的肉，使得大块毯状的肉松动，随后被钩镰拉扯下，并滚落。接下来就是灵巧的气球空投手的工作，将这份宝物送到下方的屠户手中。

剥皮手：这些人切开神殿的肉。

爆破手：这些人将冲击载荷安置在选好的线路上，并且"点火"，使得切开的肉松动，好让气球挪走。

回收手：这些人负责在每一班结束时拧出所有的油脂。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentF
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: Er-Phryah and Mer-Sah ran away together, as lovers do, and were never heard from again. Rent by grief her family thought her dead. Her father passed away, clutching her cameo, at peace thinking he would see her soon in some moonlit afterlife.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 埃尔-芙丽雅和弥尔-撒像所有相爱的恋人那样，私奔远走，从此杳无音讯。家人悲痛欲绝，以为她已不在人世。她的父亲临终时，手中紧攥着那枚刻着她容貌的浮雕饰物，心怀安宁，深信不久后便能在月光下的来世与女儿重逢。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn: Perhaps it is a by-product of the Sentient's body being scattered across the Plains. It may be that the Tower is here for this very reason. Or, perhaps, it's just chance… but the Plains are mineral- and resource-rich. So much so that the Grineer risk Ostron retaliation, the wrath of the Tenno and the rage of the Eidolon itself to mine this place.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh: 也许这是 Sentient 的身躯四散在平野的副产品。也许这可能是高塔坐落在这里的原因。或者，也许，只是巧合……但是平野有着丰富的矿物和资源。因此冒着被 Ostron 人报复、激怒 Tenno 和惹怒夜灵的风险，Grineer 在这里进行着采矿。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentG
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: Decades later, ships entering ancient Er's orbit were hailed from the planet's poisoned surface by an old woman's voice, gentle and knowing. Traders would call for her, greet her, offer the latest news on their families and lives - but never did they learn anything of this woman, save that she had a husband and they were, somehow, happy living on the toxic skin of that hostile world. The old woman would always - always - ask those travellers of news of the yingbindunyai clade.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 几十年过去了。每当飞船驶入阋神星那远古的轨道，这颗星球被剧毒侵蚀的地表，总会传来一位老妇人的声音，温柔而通透，向旅人致意。商人们会主动呼唤她、问候她，向她说起家人与生活的种种近况。然而，他们始终无从得知这位妇人的来历，只知道她有一个丈夫，二人不知何故，竟能在这颗充满敌意的星球那剧毒的表层上幸福地生活着。而那位老妇人，每一次，无一例外，总会向过往的旅人打听英宾杜奈枝族的消息。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn: The Eidolon is no common beast of the Plains, and cannot be laid low with the tools of an everyday hunter. These ‘amps' focus the user's will into a killing beam, capable of eventually bringing one of these giant monstrosities down.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh: 夜灵并非平野中一般的野兽，寻常猎人的工具难以使其屈服。这些"增幅器"，能将操控者的意志聚焦成致命的光束，最终得以将这种庞然大物击倒。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentH
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: Yingbindunyai junkers came searching for a sign of their missing daughter. The frail voice of their long-lost child reached out to them, and there was much joy. You will find us, her message said, by the light of our love.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 英宾杜奈枝族的人们驾着飞船，前来寻找失踪女儿的踪迹。那个失散多年的孩子，用微弱的声音向他们传来了讯息，一家人喜极而泣。她在讯息中说，循着我们爱的光芒，你们便能找到我们。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn:
Secretive and respected, the Quills are the Unum's closest adherents. Strange and reserved, their bond to her and each other makes for a strange relationship with causality. 

"We are each one viewpoint within the myriad that comprises the Unum. We watch, we anticipate, we intercede."
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh:
行事隐秘而又备受尊重，夜羽是乌努母神最亲密的信徒。陌生而又高冷，他们与她以及他们之间的纽带通过因果产生了一种奇特的关联。

"我们是组成乌努母神的无穷视角之一。我们监察，我们预测，我们斡旋。"

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentI
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: Er-Phryah bade them make their home around a magnificent Orokin ruin, promising them that it would be a source of prosperity for generations to come. The yngbindunyai arrived in their vast floating market. There, by a ragged coastline, winked a point of light. Follow the brightness of the love between Mer-Sah and I, said the message, and be safe from all harm.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 埃尔-芙丽雅嘱咐族人们环绕一座宏伟的奥罗金遗迹安家，并许诺此地将为他们带来世代不绝的繁荣。英宾杜奈枝族乘着他们庞大的移动集市，抵达了这里。在那崎岖破碎的海岸旁，一点微光正闪烁着。讯息中说，循着我与弥尔-撒之间那爱的光芒，你们便可免受一切伤害。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn:
"Attachment is pain. Whatever you wish to gain or lose is a door, behind which lies grace."

"My door is a shipment of rubedo and the cost of opening it would be...?"

"3000 credits, plus tax."
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh:
"依恋是一种痛苦。不论你希望获得什么还是失去什么都是一道门，门后则有着恩典。"

"我的门是一批红化结晶，而打开它的代价是……？"

"3000 现金，不含税。"

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentJ
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: The wrathful Grineer took umbrage at this and sought to block their passage but, upon approaching that ancient Orokin tower, found their transmissions silenced, their engines turned cold, and their weapons reduced to lumps of dead iron.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 暴怒的克隆尼对此深感不满，企图阻断他们的去路。然而，他们的舰队一旦靠近那座古老的奥罗金塔，通讯便会陷入沉寂，引擎彻底熄火，武器也尽数化作一堆毫无生气的废铁。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn: The Orokin Empire may have receded into the mists of history, but what it left behind is repurposed by those who remain.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh: 奥罗金帝国也许早已衰退在了历史的迷雾中，但是它所留下的被存活下来的人重新地改造了。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentK
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: She was a being of the day^ her husband, a spirit of the night. Er-Phryah was a woman of the land^ Mer-Sah a man of the sea. Mer-Sah understood the crushing weight of time in which Er existed. In return Er gifted pieces of its ancient self to Mer-Sah: old things shaped to near shapelessness by a thousand years beneath the waves. Mer-Sah was a man dedicated to finding the sacred in the forgotten, the neglected. And took wisdom from them.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 她是属于白昼的生灵，她的丈夫则是黑夜的精魂。埃尔-芙丽雅属于大地，弥尔-撒属于海洋。弥尔-撒读懂了阋神星，读懂了这颗星球在亘古岁月中承受的千钧重压。作为回报，阋神星将自身远古的碎片赠予了他，那些古物沉于浪涛之下千年之久，早已被磨蚀得几近无形。弥尔-撒毕生都在被遗忘、被冷落的事物里追寻神圣，再从中汲取智慧。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn: Despatched to the Plains to assist in efforts to harness and understand the Eidolons, these shock troops stand vigil over Grineer operations. They wait for the day when the power of that lobotomized Sentient might be turned to their own ends… and loosed against the walls of Cetus.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh: 被派向平野来协助驾驭和理解夜灵，这些突击部队监守着 Grineer 的行动。他们静候着天明，在那时那些迟钝的 Sentient 的力量也许会有所收敛……并且被希图斯的墙所消耗。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentL
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: After many decades Mer-Sah had a small collection of such gifts - such that they could be held in two cupped hands - but in them he understood the lifespan of a world. And so he had struck an accord with the creatures of the sea.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 几十年过去，弥尔-撒只攒下了一小捧这样的馈赠。尽管仅凭双手便能捧起，他却在其中参透了一个世界的存亡兴衰。于是，他与海中生灵缔结了契约。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn: Finding worth in the worthless the Ostron clade-families have built for themselves a bastion from the bones of a once-great Orokin citadel. In the eyes of an Ostron everything may serve a second purpose, and what is valueless now can be turned to serve a useful purpose later.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh: 通过从废物中搜刮价值，Ostron 的家族已经在这座曾经辉煌的奥罗金城堡的骨架上建立了一处堡垒。在 Ostron 人眼中，所有的东西都有其他的作用，现在无用的事物以后可以起到有益的作用。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentM
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: For her part, in her times alone, Er-Phryah came to know the birds and animals of the Plains and likewise struck an accord with them. Even the tortured Eidolons, creatures of this world and the next, left them in peace and made the lands around the Tower safe for the Ostrons.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 至于埃尔-芙丽雅，在独处的时光里，她熟识了平野上的飞禽走兽，并同样与它们结下了默契。就连那些徘徊于现世与彼岸、饱经折磨的夜灵，也未曾侵扰他们，让奥斯特朗人得以在高塔周围安居。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn: The blanketpiece of temple flesh is lowered to waiting butchers and flensers. The balloon's drop-driver holds her delicate craft steady as a great airing board is positioned beneath her cargo. The Old Man gives the order: ‘Sever the mainline!'
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh: 毯状的神殿肉被下放到等待的屠户和剥皮手手中。气球空投手小心地维持着她精巧飞行器的稳定，而一块巨大的晾晒板就放在她的货物之下。一个老人发出了指令："切断主线！"

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentN
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: At the center of this place was the Tower. And within the Tower was the Unum: the voice, the force, that had called Mer-Sah and Er-Phryah there so many years ago for this exact purpose. But the Unum is a being for another time, and another story.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 这片土地的中心矗立着高塔，高塔之中便是乌努母神。多年前，正是那道声音，那股力量，将弥尔-撒与埃尔-芙丽雅召唤至此，只为达成这一使命。但乌努母神属于另一个时代，那是另一段故事了。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn: While their floating markets may ply the rails of the Origin system, Cetus is the Ostron home: a trading hub where travelers from across the system meet to exchange information, wares and plunder in safety, protected by the Unum-enforced laws of barter and parley - free from the influence of Grineer and Corpus.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh: 尽管他们的浮空市集可以定期往来于始源星系的航道，希图斯仍然是 Ostron 人的家：这是一座交易中心，全星系的旅行者在这里碰头，安全地交换信息、商品和掠夺品。这里受到乌努母神定下的交易商谈法律的保护，免受 Grineer 和 Corpus 的影响。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentO
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: The Ostrons named their village Karifamil - 'family and prosperity'. Er-Phyrah was overjoyed to see her clade again… but Mer-Sah would not enter Karifamil, for he had no family save Er-Phyrah. Er-Phryah was drawn to her clade, and Mer-Sah felt no resentment. She would one day return to them^ Mer-Sah had known it would be so.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 奥斯特朗人将他们的村庄命名为卡里法米尔，意为「家族与繁荣」。埃尔-芙丽雅与枝族重逢，满心欢喜。弥尔-撒却不愿踏入卡里法米尔，因为除了埃尔-芙丽雅，他已别无亲眷。埃尔-芙丽雅心系枝族，弥尔-撒却毫无怨言，因为他早已知晓，她终有一天会回到族人身边。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn: The Ostron mercantile scavenger culture has birthed a rich tradition of artisans fluent in many styles, able to make use of whatever material is at hand to achieve stunning results. A side-effect of Temple harvesting is a light rain of gold dust, which can lead to the degenerative condition known as ‘gilded lung'. The need for masks to protect against this has led to a rich maskwork tradition unique to Cetus.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh: Ostron 重商的拾荒文化促成有着丰富传统的工匠，他们善于多种风格，能够将手中任何的材料化腐朽为神奇。神殿收割的一个副作用就是产生了金色粉尘的小雨，这导致了一种退行性疾病，被称作"镀金肺"。为了预防这种疾病，对面具的需求形成了希图斯独有的面具工艺传统。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentP
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: Mer-Sah took the things the sea had gifted him over his long life, and took to his boat, and sailed out across his midnight ocean. He returned those gifts to the deep... and himself to them too. But this was no death into which Mer-Sah stepped, for a world is made of cycles upon cycles. Mer-Sah stepped into his midnight ocean, falling down into it. The deeper he sank, the larger he became. This is how the oceans of Er came to be the home of the thousand-year fish: legendary, vast, reclusive, the rare sight of which changes men. One of the great ancient spirits of Er.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 弥尔-撒带上海洋在漫长岁月中赐予他的馈赠，登上小船，驶向午夜的汪洋。他将这些馈赠还给深海，也将自己一并归还。但弥尔-撒步入的并非死亡，因为世界本就是无尽的循环。弥尔-撒步入午夜的汪洋，不断向深处坠落。他下沉得越深，身躯便越发庞大。阋神星的海洋由此成为了千年鱼的栖息地。这种生灵庞大神秘且充满传奇色彩，常人难得一见，得见者皆为之改变。它是阋神星伟大的远古生灵之一。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn: Rising from the lakes at sundown and returning to them before dawn these simple-minded monstrosities roam the nighttime plains, howling, searching for a thing they can barely remember: completeness. Wholeness. An intelligence and malevolent purpose which, fate willing, they will never return to again.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh: 在落日时从湖中升起，又赶在黎明前回归，这些头脑简单的庞然大物游荡在夜晚的平野中，咆哮着搜寻依稀记得的一件事：完整性。完全性。所幸，他们再也无法回归，那种智慧和恶意。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentQ
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: The spirits of the land felt Er-Phryah's sadness, mad with grief for the loss of their friend to the spirits of the sea. The accord broke down, the animals and Eidolons returning once more to wildness. And so the people of the clade yingbindunyai rebuilt the great Orokin wall that had, in centuries gone by, ringed their gleaming Tower... and never again ventured out at night.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 大地的生灵也感受到了埃尔-芙丽雅的悲伤。它们痛失挚友，眼看着他被海洋的生灵带走，伤心得几近癫狂。于是，那份契约破裂了，飞禽走兽与夜灵重新变回了野性难驯的模样。万般无奈之下，英宾杜奈枝族的族人只得重新筑起那道宏伟的奥罗金高墙，数百年前，正是这道墙环绕着他们那座熠熠生辉的高塔。从此之后，他们再也不敢在夜里踏出墙外半步。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn:
"I know us for a miracle. A million-to-one improbability. Our existence is the most fragile of all existences. We could be exterminated tomorrow, yet we have endured by wit alone for millennia."

Oro-kin-ka: spirit houses for the souls of the Orokin who once inhabited Cetus. By giving them a small house in which to reside the Ostrons hope the Orokin spirits will leave them in peace. Said to be good luck.

Yoong-bat: Urns left outside Ostron doorways, filled with fresh water for traveling monks. No-one else should drink from them, especially offworlders.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh:
"我们是一个奇迹。百万分之一都未必有的可能性。我们的存在是所有的存在中最脆弱的。明天，我们就可能被消灭，然而单单凭借智慧，我们经受了数个千年。"

Oro-kin-ka：曾经生活在希图斯的奥罗金人的灵魂居所。通过给灵魂一间小屋子住，Ostron 人希望奥罗金的幽灵可以不来打搅。据说会带来好运。

僧水：Ostron 人门外的瓮，灌满了清水，给云游僧喝的。其他人不可以喝，尤其是异世者。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentR
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: The villagers decided as one that their home would no longer be known as Karifamil, 'family and prosperity'. From that day forward it would be known as Cetus: landless, of no one clade, home to any who are blown as dust on the wind. Er-Phyrah lived there the rest of her days, and for the remainder of her nights she held vigil atop the walls of Cetus, looking to the sea and, some say, occasionally catching sight of a great fish, like an island in a midnight ocean, looking back at her. With love.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 村民们一致决定，他们的家园不再叫作卡里法米尔。从那日起，它将被称为希图斯。它没有领地，不属于任何枝族，是所有如风中尘埃般飘零之人的归宿。埃尔-芙丽雅在那里度过了余生。此后的每一个长夜，她都在希图斯的城墙上守望，凝视着大海。有人说，她偶尔会看到一条巨鱼，宛如午夜汪洋中的一座孤岛。它也在回望着她，满怀爱意。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn: "It is my experience of the Plains that nature adapts with greater alacrity than we. Condrocs nest in Grineer comms towers, keeping watch over the gutted Sentient husks which Kuaka rodents have transformed into colony-nests. Master Teasonai has been of great assistance to my cataloguing, striving as he does to tame all manner of wildlife." - Onkko, Cetus Archivist.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh: "根据我在平野的经验，自然适应得远比我们要快。秃鹰会在 Grineer 的通信塔上筑巢，不断注视着严重受损的 Sentient 躯壳，库阿卡啮齿类已经将之变成了自己的巢穴。提松奈大师对我的分类工作帮助很大，他竭尽所能地驯化了各种野生动物。"——昂克，希图斯档案保管人。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentS
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: It is said that Mer-Sah continued to watch over the deep, as he had always done, and Er-Phryah the land. Often she would stand by her husband-sea, speaking in a language only those bound at the soul can know.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 据说，弥尔-撒一如既往地守望深海，而埃尔-芙丽雅则守望大地。她常常伫立在化作汪洋的丈夫身畔，用唯有灵魂相契者方能听懂的语言，与他低语倾诉。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn:
The cry of seabirds. The delicate, permeating scent of Temple blood. The laughter of children. The shouts of merchants and hawkers. The roar of approaching spacecraft. The distant, haunting howls of the Eidolon. Cetus.

Not much ruffles an Ostron. It is as if they have made peace with whatever will be. The closeness of the Unum provides a kind of comfort, offworlders suppose. Or perhaps some of the sanguine knowingness of the enigmatic Quills have rubbed off on them.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh:
海鸟的鸣叫。神殿血液弥散的轻微味道。孩童的笑语。商人和小贩的叫卖声。逼近的航天器的轰鸣。遥远而阴魂不散的夜灵咆哮。这就是希图斯。

不太有什么会触怒一个 Ostron 人。仿佛他们可以与任何东西和平共处。异世者觉得，是因为乌努母神的近临提供了一种舒适感。或者也许神秘的夜羽的一些乐观认知对他们产生了影响。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmentT
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textEn: When the day came and Er-Phryah passed from the world, her family buried her on the land. A great fish watched from the sea, and kept vigil over her, for ten days and nights. When it sank beneath the waves, it was never seen again. Some say Mer-Sah, the thousand-year fish, waits to this day for their story to be retold - relived - that he and Er-Phryah, his great love, may one day be reunited again. This is Onkko, Cetus Archivist, with my translation of the Tale of the Wife of the Earth and the Husband of the Sea.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.secretTransmission__textZh: 当埃尔-芙丽雅离世那日，家人将她安葬于大地。一条巨鱼在海面上静静注视，为她守灵十天十夜。随后它沉入波涛，世上便再也无人见过它的踪影。有人说，化作千年鱼的弥尔-撒至今仍在等待，等待着他们的故事被再次传唱，被再次重演。期盼着有朝一日，他能与一生挚爱埃尔-芙丽雅再度重逢。我是希图斯典籍官昂克，以上便是我译述的《大地之妻与大海之夫的传说》。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionEn:
"If the Unum speaks to you, traveler, it is because you have the ears to hear - though at first you may not believe it is so."

The being known by the Ostrons as ‘the Unum', and to ignorant offworlders as ‘the Wall', has a reputation for prophecy. Those wealthy enough to own moons have journeyed to Cetus, hoping to buy an audience. But the Unum has no use for wealth, and she alone decides who will hear her words, and when. 

Ostrons believe she sits at the pin-center of the universe, listening to the infinite poetry of cause-and-effect.

Some visitors to her chamber leave bitterly disappointed, others elated, others furious. But one thing is certain: the information she imparts changes the person who receives it.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/EidolonFragm.descriptionZh:
"如果乌努母神同你对话，旅行者，那是因为你拥有能听见的能力——虽然起初你可能不会这么认为。"

那个存在以乌努母神之名为 Ostron 所知，而无知的异世者称之为"墙"，她因为可以预知未来而名声远播。那些拥有卫星星球的富人远道而来，希望得以聆听。但是财富对于乌努母神来说没有用处，因此她自己决定何人、何时能听见她。

Ostron 人相信她位于宇宙的中心轴上，聆听着因果的无尽诗集。

有些前去她房间的参观者离去时大为失望，有些却兴高采烈，也有些怒不可遏。但是有一件事是确定的：她所透露的信息将会改变接收到之人。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RevenantFrag.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/MaskOfTheRevenantATitle
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RevenantFrag.secretTransmission__textEn: Why do I remember this? The land here, killing hot, full of strangeness. This is where Gara vanquished the Sentient! Where its essence fell into the ground, trapped in some unworldly between. It wanted out. At moon-rise its ghostly tendrils would emerge, seeking form, seeking… return. And this… this was the warden… a Warframe. I can see it, like a dream repeating… The tendril emerging, night after night, and the warden, night after night, cutting it down… until the warden himself was lost. How?
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RevenantFrag.secretTransmission__textZh: 为何我会记得这些？这片土地，热的要死，充满陌生。这是 Gara 消灭那个 Sentient 的地方！Sentient 的精华沉入了地下，被束缚在某种非物质之间。它想要挣脱。当月亮高悬之际，它的鬼影触须就会出现，寻求实体，寻求……回归。而这……这是看守人，一位战甲。我能看到它，仿佛是萦绕的梦境……触须出现，夜复一夜，而看守人也夜复一夜地砍断它们……直到看守者自身迷失了。为何如此？
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RevenantFrag.descriptionEn: A vision comes, something new is stirring within the ground. Seeking a body to call its own; longing to strike those who sent it to the grave.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RevenantFrag.descriptionZh: 一个影像出现了，全新的威胁在地底搅动。寻求着成为自身的身体，渴望着伏击将其送入坟墓之人。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RevenantFrag.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/MaskOfTheRevenantBTitle
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RevenantFrag.secretTransmission__textEn: Ugh… here we go again. I remember… the pool glows, the tendril emerges... and this Warframe draws its weapon to destroy it yet again… wait… no. He does not strike this time, he watches. Why? The phantom tendril grips trees and rocks, probing for substance... then fear returns and the lost one slashes the phantom, sending it back to its purgatory...
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RevenantFrag.secretTransmission__textZh: 呃……又来了。我记得……水池发光，触须显现……这台战甲抽出武器再次消灭……慢着……不。他这次没有攻击，他只是看着。为什么？幻影触须抓住了树木和石块，刺探着物体……接着恐惧再次出现，而迷失者切断了幻影，将它送回了炼狱……
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RevenantFrag.descriptionEn: A fragment of the ancient Sentient that once terrorized these plains.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RevenantFrag.descriptionZh: 曾经威胁着这平野的远古 Sentient 的一片碎片。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RevenantFrag.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/MaskOfTheRevenantCTitle
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RevenantFrag.secretTransmission__textEn: I see… The tendril once again. Instead of striking it... the lost one… he extends a hand to the Eidolon?! Khanung! What was he thinking? He's like Mukha on the tower. Every day, Mukha clamored across the tower ledges and scaffolds - nothing happened, day in and day out... Routine took his fear away. Uhh... Tenno - I see the tendril has him now. The lost one. He's become an anchor for the Eidolon - to pull itself into our world! The lost one struggles, pulling back, but it's too late! The Eidolon begins to emerge. But… the lost one realizes - he stops… he lets go... And so he falls. Falls from this world of the living and down, down, down, into the next. Mukha, that so was stupid.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RevenantFrag.secretTransmission__textZh: 我明白了……又是触须。没有攻击它……迷失者……他反而向夜灵伸出了手？！当心！他在想什么？他就像是在高塔上的穆卡。每一天，他在高塔的壁架和脚手架之间呼喊——什么都没有发生，日复一日……习以为常使他的恐惧日渐淡薄。呃……Tenno——我看到触须抓住了他，迷失者。他变成了夜灵把自己拉向现实世界的固位锚！迷失者挣扎着，想要抽身而退，但已经太迟了！夜灵开始现身。但是……迷失者意识到了——他停下了……他放手了……于是他坠落了。从生的世界坠落，越落越深，进入了另一个异界。穆卡，那太愚蠢了。
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RevenantFrag.descriptionEn: The warden of the plains, tasked with striking down the ever-returning ghostly Eidolon that threatened the Unum's Tower. Night after night, he cut them down. Then one night, he disappeared, lost… forever.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/RevenantFrag.descriptionZh: 平野的看守者，被赋予了击倒那鬼魅夜灵的任务，这只不断试图回归的夜灵曾经威胁了到了乌努母神之塔。夜复一夜，他将其击倒。但某一个晚上，他消失了，永远地……迷失了。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFragmentAName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.nameZh: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 后续
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.descriptionEn:
I wanted nothing but the ease of oblivion, at first. I floated ignorant in baths of nepenthe, a second gestation. Unseeing, unspeaking. Only rarely did my brain flicker errant light across the cave-paintings still smeared on the interior of my skull. 

At sensation's edge I knew a vague silhouette of Loid crooning motherly across the watery distances, the poetry my tongue was too blackened to recite.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.descriptionZh:
起初，我除了遗忘带来的安逸，什么也不想要。我毫无念想地漂浮在忘忧草浴中，仿佛进入了第二次孕育。不见世事，不发一言。我的脑海中偶尔会闪过游离的光线，照亮了那残留在我头骨内的洞穴壁画。 

在感知的尽头，我隐约认出了一个模糊的轮廓，那是洛德，隔水相望，如同慈母般低声吟唱。我的舌头太过污浊，无法诵出那歌谣。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFragmentBName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.nameZh: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 科维兽
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.descriptionEn:
I employed a variety of Cavia in an attempt to unmake the adversary. 

The principle was straightforward enough, though in hindsight I abhor my naivete. My humanity had been unscrolled by the caustic Void and now smirked back at me across the divide, privy to all my unfettered malice and pettiness. In answer, I resolved to hurl into the Void minds that were not human. Let it parody them. The proximity of the bestial would force a humbling devolution, or so I thought.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.descriptionZh:
我用多种科维兽试图消灭对手。

这个原理足够简单，尽管事后回想起来我讨厌自己的天真。我的人性被腐蚀性的虚空揭开，而现在又隔着鸿沟对我笑，对我所有肆无忌惮的恶意和狭隘了如指掌。作为回应，我决定将非人的思想投入到虚空。让虚空去拙劣地模仿它们。野性的接近将迫使它经历一场屈辱的退化。至少我是怎么认为的。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFragmentCName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.nameZh: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 双衍王境
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.descriptionEn:
In Duviri, I woke every day to the voice of my daughter. I recoiled from this at first, feeling the sting of conscience. I could not confront, even in semblance, the woman I had abandoned. Instead I reinvented myself as a teacher, advising the child-King of the menace beyond his borders.

But as the days melted away, I came to recognize the strange cast of characters Euleria had created, and their purpose. I heard voices I had myself first conjured in the darkness of her childhood chambers, for no other reward than her delight. She had not only preserved this gift I had thought so trivial, she had made it an instrument of healing. More: a stronghold.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.descriptionZh:
在双衍王境， 我每天都在我女儿的声音中醒来。起初，我因良心的责备而退缩。我无法面对我所抛弃的女儿，哪怕只是表面上的。于是我改头换面成为一位师长，告诫少年国王注意他王境之外的威胁。

但随着时光流逝，我开始认出欧拉瑞娅创造的那些古怪角色及其目的。我听到了那些声音，那是我最初在她孩童时代房间的漆黑中召唤出来的，不求任何回报，只为了她的喜悦。她不仅保留了这份我曾认为微不足道的礼物，还把它变成了一种治愈的工具。不仅如此：它还成为了一个堡垒。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFragmentDName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.nameZh: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 承载体
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.descriptionEn: I went among the denizens of the plague year like a savior, my hands filled with healing. To those who volunteered, I brought more than mere health. Their bodies were primed; it needed only the Helminth infusions, brought from my own time, to work the alchemy of transformation. They have become partial Warframes, still in possession of their free will, yet enhanced, Void-attuned, capable.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.descriptionZh: 我在瘟疫之年的居民中穿行，如同一个救世主，双手充满治愈之力。对于那些自愿者，我带去的不仅仅是健康。他们的身体已经做好了准备；只需要从我自己的时代带来的 Helminth 注入，就能实现转化的炼金术。他们已经成为了部分战甲，仍保有自由意志，同时得到了增强，适应虚空，能力出众。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFragmentEName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.nameEn: Albrecht's Notes - We End as we Began
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.nameZh: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 我出于尘土，也归于尘土
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.descriptionEn:
All is in readiness. Loid will do as he is bid, though his eyes silently plead with me to choose another path.


As I await my final crossing to the past, I ponder what role a scientist may play in so spiritual a matter as 'absolution'. How in the alchemy of the soul, even repentance must necessarily be a calculated task.

I will repair what I have broken, no more and no less. The scales must balance. And in such a monstrous penitence as this, I shall take no heed of the dust that may fall upon them on either side, the dust of petty lives.

The builders of old tempered their mortar with blood, to appease the most ancient of land-spirits. We should have been so wise. Yet it is not too late to learn.

The sands fall. The circuit completes. I return to the place of the beginning.

Let witless hordes bleat their disdain for every fervent plan;
The deal is done, the die is cast. I end as I began.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/AlbrectFragm.descriptionZh:
一切已准备就绪。洛德会按照命令行事，尽管他的眼神在无声地恳求我选择另一条道路。


在我等待着最后一次穿越到过去，我在思索，一个科学家在'赦免'这样一个灵性问题上能发挥什么作用。在灵魂的炼金术中，即使是悔改也必然是一项经过计算的任务。

我将修复我所破坏的，不多也不少。天平必须保持平衡。在这样巨大的忏悔面前，我不会关心任何一边上可能落下的尘埃，那些琐碎人生的尘埃。

古代建筑师用血液混合砂浆，以安抚最古老的土地神灵。我们本应如此明智。然而，现在学习还不算晚。

沙子落下，循环闭合。我回到了一切的起点。

任由那些无知人们对每个热切计划表示轻蔑吧；
交易已成，命运已定。我出于尘土，也归于尘土

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetAName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.nameEn: We Are Not What We Were
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionEn:
I am naturally curious. I can hardly help it. And so I set this down for any that follow in my footsteps, who wonder - as I have - about our home. 

Today, Duviri is a mere scattering of islands, set about the Palace as if they had spilled forth from it. But in the dawning time, when the Kingdom was new, it was a Kingdom worthy of the name.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionZh:
我天性好奇，几乎不能自已。因此，我为了那些跟随我脚步的人，为了那些像我一样，想要了解我们家园的人写下了这些话。 

今天，双衍王境只是一座座散布在王宫周围的岛屿，仿佛它们是从王宫里溢出来的。但在最开始，当王境刚成立时，它是一个名副其实的王境。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetBName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionEn: When Duviri came into being there were many islands whose contents were - to put it bluntly- horrific. The Execution Cyst, the Golden Hive, the Inversion Tree, Stitcher's Gulch and the Bountiful Swamp were all notorious, but each met a natural end, engulfed by the Void. Lorn was exiled deliberately.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionZh: 双衍王境诞生之初，许多岛屿上的事物……恕我直言，实在令人毛骨悚然。「处决包囊」「黄金蜂巢」「逆位之树」「缝合机峡谷」与「丰饶沼泽」无不恶名远扬，但最终都被虚空吞没，走向消亡。唯独孤魂岛，是被人为放逐的。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetCName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionEn:
In all the ages of Thrax's reign, only two strangers have ever been known to come to Duviri. 

One was the monk, Teshin, who fell from the sky into the lake on the island we now call Hermit's Landing. Seemingly lifeless, he was dragged ashore by Mathila who nursed his return to health. I have never known a constitution to match his; yet unlike us, he has… deteriorated… with the passing of time.

The other stranger came far earlier in Thrax's reign, before even the Bleeding Earth.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionZh:
在士魂大帝统治的所有时代当中，真要说起来，也只有两个陌生人来到过双衍王境。 

一位是个叫做 Teshin 的僧侣，他从天而降掉进了岛上的湖中，我们现在称那里为"隐临岛"。玛蒂拉把看上去毫无生命迹象的他拖上了岸，并照料他一直到他康复。我不知道谁有哪一种体质能跟他的体质相提并论；但他和我们不同，他，随着时间的流逝，状况已经越来越差。

另一个陌生人，在士魂大帝的统治早期就在这里了，甚至要早于"大地泣血"的时代。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetDName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionEn: The Necropolis Island was once one of the largest in Duviri, and the strangest. It appeared to be a sprawling burial ground, littered with gravestones, wooden crosses, sarcophagi and ornate tombs. But those who broke into these places found that there were no bodies to loot. Not a cadaver, not a skull, not even a tooth.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionZh: 大墓岛曾经是双衍王境最大的岛屿之一，也是最奇怪的岛屿之一。它似乎是一个庞大的墓地，散落着墓碑、木制十字架、石棺和华丽的坟墓。但那些胆大妄为闯入这些地方的人却发现，这里没有尸体可以掠夺。没有尸体，没有头骨，甚至连颗牙齿也没有。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetEName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionEn:
The island of Manipura was Duviri's vineyard. The Calaventi merchant sisterhood had villas there. Their tenant farmers raised succulent grapes to be turned into wine, which was taken as a tribute to be shared among the Dax. 

Tribute day was a great celebration in the Dax barracks, as the veiled Yaskutai would pour bowl after bowl of wine, comrades would show old wounds and tell tall tales of how they were come by, and old songs would be sung late into the night.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionZh:
宝石之岛是双衍王境的葡萄园。卡拉文蒂商人姐妹会在那里拥有别墅。她们的佃农种植多汁的葡萄酿造葡萄酒，作为贡品供禁卫享用。 

进贡日在禁卫军营是一个盛大的庆祝活动，蒙着面纱的管家会一碗一碗地倒酒，战友们会露出旧伤并大谈特谈他们是怎么受伤的，并在深夜里唱着老歌。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetFName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionEn: For Lake Verula to be lost and forgotten is a lasting bitterness to me. There was a time when it was Duviri's festival spot. On the anniversary of Thrax's coronation, the citizenry would build ceremonial floating islands. On these they would drift, sing, play music and light fragrant lanterns in honor of Thrax.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionZh: 维鲁拉湖的消失和被遗忘对我来说是一种非常漫长的痛苦。曾经有一段时间，这里是双衍王境的节日胜地。在士魂大帝的加冕周年纪念日中，国民们会建造仪式性的浮岛。他们会在上面漂浮、唱歌、演奏音乐并点亮芬芳的灯笼以纪念士魂大帝。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetGName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionEn:
The island was called Cornucopia, for its fecundity. The soil, dark and rich, yielded tubers and greens that shimmered with life. Wagons laden with tribute would go tottering up to the Palace in procession. 

All this was, of course, the will of the King; for what is a kingdom without its peasants? Thus had he created the islands, and thus they remained, day after indolent day. 

Then, on a morning like any other, Farmer Hovrel drove his spade into the earth and brought up blood.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionZh:
这座岛因为物产丰富被叫做丰饶岛。深色肥沃的土壤长出了闪闪发光的块茎和绿色植物。满载贡品的马车会列队摇摇晃晃地驶向王宫。 

当然，这一切都是大帝的旨意；没有农民的王境算什么？他就这样创造了这些岛屿，它们就这样日复一日地留了下来。 

然后，在一个和往常一样的早晨，农夫霍夫雷尔把他的铲子插进土里时，鲜血涌了上来。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetHName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionEn:
There was a time when the children of Duviri were educated. 

Upon the island of Academe, within its chalky caves, in rough-hewn classrooms lit by burning blue gas, sages taught them everything they would need to know. They learned of the Seven Principles, the geometries, the primords, the harmonics and resonances, the sacred stories, and most importantly, the unquestionable benignity of Dominus Thrax.

And then, not long after the Rain of Chains, the first of the Hollow Children appeared.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionZh:
曾经的日子里，双衍王境的孩子们是可以上学的。 

在学院岛上，有一个洞口多孔的山谷。在粉白色的洞穴里，在通过燃烧蓝色气体来照亮的简陋教室里，圣人会教给他们一切他们需要知道的关于现实的本质、七大原则、几何学、原基学、谐波和共振、神圣的故事，最重要的是，士魂大帝不容置疑的仁慈。

"锁链之雨"发生后不久，第一个空洞之子出现了。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetIName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionEn: How I loved the Galleria. It was an island of simple beauty, where white statues rose out of the ground as if they had grown there. They were classical in their features, masked in due propriety, each bearing an instrument or an emblem of their craft. I gave them names: the Scribe, the Scryer, the Shawzinist.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionZh: 我多么喜欢艺术回廊。这是一座朴素而美丽的岛屿，白色的雕像拔地而起，就好像它们长在那里一样。他们有着古典的特征，装扮得体，每个人都佩戴着代表他们自己手艺的乐器或标志。我给他们起了名字：作家、占卜师、三线琴家。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetJName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionEn:
In the splendid lands on this side of the Wall lives happy Mathila; and she has two children. 

She also had a husband, in her yesterdays. When I have attempted to talk to her about him she has simply frozen, like a rat before a snake. 

His name was Garmi, and he was keeper of the Seriglass Lighthouse on Watcher's Island.
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriFragme.descriptionZh:
在「墙」这一边的锦绣大地上，住着快乐的玛蒂拉和她的两个孩子。 

从前，她还有过一位丈夫。可每当我谈起她丈夫时，她都会像老鼠撞见了蛇一般，瞬间僵住。 

她的丈夫名叫加尔米，曾是守望者之岛上玻璃灯塔的守护人。

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriMITWFr.name: /Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverFragmentTitle1
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriMITWFr.descriptionEn:
THE FIRST THREAD

Once Upon A Time… there was a little girl. An envious little girl, who watched as the whole world had more than she did. All the nice things, all the expensive things. And so she took what she didn't have.

And along came a spider who told her that everyone in the world would always have more than she did. But the spider said he could eat it all up for her.

But she clung to her favorite toy and filled her life with her family and told the spider to GO! AWAY!
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/DuviriMITWFr.descriptionZh:
第一根蛛丝

从前……有一个小女孩。一个嫉妒的小女孩，眼睁睁地看着全世界的人都拥有得比她多，所有美好的、昂贵的东西。于是她拿走了自己没有的。

这时来了一只蜘蛛，告诉她世界上总会有人拥有得比她多。但蜘蛛说他可以为她把这一切都吃掉。

然而，她紧紧抓住自己最爱的玩具，用家人填满自己的生活，并让蜘蛛滚——开——！

/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MusicFragmen.name: /Lotus/Language/Fragments/LullabyOfTheManifoldAdissLamentSongName
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MusicFragmen.nameEn: Lullaby of the Manifold - Adis's Lament
/Lotus/Types/Lore/Fragments/MusicFragmen.nameZh: 万物摇篮曲 - 阿迪斯的哀歌
